import Foundation

/// Result of a finished child process.
struct ProcessResult: Sendable {
    var exitCode: Int32
    var stdout: String
    var stderr: String
    var cancelled: Bool

    var ok: Bool { exitCode == 0 && !cancelled }
}

enum ProcessError: LocalizedError {
    case launchFailed(String)
    case missingTool(String)
    case failed(code: Int32, message: String)
    case cancelled

    var errorDescription: String? {
        switch self {
        case .launchFailed(let m): return L("enum.processerror.cancelled", m)
        case .missingTool(let t): return L("enum.processerror.cancelled.2", t)
        case .failed(let code, let message):
            let trimmed = message.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
            // The detail is appended only when present, so the two languages
            // can phrase the prefix independently.
            let detail = trimmed.isEmpty ? "" : ":\n" + String(trimmed.suffix(600))
            return detail.isEmpty
                ? L("error.failed.short", code)
                : L("error.failed", code, detail)
        case .cancelled: return L("ui.cancelled")
        }
    }
}

/// A cancellable handle around a running child process.
final class ProcessHandle: @unchecked Sendable {
    private let lock = NSLock()
    private var process: Process?
    private var _cancelled = false

    var isCancelled: Bool {
        lock.lock(); defer { lock.unlock() }
        return _cancelled
    }

    fileprivate func attach(_ p: Process) {
        lock.lock()
        process = p
        let alreadyCancelled = _cancelled
        lock.unlock()
        if alreadyCancelled { p.terminate() }
    }

    func cancel() {
        lock.lock()
        _cancelled = true
        let p = process
        lock.unlock()
        p?.terminate()
    }
}

/// Thin, allocation-light wrapper over `Process` that streams stdout/stderr
/// incrementally so callers can parse live progress (ffmpeg `-progress`).
enum ProcessRunner {

    /// Locate an executable across the usual Homebrew + system locations.
    /// GUI apps inherit a minimal PATH, so we must probe explicitly.
    static let searchPaths = [
        "/opt/homebrew/bin", "/usr/local/bin", "/usr/bin", "/bin",
        "/usr/sbin", "/sbin", "/opt/homebrew/sbin", "/usr/local/sbin",
    ]

    /// Tools bundled inside the app (Resources/Tools). Checked first so the
    /// app works on a machine with no Homebrew at all.
    static var bundledToolsDirectory: URL? {
        guard let resources = Bundle.main.resourceURL else { return nil }
        let directory = resources.appendingPathComponent("Tools", isDirectory: true)
        var isDirectory: ObjCBool = false
        guard FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: directory.path, isDirectory: &isDirectory),
              isDirectory.boolValue else { return nil }
        return directory
    }

    /// True when the app shipped its own copies of the external tools.
    static var isSelfContained: Bool {
        guard let directory = bundledToolsDirectory else { return false }
        return FileManager.default.fileExists(
            atPath: directory.appendingPathComponent("ffmpeg").path)
    }

    static var cache: [String: String?] = [:]
    static let cacheLock = NSLock()

    static func locate(_ tool: String) -> String? {
        if tool.hasPrefix("/") {
            return FileManager.default.isExecutableFile(atPath: tool) ? tool : nil
        }
        cacheLock.lock()
        if let hit = cache[tool] { cacheLock.unlock(); return hit }
        cacheLock.unlock()

        var found: String?

        // 1. A copy bundled inside the app always wins: it makes the DMG work
        //    on machines without Homebrew, and guarantees a known version.
        if let directory = bundledToolsDirectory {
            let candidate = directory.appendingPathComponent(tool).path
            if FileManager.default.isExecutableFile(atPath: candidate) {
                found = candidate
            }
        }

        // 2. A user-specified path (Settings) overrides the system search.
        if found == nil, tool == "ffmpeg" || tool == "ffprobe" {
            let custom = AppSettings.shared.customFFmpegPath
            if !custom.isEmpty {
                let directory = (custom as NSString).deletingLastPathComponent
                let candidate = directory + "/" + tool
                if FileManager.default.isExecutableFile(atPath: candidate) {
                    found = candidate
                }
            }
        }

        // 3. Fall back to the system / Homebrew installations.
        if found == nil {
            for dir in searchPaths {
                let candidate = dir + "/" + tool
                if FileManager.default.isExecutableFile(atPath: candidate) {
                    found = candidate
                    break
                }
            }
        }

        cacheLock.lock(); cache[tool] = found; cacheLock.unlock()
        return found
    }

    static func exists(_ tool: String) -> Bool { locate(tool) != nil }

    /// Environment with a PATH that includes Homebrew so child tools can find
    /// their own dependencies.
    static var environment: [String: String] {
        var env = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment
        env["PATH"] = searchPaths.joined(separator: ":")
        env["LC_ALL"] = "en_US.UTF-8"
        env["LANG"] = "en_US.UTF-8"
        // Keep ffmpeg quiet and non-interactive.
        env["AV_LOG_FORCE_NOCOLOR"] = "1"
        return env
    }

    /// Run a tool to completion, streaming each stdout line to `onLine`.
    /// `stderr` is captured separately (ffmpeg logs there, progress on stdout).
    @discardableResult
    static func run(
        _ tool: String,
        _ arguments: [String],
        handle: ProcessHandle? = nil,
        onStdout: (@Sendable (String) -> Void)? = nil,
        onStderr: (@Sendable (String) -> Void)? = nil
    ) async throws -> ProcessResult {
        guard let path = locate(tool) else { throw ProcessError.missingTool(tool) }

        let process = Process()
        process.executableURL = URL(fileURLWithPath: path)
        process.arguments = arguments
        process.environment = environment
        process.standardInput = FileHandle.nullDevice

        let outPipe = Pipe(), errPipe = Pipe()
        process.standardOutput = outPipe
        process.standardError = errPipe

        let collector = LineCollector()
        outPipe.fileHandleForReading.readabilityHandler = { fh in
            let data = fh.availableData
            guard !data.isEmpty else { return }
            collector.append(data, isStdout: true, sink: onStdout)
        }
        errPipe.fileHandleForReading.readabilityHandler = { fh in
            let data = fh.availableData
            guard !data.isEmpty else { return }
            collector.append(data, isStdout: false, sink: onStderr)
        }

        do {
            try process.run()
        } catch {
            outPipe.fileHandleForReading.readabilityHandler = nil
            errPipe.fileHandleForReading.readabilityHandler = nil
            throw ProcessError.launchFailed(error.localizedDescription)
        }
        handle?.attach(process)

        // Await termination without blocking a cooperative thread.
        await withCheckedContinuation { (cont: CheckedContinuation<Void, Never>) in
            process.terminationHandler = { _ in cont.resume() }
        }

        outPipe.fileHandleForReading.readabilityHandler = nil
        errPipe.fileHandleForReading.readabilityHandler = nil
        // Drain anything buffered after the handler was removed.
        collector.append(outPipe.fileHandleForReading.readDataToEndOfFile(), isStdout: true, sink: onStdout)
        collector.append(errPipe.fileHandleForReading.readDataToEndOfFile(), isStdout: false, sink: onStderr)

        let cancelled = handle?.isCancelled ?? false
        return ProcessResult(
            exitCode: process.terminationStatus,
            stdout: collector.stdout,
            stderr: collector.stderr,
            cancelled: cancelled
        )
    }

    /// Run a tool while mirroring its output into a job log.
    @discardableResult
    static func runLogged(
        _ tool: String,
        _ arguments: [String],
        handle: ProcessHandle? = nil,
        logger: JobLogger,
        onStdout: (@Sendable (String) -> Void)? = nil
    ) async throws -> ProcessResult {
        logger.commandLines(tool, arguments)
        let result = try await run(
            tool, arguments, handle: handle,
            onStdout: onStdout,
            onStderr: { line in
                let trimmed = line.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces)
                guard !trimmed.isEmpty else { return }
                logger.output(trimmed)
            })
        if !result.ok && !result.cancelled {
            logger.error(L("ui.tool_exited_with_code_result_exitcode", tool, result.exitCode))
        }
        return result
    }

    /// Convenience for short, non-streaming calls such as `ffprobe`.
    static func capture(_ tool: String, _ arguments: [String]) async throws -> String {
        let result = try await run(tool, arguments)
        guard result.ok else {
            throw ProcessError.failed(code: result.exitCode, message: result.stderr)
        }
        return result.stdout
    }
}

/// Thread-safe line splitter shared by the pipe readability handlers.
private final class LineCollector: @unchecked Sendable {
    private let lock = NSLock()
    private var outBuf = Data()
    private var errBuf = Data()
    private var _stdout = ""
    private var _stderr = ""

    var stdout: String { lock.lock(); defer { lock.unlock() }; return _stdout }
    var stderr: String { lock.lock(); defer { lock.unlock() }; return _stderr }

    func append(_ data: Data, isStdout: Bool, sink: (@Sendable (String) -> Void)?) {
        guard !data.isEmpty else { return }
        lock.lock()
        if isStdout { outBuf.append(data) } else { errBuf.append(data) }

        var lines: [String] = []
        if isStdout {
            lines = Self.drain(&outBuf)
            _stdout += lines.joined(separator: "\n")
            if !lines.isEmpty { _stdout += "\n" }
        } else {
            lines = Self.drain(&errBuf)
            _stderr += lines.joined(separator: "\n")
            if !lines.isEmpty { _stderr += "\n" }
        }
        lock.unlock()

        guard let sink else { return }
        for line in lines { sink(line) }
    }

    /// Split complete lines out of the buffer, leaving a partial tail behind.
    private static func drain(_ buffer: inout Data) -> [String] {
        var lines: [String] = []
        while let idx = buffer.firstIndex(of: 0x0A) {
            let slice = buffer[buffer.startIndex..<idx]
            if let text = String(data: slice, encoding: .utf8) {
                lines.append(text.trimmingCharacters(in: CharacterSet(charactersIn: "\r")))
            }
            buffer.removeSubrange(buffer.startIndex...idx)
        }
        return lines
    }
}

import Foundation

// MARK: - Log entry

/// One line in a job's activity log.
struct LogEntry: Identifiable, Sendable {
    enum Level: String, Sendable {
        case info, command, output, success, warning, error

        var symbol: String {
            switch self {
            case .info: return "circle.fill"
            case .command: return "chevron.right"
            case .output: return "text.alignleft"
            case .success: return "checkmark.circle.fill"
            case .warning: return "exclamationmark.triangle.fill"
            case .error: return "xmark.octagon.fill"
            }
        }
    }

    let id = UUID()
    let timestamp: Date
    let level: Level
    let text: String

    init(level: Level, text: String, timestamp: Date = Date()) {
        self.level = level
        self.text = text
        self.timestamp = timestamp
    }

    var timeLabel: String {
        let formatter = DateFormatter()
        formatter.dateFormat = "HH:mm:ss.SSS"
        return formatter.string(from: timestamp)
    }
}

// MARK: - Logger

/// Thread-safe sink that streams log lines out of worker tasks and into the UI.
/// Entries are appended from arbitrary threads, so the buffer is lock-guarded
/// and the delivery callback hops to the main actor.
final class JobLogger: @unchecked Sendable {
    private let lock = NSLock()
    private var buffer: [LogEntry] = []
    private var truncated = 0
    private let limit: Int
    private let sink: @Sendable (LogEntry) -> Void

    init(limit: Int = 600, sink: @escaping @Sendable (LogEntry) -> Void) {
        self.limit = limit
        self.sink = sink
    }

    func log(_ level: LogEntry.Level, _ text: String) {
        // Keep the buffer bounded so a long ffmpeg run cannot exhaust memory.
        let entry = LogEntry(level: level, text: text)
        lock.lock()
        buffer.append(entry)
        if buffer.count > limit {
            let overflow = buffer.count - limit
            buffer.removeFirst(overflow)
            truncated += overflow
        }
        lock.unlock()
        sink(entry)
    }

    func info(_ text: String) { log(.info, text) }
    func command(_ text: String) { log(.command, text) }
    func output(_ text: String) { log(.output, text) }
    func success(_ text: String) { log(.success, text) }
    func warning(_ text: String) { log(.warning, text) }
    func error(_ text: String) { log(.error, text) }

    /// Multi-line helpers used for command lines and process output.
    func commandLines(_ executable: String, _ arguments: [String]) {
        command(shellLine(executable, arguments))
    }

    func outputBlock(_ text: String, level: LogEntry.Level = .output) {
        for line in text.split(separator: "\n", omittingEmptySubsequences: true) {
            let trimmed = String(line).trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces)
            guard !trimmed.isEmpty else { continue }
            log(level, trimmed)
        }
    }

    /// Render a command line the way a user could paste it into a terminal.
    static func shellLine(_ executable: String, _ arguments: [String]) -> String {
        ([executable] + arguments).map(quote).joined(separator: " ")
    }

    private func shellLine(_ executable: String, _ arguments: [String]) -> String {
        Self.shellLine(executable, arguments)
    }

    /// Quote only when the token would otherwise be split by the shell.
    private static func quote(_ token: String) -> String {
        let safe = CharacterSet(charactersIn:
            "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789-_./=:@,+")
        if token.unicodeScalars.allSatisfy({ safe.contains($0) }) { return token }
        return "'" + token.replacingOccurrences(of: "'", with: "'\\''") + "'"
    }

    static let silent = JobLogger { _ in }
}

// MARK: - Lifecycle

/// Log lines describing a job's start and finish. Extracted so the app queue
/// and the headless test harness emit identical, verifiable output.
enum JobLifecycle {

    static func logStart(
        _ logger: JobLogger,
        toolName: String,
        inputs: [URL],
        outputDirectory: URL,
        estimate: WorkEstimate?
    ) {
        let total = inputs.reduce(Int64(0)) { $0 + FileIO.size(of: $1) }
        logger.info(L("ui.task_started_toolname", toolName))
        logger.info(L("ui.inputs_count_file_s_format_bytes_total_tot", inputs.count, Format.bytes(total)))
        for url in inputs.prefix(10) {
            logger.info("  · \(url.lastPathComponent)  \(Format.bytes(FileIO.size(of: url)))")
        }
        if inputs.count > 10 {
            logger.info(L("ui.and_inputs_count_10_more_files", inputs.count - 10))
        }
        logger.info(L("ui.output_folder_outputdirectory_path", outputDirectory.path))
        if let estimate {
            logger.info(L("ui.estimated_estimate_sizelabel_about_estimat", estimate.sizeLabel, estimate.timeLabel)
                        + "（\(estimate.basis)）")
        }
    }

    static func logSuccess(
        _ logger: JobLogger,
        outputs: [URL],
        inputBytes: Int64,
        elapsed: TimeInterval
    ) {
        let outputBytes = outputs.reduce(Int64(0)) { $0 + FileIO.size(of: $1) }
        logger.success(L("ui.finished_outputs_count_file_s_format_bytes", outputs.count, Format.bytes(outputBytes)))
        for url in outputs.prefix(20) {
            logger.success("  → \(url.lastPathComponent)  \(Format.bytes(FileIO.size(of: url)))")
        }
        if outputs.count > 20 {
            logger.info(L("ui.and_outputs_count_20_more_files_omitted", outputs.count - 20))
        }
        if inputBytes > 0, outputBytes > 0 {
            let saved = 1 - Double(outputBytes) / Double(inputBytes)
            let verb = saved >= 0 ? L("ui.smaller") : L("ui.increased")
            logger.info(String(format: L("ui.size_by_0f"),
                               verb, abs(saved) * 100,
                               Format.bytes(inputBytes), Format.bytes(outputBytes)))
        }
        logger.info(String(format: L("ui.took_2f_s"), elapsed))
    }
}

ffmpeg driver and progress parsingffmpeg 驱动与进度解析ffmpeg ドライバと進捗解析ffmpeg 드라이버와 진행률 파싱Pilotage de ffmpeg et analyse de la progression

Every video feature is built on top of ffmpeg. The difficulty is getting the argument combinations right — encoders, containers, pixel formats, and filters carry a large number of implicit constraints.视频功能全部建立在 ffmpeg 之上。难在参数组合的正确性——编码器、容器、像素格式、滤镜之间有大量隐含约束。動画機能はすべて ffmpeg の上に成り立っています。難しいのはパラメータの組み合わせの正しさ——エンコーダ・コンテナ・ピクセルフォーマット・フィルタの間には多くの暗黙の制約があります。동영상 기능은 전부 ffmpeg 위에 세워져 있습니다. 어려운 점은 파라미터 조합의 정확성입니다. 인코더, 컨테이너, 픽셀 포맷, 필터 사이에 암묵적인 제약이 아주 많습니다.Toutes les fonctions vidéo reposent sur ffmpeg. La difficulté réside dans la justesse des combinaisons d'arguments : encodeurs, conteneurs, formats de pixels et filtres sont liés par une foule de contraintes implicites.

The core idea核心思路核心となる考え方핵심 발상L'idée directrice　Calling ffmpeg is easy; getting <b>the argument combinations right</b> is not — encoders, containers, pixel formats, and filters carry a lot of implicit constraints, and a bad combination either errors out or produces a file other players can't open.调用 ffmpeg 本身很简单，难在<b>参数组合的正确性</b>——编码器、容器、像素格式、滤镜之间有大量隐含约束，组合错了要么报错，要么产出别的播放器打不开的文件。ffmpeg の呼び出し自体は簡単です。難しいのは<b>パラメータの組み合わせの正しさ</b>です——エンコーダ・コンテナ・ピクセルフォーマット・フィルタの間には多くの暗黙の制約があり、間違えるとエラーになるか、他のプレイヤーで開けないファイルができます。ffmpeg를 호출하는 것 자체는 간단합니다. 어려운 것은 <b>파라미터 조합의 정확성</b>입니다. 인코더, 컨테이너, 픽셀 포맷, 필터 사이에는 암묵적인 제약이 아주 많아서, 조합을 잘못하면 오류가 나거나 다른 플레이어가 열지 못하는 파일이 나옵니다.Appeler ffmpeg est simple en soi ; la difficulté est <b>la justesse des combinaisons d'arguments</b> — encodeurs, conteneurs, formats de pixels et filtres sont liés par une foule de contraintes implicites. Une mauvaise combinaison provoque soit une erreur, soit un fichier que les autres lecteurs refusent d'ouvrir.

Why it is built this way为什么这样实现なぜそう実装したのか왜 이렇게 구현했는가Pourquoi c'est fait ainsi

Why arguments are assembled in three layers为什么参数要分三层组装なぜパラメータを 3 層に分けて組み立てるのか왜 파라미터를 세 층으로 나누어 조립하는가Pourquoi les arguments sont assemblés en trois couches

Input options (before <code>-i</code>), filters, and output options (after <code>-i</code>) have to be in the right order. Building them as three separate layers avoids 'option in the wrong place' bugs — <code>-hwaccel</code>, for instance, is an input option, and putting it on the output side fails immediately.输入选项（<code>-i</code> 之前）、滤镜、输出选项（<code>-i</code> 之后）顺序不能乱。把这三层分开构建，避免「选项放错位置」这类错误——比如 <code>-hwaccel</code> 是输入选项，放到输出侧会直接报错。入力オプション（<code>-i</code> より前）・フィルタ・出力オプション（<code>-i</code> より後）は順序を崩せません。この 3 層を分けて構築すれば「オプションの置き場所ミス」を避けられます——たとえば <code>-hwaccel</code> は入力オプションなので、出力側に置くと即エラーになります。입력 옵션(<code>-i</code> 앞), 필터, 출력 옵션(<code>-i</code> 뒤)은 순서를 틀리면 안 됩니다. 이 세 층을 따로 조립하면 "옵션 위치를 잘못 두는" 유형의 오류를 피할 수 있습니다. 예를 들어 <code>-hwaccel</code>은 입력 옵션이라 출력 쪽에 두면 곧바로 오류가 납니다.Options d'entrée (avant <code>-i</code>), filtres et options de sortie (après <code>-i</code>) ne peuvent pas être mélangés. Construire ces trois couches séparément évite les erreurs d'option mal placée — <code>-hwaccel</code>, par exemple, est une option d'entrée : du côté sortie, ffmpeg échoue immédiatement.

Why the container has to match the encoder为什么容器要跟编码器对齐なぜコンテナをエンコーダに合わせるのか왜 컨테이너를 인코더에 맞춰야 하는가Pourquoi le conteneur doit s'accorder à l'encodeur

The WebM container only accepts VP8/VP9/AV1, and MP4 rejects plenty of combinations beyond VP9. If a user picks H.264 with WebM, we have to correct it automatically or ffmpeg errors out.WebM 容器只接受 VP8/VP9/AV1，MP4 不接受 VP9 之外的很多组合。如果用户选了 H.264 又选了 WebM，必须自动纠正，否则 ffmpeg 报错。WebM コンテナは VP8/VP9/AV1 しか受け付けず、MP4 も VP9 以外の多くの組み合わせを受け付けません。ユーザーが H.264 と WebM を選んだら自動で訂正しないと、ffmpeg がエラーを出します。WebM 컨테이너는 VP8/VP9/AV1만 받아들이고, MP4는 VP9 외의 많은 조합을 받지 않습니다. 사용자가 H.264를 고르고 WebM까지 고르면 자동으로 바로잡아야 하며, 그렇지 않으면 ffmpeg가 오류를 냅니다.Le conteneur WebM n'accepte que VP8/VP9/AV1, et le MP4 refuse quantité de combinaisons en dehors de VP9. Si l'utilisateur choisit H.264 avec WebM, il faut corriger automatiquement, sinon ffmpeg échoue.

Why tools with multiple inputs build -i themselves为什么有多个输入时要自己拼 -iなぜ入力が複数あるときは -i を自分で組み立てるのか왜 입력이 여러 개일 때 -i를 직접 조립해야 하는가Pourquoi les entrées multiples assemblent elles-mêmes leur -i

The generic wrapper adds an <code>-i input</code> by default. Tools like concat, watermark, and slideshow need several inputs, and if the wrapper adds one more, every input index shifts — <code>-map 1:a</code> points at the wrong stream. That bug actually shipped: concatenating two videos produced 3 seconds instead of 6.通用封装会默认加一个 <code>-i input</code>。拼接、水印、相册这类工具需要多个输入，如果封装再加一个，所有输入索引都会偏移——<code>-map 1:a</code> 会指到错误的流。这个 bug 实际发生过：视频拼接只输出了 3 秒而不是 6 秒。汎用ラッパーは既定で <code>-i input</code> を 1 つ足します。結合・ウォーターマーク・スライドショーのようなツールは複数入力が必要で、ここでラッパーがもう 1 つ足すと入力インデックスがすべてずれ、<code>-map 1:a</code> が誤ったストリームを指します。このバグは実際に起きました——動画の結合で 6 秒ではなく 3 秒しか出力されなかったのです。범용 래퍼는 기본적으로 <code>-i input</code>을 하나 붙입니다. 이어 붙이기, 워터마크, 슬라이드쇼 같은 도구는 입력이 여러 개 필요한데, 래퍼가 또 하나를 더하면 모든 입력 인덱스가 밀립니다. <code>-map 1:a</code>가 엉뚱한 스트림을 가리키게 됩니다. 이 버그는 실제로 발생했습니다. 동영상 이어 붙이기가 6초가 아니라 3초만 출력했습니다.L'enveloppe générique ajoute par défaut un <code>-i input</code>. Les outils comme la concaténation, le filigrane ou le diaporama ont besoin de plusieurs entrées ; si l'enveloppe en ajoute une de plus, tous les index d'entrée se décalent — <code>-map 1:a</code> pointerait sur le mauvais flux. Le bug s'est bel et bien produit : une concaténation n'a produit que 3 secondes au lieu de 6.

Why text watermarks don't use drawtext为什么文字水印不用 drawtextなぜテキストウォーターマークで drawtext を使わないのか왜 텍스트 워터마크에 drawtext를 쓰지 않는가Pourquoi le filigrane texte n'utilise pas drawtext

The bundled ffmpeg isn't built with libfreetype, so the <code>drawtext</code> filter doesn't exist. We render the text to a transparent PNG with CoreText and composite it with <code>overlay</code> — which incidentally gives us full CJK font support and better antialiasing.本机 ffmpeg 没有编译 libfreetype，<code>drawtext</code> 滤镜不存在。改用 CoreText 把文字渲染成透明 PNG，再用 <code>overlay</code> 合成——顺带获得了完整的中日韩字体支持和更好的抗锯齿。手元の ffmpeg は libfreetype を組んでおらず、<code>drawtext</code> フィルタが存在しません。そこで CoreText でテキストを透過 PNG に描画し、<code>overlay</code> で合成する方式にしました——副次的に、CJK フォントの完全なサポートとより良いアンチエイリアスも得られました。이 환경의 ffmpeg에는 libfreetype이 컴파일되어 있지 않아 <code>drawtext</code> 필터가 없습니다. 대신 CoreText로 텍스트를 투명 PNG로 렌더링한 뒤 <code>overlay</code>로 합성합니다. 덕분에 한중일 폰트 지원과 더 나은 앤티앨리어싱도 함께 얻었습니다.Le ffmpeg de la machine a été compilé sans libfreetype : le filtre <code>drawtext</code> n'existe pas. On rend donc le texte en PNG transparent avec CoreText, puis on le compose via <code>overlay</code> — avec, en prime, une prise en charge complète des polices CJK et un meilleur anticrénelage.

Why CRF and hardware encoding are handled separately为什么 CRF 和硬件编码要分开处理なぜ CRF とハードウェアエンコードを分けて扱うのか왜 CRF와 하드웨어 인코딩을 따로 처리하는가Pourquoi CRF et encodage matériel sont traités à part

VideoToolbox doesn't support CRF; it only takes the 0–100 quality scale of <code>-q:v</code>. Mapping CRF onto it is only an approximation, so hardware encoding defaults to off — it's faster, but at the same visual quality the file is noticeably larger.VideoToolbox 不支持 CRF，只接受 <code>-q:v</code> 的 0–100 质量标度。把 CRF 映射过去只是近似，所以硬件编码的默认值是关闭——它更快，但同画质下文件明显更大。VideoToolbox は CRF に対応せず、<code>-q:v</code> の 0〜100 の品質スケールしか受け付けません。CRF を写像しても近似にすぎないため、ハードウェアエンコードの既定値はオフです——速い代わりに、同じ画質ではファイルが明らかに大きくなります。VideoToolbox는 CRF를 지원하지 않고 <code>-q:v</code>의 0–100 품질 척도만 받습니다. CRF를 옮겨 매핑하는 것은 근사일 뿐이라, 하드웨어 인코딩의 기본값은 꺼짐입니다. 더 빠르지만 같은 화질에서 파일이 눈에 띄게 커집니다.VideoToolbox ne gère pas le CRF et n'accepte que l'échelle de qualité 0–100 de <code>-q:v</code>. La conversion depuis le CRF reste approximative, c'est pourquoi l'encodage matériel est désactivé par défaut : il va plus vite, mais à qualité égale le fichier est nettement plus gros.

Diagram图示図解도해Schéma

Implementation steps实现步骤実装手順구현 단계Étapes d'implémentation

  1. Pick the encoder选编码器エンコーダを選ぶ인코더 선택Choisir l'encodeurBased on the chosen codec and whether hardware acceleration is on, <code>FFmpeg.videoArgs</code> decides between <code>libx264</code> and <code>h264_videotoolbox</code>.<code>FFmpeg.videoArgs</code> 根据编码器与是否启用硬件加速，决定用 <code>libx264</code> 还是 <code>h264_videotoolbox</code>。<code>FFmpeg.videoArgs</code> がエンコーダとハードウェア加速の有無から、<code>libx264</code> か <code>h264_videotoolbox</code> かを決めます。<code>FFmpeg.videoArgs</code>는 인코더와 하드웨어 가속 사용 여부에 따라 <code>libx264</code>를 쓸지 <code>h264_videotoolbox</code>를 쓸지 정합니다.<code>FFmpeg.videoArgs</code> choisit <code>libx264</code> ou <code>h264_videotoolbox</code> selon l'encodeur et l'activation de l'accélération matérielle.
  2. Assemble quality arguments组装画质参数画質パラメータを組む화질 파라미터 조립Assembler les arguments de qualitéSoftware encoding uses <code>-crf</code> + <code>-preset</code>; hardware encoding uses <code>-q:v</code>, mapping the CRF value back onto the quality scale.软件编码用 <code>-crf</code> + <code>-preset</code>；硬件编码用 <code>-q:v</code> 并把 CRF 反向映射到质量标度。ソフトウェアエンコードは <code>-crf</code> + <code>-preset</code>、ハードウェアエンコードは <code>-q:v</code> を使い、CRF を品質スケールへ逆写像します。소프트웨어 인코딩은 <code>-crf</code> + <code>-preset</code>을 쓰고, 하드웨어 인코딩은 <code>-q:v</code>를 쓰며 CRF를 품질 척도로 역매핑합니다.L'encodage logiciel utilise <code>-crf</code> + <code>-preset</code> ; l'encodage matériel utilise <code>-q:v</code>, avec une conversion inverse du CRF vers l'échelle de qualité.
  3. Stack the geometry filters叠加几何滤镜幾何フィルタを重ねる기하 필터 겹치기Empiler les filtres géométriquesScale, frame rate, and fit mode combine into a single <code>-vf</code> chain. Multiple filters are comma-separated — and note that commas inside a filter expression must be escaped as <code>\,</code>.缩放、帧率、适配方式合成一条 <code>-vf</code> 链。多个滤镜用逗号连接，注意逗号在滤镜表达式里要转义成 <code>\,</code>。拡大縮小・フレームレート・フィット方式を 1 本の <code>-vf</code> チェーンにまとめます。複数のフィルタはカンマで繋ぎ、フィルタ式の中のカンマは <code>\,</code> にエスケープする必要があります。크기 조정, 프레임 레이트, 맞춤 방식을 하나의 <code>-vf</code> 체인으로 합칩니다. 필터가 여러 개면 쉼표로 연결하는데, 필터 표현식 안에서는 쉼표를 <code>\,</code>로 이스케이프해야 합니다.Redimensionnement, cadence et mode d'ajustement forment une seule chaîne <code>-vf</code>. Les filtres sont séparés par des virgules, et attention : dans une expression de filtre, la virgule doit être échappée en <code>\,</code>.
  4. Assemble the input side拼装输入侧入力側を組み立てる입력 측 조립Assembler le côté entréeMulti-input tools supply their own <code>inputArguments</code>; single-input tools use the default <code>["-i", path]</code>.多输入工具提供自己的 <code>inputArguments</code>，单输入工具用默认的 <code>["-i", path]</code>。複数入力のツールは自前の <code>inputArguments</code> を渡し、単入力のツールは既定の <code>["-i", path]</code> を使います。다중 입력 도구는 자체 <code>inputArguments</code>를 제공하고, 단일 입력 도구는 기본값 <code>["-i", path]</code>를 씁니다.Les outils à entrées multiples fournissent leur propre <code>inputArguments</code> ; les outils à entrée unique utilisent la valeur par défaut <code>["-i", path]</code>.
  5. Run and parse执行并解析実行して解析する실행 및 파싱Exécuter et analyser<code>-progress pipe:1</code> sends progress to stdout, keeping it separate from the logs on stderr.<code>-progress pipe:1</code> 让进度走 stdout，与日志（stderr）分离。<code>-progress pipe:1</code> で進捗を stdout に流し、ログ（stderr）と分離します。<code>-progress pipe:1</code>은 진행 상황을 stdout으로 보내 로그(stderr)와 분리합니다.<code>-progress pipe:1</code> fait passer la progression par stdout, séparée du journal (stderr).

Mistakes we hit踩过的坑踏んだ落とし穴밟은 함정Pièges rencontrés

Concatenated output is only half as long拼接后时长只有一半結合後の再生時間が半分になる이어 붙인 뒤 길이가 절반만 나옴Après concaténation, la durée n'était que de la moitié

Cause: 原因：原因：원인:Cause : The helper added <code>-i input</code> unconditionally, while concat uses <code>-f concat -i list.txt</code>, so the list became a second input and what actually got decoded was the list file itself.辅助函数无条件添加 <code>-i input</code>，而拼接用的是 <code>-f concat -i list.txt</code>，于是列表成了第二个输入，实际解码的是列表文件本身。ヘルパー関数が無条件に <code>-i input</code> を足していた一方、結合は <code>-f concat -i list.txt</code> を使うため、リストが 2 番目の入力になり、実際にデコードされていたのはリストファイル自体でした。헬퍼 함수가 <code>-i input</code>을 무조건 붙였는데 이어 붙이기는 <code>-f concat -i list.txt</code>를 쓰기 때문에, 목록이 두 번째 입력이 되어 실제로는 목록 파일 자체를 디코딩했습니다.La fonction auxiliaire ajoutait <code>-i input</code> sans condition, alors que la concaténation utilise <code>-f concat -i list.txt</code> : la liste devenait une seconde entrée, et c'est le fichier de liste lui-même qui était décodé.

Fix: 解决：解決：해결:Solution : Tools now supply the complete input prefix via <code>inputArguments</code>, and the helper no longer adds one.让工具提供完整的输入前缀 <code>inputArguments</code>，辅助函数不再自行添加。ツールが完全な入力プレフィックス <code>inputArguments</code> を渡すようにし、ヘルパー関数は自分で足さないようにしました。도구가 입력 접두사 전체를 <code>inputArguments</code>로 제공하고, 헬퍼 함수는 더 이상 스스로 붙이지 않습니다.L'outil fournit désormais le préfixe d'entrée complet <code>inputArguments</code>, et la fonction auxiliaire n'ajoute plus rien.

Screenshot fails with 'Requested output format png is not known'截图报错 'Requested output format png is not known'スクリーンショットで 'Requested output format png is not known' エラー스크린샷에서 'Requested output format png is not known' 오류La capture d'écran échouait avec « Requested output format png is not known »

Cause: 原因：原因：원인:Cause : The code forced <code>-f png</code> on image output too, but PNG is an encoder name, not a muxer name.代码对图片输出也强制加了 <code>-f png</code>，但 PNG 是编码器名不是封装器名。画像出力にも <code>-f png</code> を強制していましたが、PNG はエンコーダ名であってマルチプレクサ名ではありません。이미지 출력에도 <code>-f png</code>를 강제로 붙였는데, PNG는 인코더 이름이지 먹서 이름이 아닙니다.Le code imposait <code>-f png</code> même pour une sortie image, or PNG est un nom d'encodeur, pas de muxeur.

Fix: 解决：解決：해결:Solution : <code>formatHint</code> returns nil for image extensions, letting ffmpeg pick the image2 muxer from the extension.<code>formatHint</code> 对图片类扩展名返回 nil，让 ffmpeg 按扩展名自动选 image2 封装器。<code>formatHint</code> は画像系拡張子に対して nil を返し、ffmpeg に拡張子から image2 マルチプレクサを自動選択させます。<code>formatHint</code>가 이미지 계열 확장자에 대해서는 nil을 반환해, ffmpeg가 확장자에 따라 image2 먹서를 자동으로 고르게 합니다.<code>formatHint</code> renvoie nil pour les extensions d'image, ce qui laisse ffmpeg choisir tout seul le muxeur image2 d'après l'extension.

Watermark fails with 'No such filter: drawtext'水印报错 'No such filter: drawtext'ウォーターマークで 'No such filter: drawtext' エラー워터마크에서 'No such filter: drawtext' 오류Le filigrane échouait avec « No such filter: drawtext »

Cause: 原因：原因：원인:Cause : The bundled ffmpeg wasn't built with libfreetype.本机 ffmpeg 未编译 libfreetype。手元の ffmpeg が libfreetype を組んでいません。이 환경의 ffmpeg에는 libfreetype이 컴파일되어 있지 않습니다.Le ffmpeg de la machine n'a pas été compilé avec libfreetype.

Fix: 解决：解決：해결:Solution : Render the text to a PNG with CoreText, then composite with overlay.改用 CoreText 渲染文字为 PNG，再用 overlay 合成。CoreText でテキストを PNG に描画し、overlay で合成する方式に変更しました。CoreText로 텍스트를 PNG로 렌더링한 뒤 overlay로 합성하도록 바꿨습니다.On rend le texte en PNG avec CoreText, puis on le compose via overlay.

Hardware screenshot fails with 'Option hwaccel cannot be applied to output url'硬件截图报错 'Option hwaccel cannot be applied to output url'ハードウェアスクリーンショットで 'Option hwaccel cannot be applied to output url' エラー하드웨어 스크린샷에서 'Option hwaccel cannot be applied to output url' 오류La capture matérielle échouait avec « Option hwaccel cannot be applied to output url »

Cause: 原因：原因：원인:Cause : <code>-hwaccel</code> is an input option and had been placed in the output arguments.<code>-hwaccel</code> 是输入选项，被放到了输出参数里。<code>-hwaccel</code> は入力オプションなのに、出力パラメータ側に置かれていました。<code>-hwaccel</code>은 입력 옵션인데 출력 파라미터에 들어가 있었습니다.<code>-hwaccel</code> est une option d'entrée, mais elle avait été placée dans les arguments de sortie.

Fix: 解决：解決：해결:Solution : Fold it into <code>inputArguments</code>, before <code>-i</code>.把它并入 <code>inputArguments</code>，放在 <code>-i</code> 之前。<code>inputArguments</code> に含め、<code>-i</code> より前に置きます。이를 <code>inputArguments</code>에 합쳐 <code>-i</code> 앞에 두었습니다.On l'a intégrée à <code>inputArguments</code>, avant <code>-i</code>.

import Foundation

/// Codec presets and the ffmpeg argument fragments they imply.
enum VideoCodec: String, CaseIterable, Identifiable, Sendable {
    case h264, hevc, vp9, av1, prores, gif

    var id: String { rawValue }

    var label: String {
        switch self {
        case .h264: return "H.264 / AVC"
        case .hevc: return "H.265 / HEVC"
        case .vp9: return "VP9"
        case .av1: return "AV1"
        case .prores: return "Apple ProRes"
        case .gif: return "GIF"
        }
    }

    /// Short label for pickers.
    var detail: String {
        switch self {
        case .h264: return L("enum.codec.h264")
        case .hevc: return L("enum.codec.h264.2")
        case .vp9: return L("enum.codec.h264.3")
        case .av1: return L("enum.codec.h264.4")
        case .prores: return L("enum.codec.h264.5")
        case .gif: return L("enum.codec.h264.6")
        }
    }

    /// One-line summary shown under the picker.
    var summary: String {
        switch self {
        case .h264:
            return L("enum.codec.h264.7")
        case .hevc:
            return L("enum.codec.h264.8")
        case .vp9:
            return L("enum.codec.h264.9")
        case .av1:
            return L("enum.codec.h264.10")
        case .prores:
            return L("enum.codec.h264.11")
        case .gif:
            return L("enum.codec.h264.12")
        }
    }

    /// Bullet list of trade-offs, rendered in the parameter panel.
    var characteristics: [(String, String)] {
        switch self {
        case .h264:
            return [(L("enum.codec.h264.13"), L("enum.codec.h264.14")), (L("enum.codec.h264.15"), L("enum.codec.h264.16")), (L("enum.codec.h264.17"), L("enum.codec.h264.18")), (L("enum.codec.h264.19"), L("enum.codec.h264.20"))]
        case .hevc:
            return [(L("enum.codec.h264.13"), L("enum.codec.h264.21")), (L("enum.codec.h264.15"), L("enum.codec.h264.22")), (L("enum.codec.h264.17"), L("enum.codec.h264.16")), (L("enum.codec.h264.19"), L("enum.codec.h264.23"))]
        case .vp9:
            return [(L("enum.codec.h264.13"), L("enum.codec.h264.24")), (L("enum.codec.h264.15"), L("enum.codec.h264.25")), (L("enum.codec.h264.17"), L("enum.codec.h264.26")), (L("enum.codec.h264.19"), L("enum.codec.h264.27"))]
        case .av1:
            return [(L("enum.codec.h264.13"), L("enum.codec.h264.28")), (L("enum.codec.h264.15"), L("enum.codec.h264.29")), (L("enum.codec.h264.17"), L("enum.codec.h264.30")), (L("enum.codec.h264.19"), L("enum.codec.h264.31"))]
        case .prores:
            return [(L("enum.codec.h264.13"), L("enum.codec.h264.32")), (L("enum.codec.h264.15"), L("enum.codec.h264.33")), (L("enum.codec.h264.17"), L("enum.codec.h264.34")), (L("enum.codec.h264.19"), L("enum.codec.h264.35"))]
        case .gif:
            return [(L("enum.codec.h264.13"), L("enum.codec.h264.14")), (L("enum.codec.h264.15"), L("enum.codec.h264.36")), (L("enum.codec.h264.17"), L("enum.codec.h264.16")), (L("enum.codec.h264.19"), L("enum.codec.h264.37"))]
        }
    }

    /// Software encoder.
    var softwareEncoder: String {
        switch self {
        case .h264: return "libx264"
        case .hevc: return "libx265"
        case .vp9: return "libvpx-vp9"
        case .av1: return "libsvtav1"
        case .prores: return "prores_ks"
        case .gif: return "gif"
        }
    }

    /// Hardware encoder when available on Apple silicon.
    var hardwareEncoder: String? {
        switch self {
        case .h264: return "h264_videotoolbox"
        case .hevc: return "hevc_videotoolbox"
        case .prores: return "prores_videotoolbox"
        default: return nil
        }
    }

    var isCRFCapable: Bool {
        switch self {
        case .h264, .hevc, .vp9, .av1: return true
        default: return false
        }
    }

    /// Sensible CRF window per codec.
    var crfRange: ClosedRange<Double> {
        switch self {
        case .h264: return 0...51
        case .hevc: return 0...51
        case .vp9: return 0...63
        case .av1: return 0...63
        default: return 0...51
        }
    }

    var defaultCRF: Double {
        switch self {
        case .h264: return 23
        case .hevc: return 26
        case .vp9: return 32
        case .av1: return 30
        default: return 23
        }
    }

    /// Default container extension for this codec.
    var preferredExtension: String {
        switch self {
        case .h264, .hevc: return "mp4"
        case .vp9, .av1: return "webm"
        case .prores: return "mov"
        case .gif: return "gif"
        }
    }
}

/// Audio codec presets.

    case aac, mp3, opus, flac, alac, pcm, copy, none

    var id: String { rawValue }

    var label: String {
        switch self {
        case .aac: return "AAC"
        case .mp3: return "MP3"
        case .opus: return "Opus"
        case .flac: return L("enum.audio.aac")
        case .alac: return L("enum.audio.aac.2")
        case .pcm: return L("enum.audio.aac.3")
        case .copy: return L("enum.audio.aac.4")
        case .none: return L("enum.audio.aac.5")
        }
    }

    /// One-line explanation of the format.
    var summary: String {
        switch self {
        case .aac: return L("enum.audio.aac.6")
        case .mp3: return L("enum.audio.aac.7")
        case .opus: return L("enum.audio.aac.8")
        case .flac: return L("enum.audio.aac.9")
        case .alac: return L("enum.audio.aac.10")
        case .pcm: return L("enum.audio.aac.11")
        case .copy: return L("enum.audio.aac.12")
        case .none: return L("enum.audio.aac.13")
        }
    }

    var encoder: String? {
        switch self {
        case .aac: return "aac"
        case .mp3: return "libmp3lame"
        case .opus: return "libopus"
        case .flac: return "flac"
        case .alac: return "alac"
        case .pcm: return "pcm_s16le"
        case .copy: return "copy"
        case .none: return nil
        }
    }

    var preferredExtension: String {
        switch self {
        case .aac: return "m4a"
        case .mp3: return "mp3"
        case .opus: return "opus"
        case .flac: return "flac"
        case .alac: return "m4a"
        case .pcm: return "wav"
        case .copy, .none: return "m4a"
        }
    }
}

/// Scale presets shared by the video tools.
enum ScalePreset: String, CaseIterable, Identifiable, Sendable {
    case original, p2160, p1440, p1080, p720, p480, p360, custom

    var id: String { rawValue }

    var label: String {
        switch self {
        case .original: return L("enum.scale.original")
        case .p2160: return "4K (2160p)"
        case .p1440: return "2K (1440p)"
        case .p1080: return "1080p"
        case .p720: return "720p"
        case .p480: return "480p"
        case .p360: return "360p"
        case .custom: return L("enum.scale.original.2")
        }
    }

    /// Target height, or nil to keep the source height.
    var height: Int? {
        switch self {
        case .p2160: return 2160
        case .p1440: return 1440
        case .p1080: return 1080
        case .p720: return 720
        case .p480: return 480
        case .p360: return 360
        case .original, .custom: return nil
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - ffmpeg driver

enum FFmpeg {

    static var available: Bool { ProcessRunner.exists("ffmpeg") && ProcessRunner.exists("ffprobe") }

    /// Base flags applied to every invocation: quiet, non-interactive, overwrite.
    static var baseFlags: [String] {
        ["-hide_banner", "-nostdin", "-y", "-loglevel", "error", "-stats_period", "0.3"]
    }

    /// Build the video-encoding fragment for a codec/quality combination.
    static func videoArgs(
        codec: VideoCodec,
        quality: Double,
        hardware: Bool,
        preset: String? = nil,
        targetBitrateKbps: Int? = nil
    ) -> [String] {
        var args: [String] = []

        // GIF is handled by a dedicated palette pipeline elsewhere.
        if codec == .gif {
            return ["-c:v", "gif"]
        }

        let useHardware = hardware && codec.hardwareEncoder != nil
        let encoder = useHardware ? codec.hardwareEncoder! : codec.softwareEncoder
        args += ["-c:v", encoder]

        if useHardware {
            // VideoToolbox ignores CRF; drive it with an explicit bitrate that
            // tracks the requested quality (lower CRF => higher bitrate).
            if let targetBitrateKbps {
                args += ["-b:v", "\(targetBitrateKbps)k", "-maxrate", "\(Int(Double(targetBitrateKbps) * 1.5))k",
                         "-bufsize", "\(targetBitrateKbps * 2)k"]
            } else {
                // Map CRF onto VideoToolbox's 0-100 quality scale (higher = better).
                let range = codec.crfRange
                let normalised = 1 - (quality - range.lowerBound) / max(range.upperBound - range.lowerBound, 1)
                let q = Int((normalised * 80) + 15)
                args += ["-q:v", "\(min(max(q, 1), 100))"]
            }
            args += ["-allow_sw", "1"]
            return args
        }

        switch codec {
        case .h264:
            args += ["-crf", fmt(quality)]
            args += ["-preset", preset ?? "medium"]
            args += ["-pix_fmt", "yuv420p"]
        case .hevc:
            args += ["-crf", fmt(quality)]
            args += ["-preset", preset ?? "medium"]
            args += ["-pix_fmt", "yuv420p"]
            // Make HEVC playable in QuickTime.
            args += ["-tag:v", "hvc1"]
        case .vp9:
            // VP9 needs a bitrate ceiling alongside CRF to converge quickly.
            args += ["-crf", fmt(quality), "-b:v", "0"]
            args += ["-row-mt", "1", "-cpu-used", preset ?? "2"]
        case .av1:
            args += ["-crf", fmt(quality)]
            args += ["-preset", preset ?? "6"]
        case .prores:
            // ProRes profiles are chosen by number rather than CRF.
            args += ["-profile:v", "3"]
        case .gif:
            break
        }
        return args
    }

    static func audioArgs(codec: AudioCodec, bitrateKbps: Int = 192) -> [String] {
        guard let encoder = codec.encoder else { return ["-an"] }
        if encoder == "copy" { return ["-c:a", "copy"] }
        var args = ["-c:a", encoder]
        switch codec {
        case .aac, .mp3, .opus:
            args += ["-b:a", "\(bitrateKbps)k"]
        case .alac:
            args += ["-b:a", "\(max(bitrateKbps, 256))k"]
        default:
            break
        }
        return args
    }

    /// Resize fragment. `-2` keeps the value even, which most encoders require.
    static func scaleArgs(width: Int?, height: Int?, mode: String = "fit") -> [String] {
        guard width != nil || height != nil else { return [] }
        let w = width.map { "\($0)" } ?? "-2"
        let h = height.map { "\($0)" } ?? "-2"

        switch mode {
        case "fill":
            // Scale up to cover then crop to the exact box.
            let wExpr = width.map { "\($0)" } ?? "iw"
            let hExpr = height.map { "\($0)" } ?? "ih"
            return ["-vf", "scale=\(wExpr):\(hExpr):force_original_aspect_ratio=increase,crop=\(wExpr):\(hExpr)"]
        case "stretch":
            return ["-vf", "scale=\(w):\(h)"]
        default:
            return ["-vf", "scale=\(w):\(h):force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease"]
        }
    }

    /// Parse an ffmpeg `-progress pipe:1` stream, reporting fractional progress.
    /// `out_time_us` is microseconds; we fall back to `out_time_ms`.
    static func progressHandler(
        duration: Double,
        reporter: ProgressReporter,
        logger: JobLogger = .silent
    ) -> @Sendable (String) -> Void {
        guard duration > 0 else {
            return { line in
                if line.hasPrefix("frame=") { reporter.note(L("ui.encoding_line_dropfirst_6", line.dropFirst(6))) }
            }
        }
        // Only log progress every ~5% so the log stays readable.
        let tracker = ProgressLogTracker(duration: duration, logger: logger)
        return { line in
            let parts = line.split(separator: "=", maxSplits: 1)
            guard parts.count == 2 else { return }
            let key = String(parts[0]), value = String(parts[1])
            switch key {
            case "out_time_us", "out_time_ms":
                guard let raw = Double(value) else { return }
                let seconds = raw / 1_000_000
                reporter.report(seconds / duration)
                tracker.record(seconds: seconds, speed: nil)
            case "speed":
                reporter.note(L("ui.speed_value", value))
                tracker.record(seconds: nil, speed: value)
            default:
                break
            }
        }
    }

    /// Run ffmpeg with live progress. Returns the produced output URL.
    @discardableResult
    static func execute(
        context: ToolContext,
        arguments: [String],
        duration: Double,
        output: URL,
        extraInputs: [String] = []
    ) async throws -> URL {
        guard available else { throw ProcessError.missingTool("ffmpeg") }

        try FileManager.default.createDirectory(
            at: output.deletingLastPathComponent(), withIntermediateDirectories: true)

        var args = baseFlags
        args += ["-progress", "pipe:1", "-nostats"]
        args += arguments

        context.logger.commandLines("ffmpeg", args)
        context.logger.info(L("ui.output_output_path", output.path))

        // Stream meaningful stderr into the log as it arrives so the user can
        // watch what ffmpeg is actually doing.
        let stderrSink: @Sendable (String) -> Void = { line in
            let trimmed = line.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces)
            guard !trimmed.isEmpty else { return }
            context.logger.output(trimmed)
        }

        let handler = progressHandler(duration: duration, reporter: context.progress,
                                      logger: context.logger)
        let result = try await ProcessRunner.run(
            "ffmpeg", args, handle: context.handle,
            onStdout: handler, onStderr: stderrSink)

        if result.cancelled { throw ProcessError.cancelled }
        guard result.exitCode == 0 else {
            context.logger.error(L("ui.ffmpeg_exited_with_code_result_exitcode", result.exitCode))
            throw ProcessError.failed(code: result.exitCode, message: result.stderr)
        }
        guard FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: output.path) else {
            throw ProcessError.failed(code: 0, message: L("ui.the_output_file_was_not_created"))
        }
        context.progress.report(1)
        return output
    }

    /// Escape a path for use inside a filtergraph option value.
    static func escapeFilterPath(_ path: String) -> String {
        path
            .replacingOccurrences(of: "\\", with: "\\\\")
            .replacingOccurrences(of: ":", with: "\\:")
            .replacingOccurrences(of: "'", with: "\\'")
            .replacingOccurrences(of: "[", with: "\\[")
            .replacingOccurrences(of: "]", with: "\\]")
            .replacingOccurrences(of: ",", with: "\\,")
            .replacingOccurrences(of: ";", with: "\\;")
    }

    /// Escape text for `drawtext`.
    static func escapeDrawText(_ text: String) -> String {
        text
            .replacingOccurrences(of: "\\", with: "\\\\")
            .replacingOccurrences(of: ":", with: "\\:")
            .replacingOccurrences(of: "'", with: "\u{2019}")
            .replacingOccurrences(of: "%", with: "\\%")
    }

    private static func fmt(_ value: Double) -> String {
        value == value.rounded() ? String(Int(value)) : String(format: "%.2f", value)
    }
}

/// Emits a log line every ~5% of progress, carrying the current speed.
private final class ProgressLogTracker: @unchecked Sendable {
    private let lock = NSLock()
    private let duration: Double
    private let logger: JobLogger
    private var lastBucket = -1
    private var latestSpeed: String?

    init(duration: Double, logger: JobLogger) {
        self.duration = duration
        self.logger = logger
    }

    func record(seconds: Double?, speed: String?) {
        lock.lock()
        if let speed { latestSpeed = speed }
        guard let seconds, duration > 0 else { lock.unlock(); return }
        let fraction = min(max(seconds / duration, 0), 1)
        let bucket = Int(fraction * 20)
        guard bucket > lastBucket else { lock.unlock(); return }
        lastBucket = bucket
        let speedText = latestSpeed.map { L("ui.0", $0) } ?? ""
        lock.unlock()
        logger.info(String(format: L("ui.progress_d_processed"),
                           bucket * 5,
                           Format.duration(seconds),
                           speedText))
    }
}

Core/MediaProbe.swift205 lines行行줄lignes
import Foundation

/// What a file actually is.
///
/// This cannot be inferred from ffprobe streams alone: a JPEG is reported as a
/// single-frame `mjpeg` *video* stream, so a naive `videoCodec != nil` test
/// would show duration, frame rate and bitrate for a still image. The file
/// extension is the reliable signal, so it drives the classification.
enum MediaKind: String, Sendable {
    case video, audio, image, document, unknown

    var label: String {
        switch self {
        case .video: return L("ui.video")
        case .audio: return L("ui.audio")
        case .image: return L("ui.image")
        case .document: return L("enum.mediakind.video")
        case .unknown: return L("ui.file")
        }
    }
}

/// Metadata extracted by `ffprobe`, used to drive smart defaults.
struct MediaInfo: Sendable, Equatable {
    /// The real nature of the file, decided by extension.
    var kind: MediaKind = .unknown
    var duration: Double = 0
    var width: Int = 0
    var height: Int = 0
    var frameRate: Double = 0
    var videoCodec: String?
    var audioCodec: String?
    var bitRate: Int64 = 0
    var sampleRate: Int = 0
    var channelCount: Int = 0
    var rotation: Int = 0
    var frameCount: Int = 0
    var pixelFormat: String?
    var containerFormat: String = ""

    /// A still image is never presented as a video, even though ffprobe
    /// reports it as a one-frame video stream.
    var hasVideo: Bool { kind == .video }
    /// Audio-only files and images both hide the video track details.
    var hasAudio: Bool { audioCodec != nil && kind != .image }
    var hasImage: Bool { kind == .image }
    /// True when the duration/frame-rate/bitrate rows are meaningful.
    var hasTimeline: Bool { kind == .video || kind == .audio }
    var aspect: Double { height > 0 ? Double(width) / Double(height) : 16.0 / 9.0 }
    var resolution: String { width > 0 ? "\(width)×\(height)" : "—" }
}

/// Cached ffprobe front-end. Probes are cheap but repeated often while the
/// user drags sliders, so results are memoised by path + modification date.
enum MediaProbe {
    private struct Key: Hashable {
        let path: String
        let modified: Date?
    }

    private static var cache: [Key: MediaInfo] = [:]
    private static let lock = NSLock()

    static func info(for url: URL) async -> MediaInfo? {
        let attrs = try? FileManager.default.attributesOfItem(atPath: url.path)
        let key = Key(path: url.path, modified: attrs?[.modificationDate] as? Date)

        if let hit = cached(key) { return hit }

        guard let info = await probe(url) else { return nil }
        store(info, for: key)
        return info
    }

    static func invalidate() {
        lock.lock()
        cache.removeAll()
        lock.unlock()
    }

    // Synchronous helpers keep the lock strictly inside a non-async scope.
    private static func cached(_ key: Key) -> MediaInfo? {
        lock.lock()
        defer { lock.unlock() }
        return cache[key]
    }

    private static func store(_ info: MediaInfo, for key: Key) {
        lock.lock()
        cache[key] = info
        lock.unlock()
    }

    private static func probe(_ url: URL) async -> MediaInfo? {
        let args = [
            "-v", "error",
            "-print_format", "json",
            "-show_format",
            "-show_streams",
            url.path,
        ]
        guard let json = try? await ProcessRunner.capture("ffprobe", args),
              let data = json.data(using: .utf8),
              let root = try? JSONSerialization.jsonObject(with: data) as? [String: Any]
        else { return nil }

        var info = MediaInfo()
        info.kind = Self.kind(for: url)

        if let format = root["format"] as? [String: Any] {
            info.duration = (format["duration"] as? String).flatMap(Double.init) ?? 0
            info.bitRate = (format["bit_rate"] as? String).flatMap(Int64.init) ?? 0
            info.containerFormat = (format["format_name"] as? String) ?? ""
        }

        let streams = root["streams"] as? [[String: Any]] ?? []
        for stream in streams {
            let type = stream["codec_type"] as? String
            switch type {
            case "video":
                if info.videoCodec == nil {
                    info.videoCodec = stream["codec_name"] as? String
                    info.width = stream["width"] as? Int ?? 0
                    info.height = stream["height"] as? Int ?? 0
                    info.pixelFormat = stream["pix_fmt"] as? String
                    info.frameRate = parseRate(stream["avg_frame_rate"] as? String)
                        ?? parseRate(stream["r_frame_rate"] as? String) ?? 0
                    info.frameCount = (stream["nb_frames"] as? String).flatMap(Int.init) ?? 0
                    info.rotation = rotation(from: stream)
                }
            case "audio":
                if info.audioCodec == nil {
                    info.audioCodec = stream["codec_name"] as? String
                    info.sampleRate = (stream["sample_rate"] as? String).flatMap(Int.init) ?? 0
                    info.channelCount = stream["channels"] as? Int ?? 0
                }
            default:
                break
            }
        }

        if info.duration == 0, info.frameRate > 0, info.frameCount > 0 {
            info.duration = Double(info.frameCount) / info.frameRate
        }

        // For ambiguous containers, fall back to what the streams actually hold.
        if info.kind == .unknown {
            if info.videoCodec != nil && info.audioCodec != nil {
                info.kind = .video
            } else if info.videoCodec != nil {
                // A lone video stream with no duration is a still image.
                info.kind = info.duration > 0 ? .video : .image
            } else if info.audioCodec != nil {
                info.kind = .audio
            }
        }
        return info
    }

    /// Decide the file kind from its extension. Containers that can hold
    /// either audio or video (mp4, mkv, mov) are resolved by stream presence.
    static func kind(for url: URL) -> MediaKind {
        let ext = url.pathExtension.lowercased()
        if ext.isImageExtension { return .image }
        if ext.isAudioExtension { return .audio }
        if ext.isVideoExtension { return .video }
        if ext.isDocumentExtension { return .document }
        // Ambiguous containers: let the caller's stream probe decide.
        return .unknown
    }

    private static func parseRate(_ value: String?) -> Double? {
        guard let value, !value.isEmpty else { return nil }
        if value.contains("/") {
            let parts = value.split(separator: "/")
            guard parts.count == 2,
                  let num = Double(parts[0]), let den = Double(parts[1]), den != 0
            else { return nil }
            return num / den
        }
        return Double(value)
    }

    /// Rotation may live in `tags.rotate` or in the display matrix side data.
    private static func rotation(from stream: [String: Any]) -> Int {
        if let tags = stream["tags"] as? [String: Any],
           let raw = tags["rotate"] as? String, let value = Int(raw) {
            return ((value % 360) + 360) % 360
        }
        if let side = stream["side_data_list"] as? [[String: Any]] {
            for entry in side {
                if let r = entry["rotation"] as? Double {
                    return ((Int(r) % 360) + 360) % 360
                }
            }
        }
        return 0
    }

    /// Fast duration-only lookup for tools that just need a progress denominator.
    static func duration(_ url: URL) async -> Double {
        await info(for: url)?.duration ?? 0
    }
}

A GIF encoder built from scratch自研 GIF 编码器自前の GIF エンコーダ자체 제작 GIF 인코더Un encodeur GIF écrit maison

macOS ImageIO can read GIF but not write it, so the entire output path is hand-rolled: median-cut color quantization, LZW compression, Bayer dithering, and per-frame transition compositing.macOS 的 ImageIO 只能读不能写 GIF，所以输出完全自己实现：中位切分色彩量化、LZW 压缩、Bayer 抖动、逐帧转场合成。macOS の ImageIO は GIF を読めても書けないため、出力は完全に自前で実装しています：中央値分割による色量子化、LZW 圧縮、Bayer ディザ、フレームごとのトランジション合成。macOS의 ImageIO는 GIF를 읽기만 하고 쓸 수 없어 출력을 완전히 직접 구현했습니다. 중위 분할 색상 양자화, LZW 압축, Bayer 디더링, 프레임별 전환 합성입니다.L'ImageIO de macOS sait lire le GIF mais pas l'écrire : toute la sortie est donc maison — quantification median cut, compression LZW, tramage Bayer et composition des transitions image par image.

The core idea核心思路核心となる考え方핵심 발상L'idée directrice　macOS ImageIO <b>can read GIFs but not write them</b>, so GIF output is implemented entirely by hand: color quantization → index mapping → LZW compression → frame composition. This is the closest the project comes to implementing a file format from scratch.macOS 的 ImageIO <b>只能读 GIF 不能写</b>，所以 GIF 输出完全自己实现：色彩量化 → 索引映射 → LZW 压缩 → 帧合成。这段代码是项目里最接近「从零实现一个文件格式」的部分。macOS の ImageIO は<b>GIF を読めても書けない</b>ため、GIF 出力は完全に自前で実装しています：色量子化 → インデックス写像 → LZW 圧縮 → フレーム合成。このコードは、プロジェクト内で最も「ファイルフォーマットをゼロから実装する」部分に近いものです。macOS의 ImageIO는 <b>GIF를 읽을 수만 있고 쓸 수는 없습니다</b>. 그래서 GIF 출력은 전부 직접 구현했습니다. 색상 양자화 → 인덱스 매핑 → LZW 압축 → 프레임 합성 순서입니다. 이 코드는 프로젝트에서 "파일 포맷을 처음부터 구현하는" 일에 가장 가까운 부분입니다.L'ImageIO de macOS <b>sait lire le GIF mais pas l'écrire</b> : toute la sortie GIF est donc maison — quantification des couleurs → mapping d'index → compression LZW → composition des images. C'est la partie du projet qui ressemble le plus à « implémenter un format de fichier depuis zéro ».

Why it is built this way为什么这样实现なぜそう実装したのか왜 이렇게 구현했는가Pourquoi c'est fait ainsi

Why color quantization is needed为什么需要色彩量化なぜ色量子化が必要か왜 색상 양자화가 필요한가Pourquoi la quantification des couleurs est nécessaire

A GIF frame allows at most 256 colors, while a photo has tens of thousands. The colors have to be collapsed onto a single palette. We use median cut: put every color in one box, split it along its longest axis at the median, and repeat until the number of boxes equals the target color count. Each box contributes its weighted average color as one palette entry.GIF 每帧最多 256 色，而照片有上万种颜色。必须把颜色收敛到一个调色板。用中位切分法：把所有颜色放进一个盒子，沿最长的轴从中位切开，反复直到盒子数等于目标颜色数。每个盒子取加权平均色，就是调色板的一个条目。GIF は 1 フレーム最大 256 色ですが、写真には何万色もあります。色を 1 つのパレットに収束させる必要があります。中央値分割法を使います：全色を 1 つの箱に入れ、最も長い軸に沿って中央値で割り、箱の数が目標色数になるまで繰り返します。各箱の加重平均色がパレットの 1 項目になります。GIF는 프레임당 최대 256색인데 사진에는 수만 가지 색이 있습니다. 색을 하나의 팔레트로 모아야 합니다. 중위 분할법을 씁니다. 모든 색을 하나의 상자에 넣고, 가장 긴 축을 따라 중앙값에서 자르기를, 상자 수가 목표 색 수와 같아질 때까지 반복합니다. 각 상자의 가중 평균색이 팔레트의 한 항목이 됩니다.Une image GIF compte au plus 256 couleurs, quand une photo en aligne des dizaines de milliers. Il faut donc ramener les couleurs à une palette. D'où le median cut : on met toutes les couleurs dans une boîte, on coupe la boîte au niveau de la médiane le long de l'axe le plus long, et on répète jusqu'à obtenir autant de boîtes que de couleurs voulues. La moyenne pondérée de chaque boîte fournit une entrée de la palette.

Why a 15-bit histogram instead of full RGB为什么用 15 位直方图而不是完整 RGBなぜフル RGB ではなく 15 ビットのヒストグラムを使うのか왜 전체 RGB가 아니라 15비트 히스토그램을 쓰는가Pourquoi un histogramme 15 bits plutôt que du RGB complet

The full 24-bit color space has 16 million possible values, which would make the histogram array 64 MB. Truncating each channel to 5 bits (32 levels) gives 32768 buckets using only 128 KB, and the eye can barely tell the difference.完整 24 位颜色空间有 1600 万种可能，直方图数组会占 64 MB。把每个通道截到 5 位（32 级）得到 32768 个桶，只占 128 KB，而肉眼几乎看不出区别。フル 24 ビットの色空間は 1600 万通りあり、ヒストグラム配列だけで 64 MB を占めます。各チャンネルを 5 ビット（32 段階）に落とすと 32768 バケットになり、128 KB しか使いません。しかも肉眼ではほとんど違いが分かりません。전체 24비트 색 공간은 1600만 가지가 가능해 히스토그램 배열만 64 MB를 차지합니다. 각 채널을 5비트(32단계)로 자르면 32768개 버킷이 되어 128 KB만 차지하는데, 눈으로는 차이를 거의 알아채지 못합니다.L'espace complet sur 24 bits compte 16 millions de possibilités : le tableau d'histogramme pèserait 64 Mo. En tronquant chaque canal à 5 bits (32 niveaux), on obtient 32768 seaux pour seulement 128 Ko, sans différence perceptible à l'œil.

Why a lookup table为什么要有查找表なぜルックアップテーブルが要るのか왜 조회 테이블이 있어야 하는가Pourquoi une table de correspondance

Each frame has anywhere from tens of thousands to hundreds of thousands of pixels, and every pixel needs its nearest palette color. Walking 256 palette entries per pixel means 33 million distance computations for a single 480×270 frame. So we precompute a 32768-entry lookup table (15-bit color → palette index), after which each pixel costs one array access.每帧有几万到几十万像素，每个像素都要找最近的调色板颜色。如果每像素都遍历 256 个调色板条目，一张 480×270 的帧就要 3300 万次距离计算。预计算一张 32768 项的查找表（15 位色 → 调色板索引），之后每像素只需一次数组访问。1 フレームには数万〜数十万のピクセルがあり、各ピクセルで最も近いパレット色を探す必要があります。ピクセルごとに 256 個のパレット項目を走査すると、480×270 の 1 フレームで 3300 万回の距離計算になります。32768 項目のルックアップテーブル（15 ビット色 → パレット索引）を事前計算すれば、以降は 1 ピクセルにつき配列アクセス 1 回で済みます。프레임마다 수만에서 수십만 개의 픽셀이 있고, 픽셀마다 가장 가까운 팔레트 색을 찾아야 합니다. 픽셀마다 256개 팔레트 항목을 순회하면 480×270 프레임 한 장에 3300만 번의 거리 계산이 필요합니다. 32768개 항목의 조회 테이블(15비트 색 → 팔레트 인덱스)을 미리 계산해 두면, 그 뒤로는 픽셀당 배열 접근 한 번이면 됩니다.Chaque image compte des dizaines à des centaines de milliers de pixels, et chacun doit trouver la couleur de palette la plus proche. En parcourant les 256 entrées de la palette pour chaque pixel, une seule image de 480×270 demanderait 33 millions de calculs de distance. On précalcule donc une table de 32768 entrées (couleur 15 bits → index de palette) : ensuite, chaque pixel ne coûte qu'un accès tableau.

Why we wrote our own LZW为什么自己写 LZWなぜ LZW を自分で書くのか왜 LZW를 직접 구현하는가Pourquoi écrire LZW soi-même

GIF uses variable-code-length LZW, which is nothing like zip's deflate. The system offers no implementation, and we need precise control over when the code length grows and when the dictionary resets.GIF 用的是可变码长 LZW，与 zip 的 deflate 完全不同。系统没有现成实现，而且需要精确控制码长增长与字典重置时机。GIF が使うのは可変コード長の LZW で、zip の deflate とは全く別物です。システムに既成の実装はなく、しかもコード長の伸長と辞書リセットのタイミングを正確に制御する必要があります。GIF가 쓰는 것은 가변 코드 길이 LZW로, zip의 deflate와 전혀 다릅니다. 시스템에 마땅한 구현이 없고, 코드 길이 증가와 사전 초기화 시점을 정확히 통제해야 합니다.Le GIF utilise un LZW à longueur de code variable, sans rapport avec le deflate du zip. Le système n'en fournit aucune implémentation, et il faut piloter précisément la croissance de la longueur de code et le moment de réinitialiser le dictionnaire.

Why transitions composite pixels by hand为什么转场要自己合成像素なぜトランジションのピクセルを自分で合成するのか왜 전환 효과의 픽셀을 직접 합성하는가Pourquoi les transitions se composent pixel par pixel

ffmpeg's xfade only works on video streams, while turning a set of images into a GIF means controlling duration and transitions frame by frame. Working directly on the RGBA buffer is more flexible: a fade is linear interpolation, a slide is a coordinate offset, a wipe is a per-column test, and a circular reveal is a radius test.ffmpeg 的 xfade 只能处理视频流，而多图转 GIF 需要逐帧控制时长和转场。直接操作 RGBA 缓冲更灵活：淡化就是线性插值，滑动就是坐标偏移，擦除就是逐列判断，圆形展开就是半径判断。ffmpeg の xfade は映像ストリームしか扱えず、複数画像から GIF を作る場合はフレームごとに表示時間とトランジションを制御する必要があります。RGBA バッファを直接操作するほうが柔軟です：フェードは線形補間、スライドは座標オフセット、ワイプは列ごとの判定、円形展開は半径の判定です。ffmpeg의 xfade는 비디오 스트림만 다룰 수 있는데, 여러 이미지를 GIF로 만드는 작업은 프레임마다 길이와 전환을 제어해야 합니다. RGBA 버퍼를 직접 다루는 편이 훨씬 유연합니다. 페이드는 선형 보간, 슬라이드는 좌표 이동, 와이프는 열 단위 판정, 원형 확장은 반지름 판정입니다.Le xfade de ffmpeg ne traite que des flux vidéo, alors que la conversion de plusieurs images en GIF demande de régler la durée et la transition image par image. Manipuler directement un tampon RGBA est plus souple : un fondu est une interpolation linéaire, un glissement un décalage de coordonnées, un balayage un test colonne par colonne, une ouverture circulaire un test de rayon.

Implementation steps实现步骤実装手順구현 단계Étapes d'implémentation

  1. Decode and normalize the canvas解码与画布归一化デコードとキャンバス正規化디코딩과 캔버스 정규화Décodage et normalisation du canevasEach image is rendered onto an RGBA canvas of a single size according to the fit mode (fit / fill / stretch). The canvas size comes from the aspect ratio of the first image.每张图按适配方式（完整显示 / 裁剪填满 / 拉伸）渲染到统一尺寸的 RGBA 画布。尺寸由第一张图的比例决定。各画像をフィット方式（全体表示 / 切り抜き / 引き伸ばし）で統一サイズの RGBA キャンバスに描画します。サイズは最初の画像の比率で決まります。각 이미지를 맞춤 방식(전체 표시 / 잘라서 채우기 / 늘리기)에 따라 통일된 크기의 RGBA 캔버스에 렌더링합니다. 크기는 첫 번째 이미지의 비율로 정해집니다.Chaque image est rendue dans un canevas RGBA de taille unique selon son mode d'ajustement (affichage complet / remplissage par recadrage / étirement). La taille découle du rapport de la première image.
  2. Build transition frames构建转场帧トランジションフレームを構築전환 프레임 생성Construire les images de transitionInsert a number of intermediate frames between each pair of neighbors. A fade is <code>a·(1-t) + b·t</code>; a slide samples source pixels by x coordinate; a circular reveal compares distance from the center.在相邻两帧之间插入若干过渡帧。淡化为 <code>a·(1-t) + b·t</code>；滑动按 x 坐标取源像素；圆形展开比较到中心的距离。隣り合う 2 フレームの間に遷移フレームを挿入します。フェードは <code>a·(1-t) + b·t</code>、スライドは x 座標で元ピクセルを取得、円形展開は中心からの距離を比較します。인접한 두 프레임 사이에 여러 장의 과도 프레임을 삽입합니다. 페이드는 <code>a·(1-t) + b·t</code>, 슬라이드는 x 좌표로 원본 픽셀을 가져오고, 원형 확장은 중심까지의 거리를 비교합니다.On insère plusieurs images de transition entre deux images voisines. Le fondu vaut <code>a·(1-t) + b·t</code> ; le glissement prend le pixel source selon la coordonnée x ; l'ouverture circulaire compare la distance au centre.
  3. Global palette全局调色板グローバルパレット전역 팔레트Palette globaleSample roughly 220,000 pixels evenly across all frames, run median cut once, and you get one palette shared by the whole animation — far smaller than a per-frame palette.从所有帧均匀采样约 22 万个像素，做一次中位切分，得到整段动画共用的调色板——比逐帧调色板体积小得多。全フレームから約 22 万ピクセルを均等にサンプリングし、中央値分割を 1 回行って、アニメーション全体で共有するパレットを得ます——フレームごとのパレットよりはるかにサイズを抑えられます。모든 프레임에서 약 22만 개의 픽셀을 균등하게 샘플링해 중위 분할을 한 번 수행하고, 애니메이션 전체가 공유하는 팔레트를 얻습니다. 프레임마다 팔레트를 두는 것보다 용량이 훨씬 작습니다.On échantillonne régulièrement environ 220 000 pixels sur l'ensemble des images, on effectue un seul median cut, et on obtient une palette commune à toute l'animation — bien plus compacte qu'une palette par image.

Index mapping索引映射インデックス写像인덱스 매핑Mapping d'indexUse the lookup table to map each pixel to a palette index, with optional Bayer dithering to break up banding.用查找表把每个像素映射成调色板索引，配合可选的 Bayer 抖动打散色带。ルックアップテーブルで各ピクセルをパレット索引に写像し、任意で Bayer ディザを併用してバンディングを散らします。조회 테이블로 각 픽셀을 팔레트 인덱스에 매핑하고, 선택적인 Bayer 디더링으로 색 띠를 흩뜨립니다.La table de correspondance convertit chaque pixel en index de palette, avec un tramage Bayer optionnel pour casser les bandes de couleur.

LZW encodingLZW 编码LZW エンコードLZW 인코딩Encodage LZWFollowing the GIF rules: emit the clear code first, then extend the prefix pixel by pixel; the code length increases when the dictionary reaches 2^n and resets at 4096.按 GIF 规则：先输出清除码，然后逐像素扩展前缀，码长在字典增长到 2^n 时提升，到 4096 时重置。GIF の規則に従います：まずクリアコードを出力し、次にピクセルごとにプレフィックスを伸長。コード長は辞書が 2^n に達するたびに上げ、4096 でリセットします。GIF 규칙에 따라 먼저 클리어 코드를 출력한 다음, 픽셀 단위로 접두사를 확장합니다. 코드 길이는 사전이 2^n까지 커질 때 늘어나고, 4096이 되면 초기화됩니다.Selon les règles du GIF : on émet d'abord le code de nettoyage, puis on étend le préfixe pixel par pixel ; la longueur de code augmente quand le dictionnaire atteint 2^n, et le dictionnaire est réinitialisé à 4096.

Write out the 89a structure写出 89a 结构89a 構造を書き出す89a 구조 기록Écrire la structure 89aHeader → logical screen descriptor → global color table → Netscape looping extension → each frame (graphic control extension + image descriptor + LZW data blocks) → trailer.文件头 → 逻辑屏幕描述符 → 全局调色板 → Netscape 循环扩展 → 每帧（图形控制扩展 + 图像描述符 + LZW 数据块）→ 结束符。ファイルヘッダ → 論理画面記述子 → グローバルパレット → Netscape ループ拡張 → 各フレーム（グラフィック制御拡張 + 画像記述子 + LZW データブロック）→ 終端。파일 헤더 → 논리 화면 설명자 → 전역 팔레트 → Netscape 루프 확장 → 프레임마다(그래픽 제어 확장 + 이미지 설명자 + LZW 데이터 블록) → 종료자 순서입니다.En-tête → descripteur d'écran logique → palette globale → extension de bouclage Netscape → chaque image (extension de contrôle graphique + descripteur d'image + blocs de données LZW) → terminateur.

Mistakes we hit踩过的坑踏んだ落とし穴밟은 함정Pièges rencontrés

Visible banding after quantization量化后的图片出现明显色带量子化後の画像に目立つバンディングが出る양자화한 이미지에 뚜렷한 색 띠가 생김Des bandes de couleur bien visibles après quantification

Cause: 原因：原因：원인:Cause : Picking the nearest color outright produces stripes in gradients.直接取最近色，在渐变区域会产生条带。最近色をそのまま取ると、グラデーション領域に縞が出ます。가장 가까운 색을 그대로 고르면 그라데이션 영역에서 줄무늬가 생깁니다.Prendre simplement la couleur la plus proche crée des bandes dans les dégradés.

Fix: 解决：解決：해결:Solution : Add ordered Bayer dithering: before the lookup, nudge each channel by a small offset from a 4×4 matrix so neighboring pixels land on different palette entries, which the eye blends into a smooth gradient.加入 Bayer 有序抖动：在查表前给每个通道叠加一个基于 4×4 矩阵的微小偏移，让相邻像素落到不同调色板条目上，人眼会把它混成平滑过渡。Bayer 秩序ディザを追加：テーブル参照の前に各チャンネルへ 4×4 マトリクスに基づく微小なオフセットを加え、隣接ピクセルを別々のパレット項目に落とします。人間の目がそれを混ぜて滑らかな階調に見せます。Bayer ordered 디더링을 넣었습니다. 조회 전에 각 채널에 4×4 행렬 기반의 아주 작은 오프셋을 더해, 이웃 픽셀이 서로 다른 팔레트 항목에 떨어지게 하면 눈이 이를 부드러운 전환으로 섞어 봅니다.Ajout d'un tramage ordonné de Bayer : avant la recherche dans la table, on ajoute à chaque canal un léger décalage tiré d'une matrice 4×4, si bien que des pixels voisins tombent sur des entrées de palette différentes — l'œil les fond en une transition douce.

Palette color cast调色板偏色パレットが色ずれする팔레트 색 왜곡Palette aux couleurs faussées

Cause: 原因：原因：원인:Cause : The first version averaged the colors in a bucket without weighting by how often each occurred, so a rare color counted as much as a common one.最初用桶内颜色的简单平均，忽略了每个颜色出现的次数，结果罕见色与常见色权重相同。当初は箱内の色の単純平均を使っており、各色の出現回数を無視していたため、希少色と頻出色が同じ重みになっていました。처음에는 버킷 안 색의 단순 평균을 썼는데, 각 색이 나타난 횟수를 무시해서 희귀한 색과 흔한 색이 같은 가중치를 가졌습니다.Au départ on faisait une simple moyenne des couleurs du seau, en ignorant leur fréquence : une couleur rare pesait autant qu'une couleur fréquente.

Fix: 解决：解決：해결:Solution : Switched to a weighted average based on histogram counts.改成按直方图计数加权平均。ヒストグラムのカウントによる加重平均に変更しました。히스토그램 카운트로 가중 평균하도록 바꿨습니다.Passage à une moyenne pondérée par les compteurs de l'histogramme.

Quantization is slow on large images大图量化很慢大きな画像の量子化が遅い큰 이미지의 양자화가 느림La quantification des grandes images était lente

Cause: 原因：原因：원인:Cause : 256 distance computations per pixel.逐像素做 256 次距离计算。ピクセルごとに 256 回の距離計算をしていました。픽셀마다 256번의 거리 계산을 했습니다.256 calculs de distance pour chaque pixel.

Fix: 解决：解決：해결:Solution : Precompute a 32768-entry lookup table, bringing the per-pixel cost down to one array access.预计算 32768 项查找表，把每像素成本降到一次数组访问。32768 項目のルックアップテーブルを事前計算し、1 ピクセルあたりのコストを配列アクセス 1 回に下げました。32768개 항목의 조회 테이블을 미리 계산해 픽셀당 비용을 배열 접근 한 번으로 낮췄습니다.Précalcul d'une table de 32768 entrées, qui ramène le coût par pixel à un simple accès tableau.
