import Foundation
import CoreGraphics

// MARK: - Colour quantisation

/// Median-cut quantiser over a 15-bit RGB histogram. Fast, deterministic and
/// good enough for photographic GIF content.
struct ColorQuantizer {

    struct Palette {
        var red: [UInt8]
        var green: [UInt8]
        var blue: [UInt8]
        var count: Int

        /// Nearest-palette-colour lookup table indexed by 15-bit RGB.
        /// 32768 entries keeps mapping O(1) per pixel.
        func lookupTable() -> [UInt8] {
            var table = [UInt8](repeating: 0, count: 32768)
            for r in 0..<32 {
                for g in 0..<32 {
                    for b in 0..<32 {
                        let index = (r << 10) | (g << 5) | b
                        var best = 0
                        var bestDistance = Int.max
                        // Expand 5-bit to 8-bit for a fair distance metric.
                        let rr = r << 3, gg = g << 3, bb = b << 3
                        for i in 0..<count {
                            let dr = Int(red[i]) - rr
                            let dg = Int(green[i]) - gg
                            let db = Int(blue[i]) - bb
                            let distance = dr * dr + dg * dg + db * db
                            if distance < bestDistance {
                                bestDistance = distance
                                best = i
                            }
                        }
                        table[index] = UInt8(best)
                    }
                }
            }
            return table
        }
    }

    private struct Bucket {
        var bins: [Int]      // indices into the histogram
        var rMin: Int, rMax: Int
        var gMin: Int, gMax: Int
        var bMin: Int, bMax: Int

        var volume: Int {
            (rMax - rMin + 1) * (gMax - gMin + 1) * (bMax - bMin + 1)
        }
    }

    /// Build a palette from sampled RGBA pixels.
    /// - Parameters:
    ///   - pixels: interleaved RGBA8 data.
    ///   - sampleStride: take every Nth pixel; 1 uses all pixels.
    static func quantize(pixels: [UInt8], colorCount: Int, sampleStride: Int = 3) -> Palette {
        var histogram = [Int](repeating: 0, count: 32768)
        let pixelCount = pixels.count / 4
        var index = 0
        while index < pixelCount {
            let offset = index * 4
            let r = Int(pixels[offset]) >> 3
            let g = Int(pixels[offset + 1]) >> 3
            let b = Int(pixels[offset + 2]) >> 3
            histogram[(r << 10) | (g << 5) | b] += 1
            index += max(sampleStride, 1)
        }
        return quantize(histogram: histogram, colorCount: colorCount)
    }

    static func quantize(histogram: [Int], colorCount: Int) -> Palette {
        var populated: [Int] = []
        populated.reserveCapacity(4096)
        for i in 0..<32768 where histogram[i] > 0 { populated.append(i) }

        guard !populated.isEmpty else {
            // Degenerate input: return a black palette.
            return Palette(red: [0], green: [0], blue: [0], count: 1)
        }

        var buckets: [Bucket] = [makeBucket(populated)]

        // Split the widest bucket until we reach the requested colour count.
        while buckets.count < colorCount {
            guard let splitIndex = buckets.indices
                .filter({ buckets[$0].bins.count > 1 })
                .max(by: { buckets[$0].volume * buckets[$0].bins.count
                        < buckets[$1].volume * buckets[$1].bins.count })
            else { break }

            let bucket = buckets[splitIndex]
            let (left, right) = split(bucket, histogram: histogram)
            guard !left.bins.isEmpty, !right.bins.isEmpty else {
                // Cannot split further; mark it exhausted by shrinking the range.
                buckets[splitIndex].rMin = buckets[splitIndex].rMax
                buckets[splitIndex].gMin = buckets[splitIndex].gMax
                buckets[splitIndex].bMin = buckets[splitIndex].bMax
                if buckets.allSatisfy({ $0.bins.count <= 1 }) { break }
                continue
            }
            buckets[splitIndex] = left
            buckets.append(right)
        }

        var reds: [UInt8] = [], greens: [UInt8] = [], blues: [UInt8] = []
        reds.reserveCapacity(buckets.count)
        greens.reserveCapacity(buckets.count)
        blues.reserveCapacity(buckets.count)

        for bucket in buckets {
            var sumR = 0, sumG = 0, sumB = 0, total = 0
            for bin in bucket.bins {
                let weight = histogram[bin]
                sumR += ((bin >> 10) & 31) << 3
                sumG += ((bin >> 5) & 31) << 3
                sumB += (bin & 31) << 3
                total += weight
            }
            guard total > 0 else {
                reds.append(0); greens.append(0); blues.append(0)
                continue
            }
            // Weighted average, weighted by how often each bin occurs.
            var weightR = 0, weightG = 0, weightB = 0
            for bin in bucket.bins {
                let weight = histogram[bin]
                weightR += (((bin >> 10) & 31) << 3) * weight
                weightG += (((bin >> 5) & 31) << 3) * weight
                weightB += ((bin & 31) << 3) * weight
            }
            reds.append(UInt8(min(weightR / total, 255)))
            greens.append(UInt8(min(weightG / total, 255)))
            blues.append(UInt8(min(weightB / total, 255)))
            _ = (sumR, sumG, sumB)
        }

        return Palette(red: reds, green: greens, blue: blues, count: reds.count)
    }

    private static func makeBucket(_ bins: [Int]) -> Bucket {
        var rMin = 31, rMax = 0, gMin = 31, gMax = 0, bMin = 31, bMax = 0
        for bin in bins {
            let r = (bin >> 10) & 31, g = (bin >> 5) & 31, b = bin & 31
            rMin = min(rMin, r); rMax = max(rMax, r)
            gMin = min(gMin, g); gMax = max(gMax, g)
            bMin = min(bMin, b); bMax = max(bMax, b)
        }
        return Bucket(bins: bins, rMin: rMin, rMax: rMax, gMin: gMin, gMax: gMax, bMin: bMin, bMax: bMax)
    }

    private static func split(_ bucket: Bucket, histogram: [Int]) -> (Bucket, Bucket) {
        let rRange = bucket.rMax - bucket.rMin
        let gRange = bucket.gMax - bucket.gMin
        let bRange = bucket.bMax - bucket.bMin

        let axis: Int = (rRange >= gRange && rRange >= bRange) ? 0 : (gRange >= bRange ? 1 : 2)
        let sorted = bucket.bins.sorted { a, b in
            switch axis {
            case 0: return ((a >> 10) & 31) < ((b >> 10) & 31)
            case 1: return ((a >> 5) & 31) < ((b >> 5) & 31)
            default: return (a & 31) < (b & 31)
            }
        }

        // Split at the weighted median so both halves carry similar pixel mass.
        let total = sorted.reduce(0) { $0 + histogram[$1] }
        var running = 0
        var splitPoint = sorted.count / 2
        for (i, bin) in sorted.enumerated() {
            running += histogram[bin]
            if running * 2 >= total { splitPoint = i + 1; break }
        }
        splitPoint = min(max(splitPoint, 1), sorted.count - 1)

        let left = Array(sorted[..<splitPoint])
        let right = Array(sorted[splitPoint...])
        return (makeBucket(left), makeBucket(right))
    }
}

// MARK: - LZW

/// GIF-flavoured LZW with LSB-first bit packing.
final class LzwEncoder {
    private var output: [UInt8] = []
    private var current: UInt32 = 0
    private var bitCount = 0

    func encode(indices: [UInt8], minCodeSize: Int) -> [UInt8] {
        output.removeAll(keepingCapacity: true)
        current = 0
        bitCount = 0

        let clearCode = 1 << minCodeSize
        let endCode = clearCode + 1
        var codeSize = minCodeSize + 1
        var nextCode = endCode + 1

        var dictionary: [Int: Int] = [:]
        dictionary.reserveCapacity(4096)

        write(clearCode, bits: codeSize)

        guard !indices.isEmpty else {
            write(endCode, bits: codeSize)
            flush()
            return output
        }

        var prefix = Int(indices[0])
        for i in 1..<indices.count {
            let pixel = Int(indices[i])
            let key = (prefix << 8) | pixel
            if let code = dictionary[key] {
                prefix = code
            } else {
                write(prefix, bits: codeSize)
                if nextCode < 4096 {
                    dictionary[key] = nextCode
                    nextCode += 1
                    // Grow the code width only after the table crosses a power of two.
                    if nextCode > (1 << codeSize), codeSize < 12 {
                        codeSize += 1
                    }
                } else {
                    write(clearCode, bits: codeSize)
                    dictionary.removeAll(keepingCapacity: true)
                    codeSize = minCodeSize + 1
                    nextCode = endCode + 1
                }
                prefix = pixel
            }
        }

        write(prefix, bits: codeSize)
        write(endCode, bits: codeSize)
        flush()
        return output
    }

    private func write(_ code: Int, bits: Int) {
        current |= UInt32(code) << UInt32(bitCount)
        bitCount += bits
        while bitCount >= 8 {
            output.append(UInt8(current & 0xFF))
            current >>= 8
            bitCount -= 8
        }
    }

    private func flush() {
        if bitCount > 0 {
            output.append(UInt8(current & 0xFF))
            current = 0
            bitCount = 0
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - GIF writer

/// Streaming GIF89a writer with a global colour table.
final class GifWriter {
    private let handle: FileHandle
    private let palette: ColorQuantizer.Palette
    private let lookup: [UInt8]
    private let width: Int
    private let height: Int
    private let minCodeSize: Int
    private let encoder = LzwEncoder()

    init(url: URL, width: Int, height: Int, palette: ColorQuantizer.Palette, loopCount: Int) throws {
        FileManager.default.createFile(atPath: url.path, contents: nil)
        guard let handle = try? FileHandle(forWritingTo: url) else {
            throw ProcessError.failed(code: 0, message: L("ui.could_not_create_the_gif_file"))
        }
        self.handle = handle
        self.palette = palette
        self.width = width
        self.height = height
        self.lookup = palette.lookupTable()

        // GIF requires a minimum code size of at least 2.
        let bits = max(2, Int(ceil(log2(Double(max(palette.count, 2))))))
        self.minCodeSize = bits

        writeHeader(loopCount: loopCount)
    }

    private func writeHeader(loopCount: Int) {
        var bytes: [UInt8] = []
        bytes += Array("GIF89a".utf8)

        // Logical screen descriptor.
        bytes += littleEndian16(width)
        bytes += littleEndian16(height)
        // Global colour table present, colour resolution 8, table size bits.
        let tableSizeBits = minCodeSize - 1
        bytes.append(0xF0 | UInt8(tableSizeBits))
        bytes.append(0)   // background colour index
        bytes.append(0)   // pixel aspect ratio

        // Global colour table, padded to a power of two.
        let tableEntries = 1 << minCodeSize
        for i in 0..<tableEntries {
            if i < palette.count {
                bytes.append(palette.red[i])
                bytes.append(palette.green[i])
                bytes.append(palette.blue[i])
            } else {
                bytes += [0, 0, 0]
            }
        }

        // Netscape looping extension.
        bytes += [0x21, 0xFF, 0x0B]
        bytes += Array("NETSCAPE2.0".utf8)
        bytes += [0x03, 0x01]
        bytes += littleEndian16(loopCount)
        bytes.append(0x00)

        handle.write(Data(bytes))
    }

    /// 4×4 Bayer threshold matrix, normalised to -0.5…0.5.
    private static let bayerMatrix: [Double] = [
        0, 8, 2, 10,
        12, 4, 14, 6,
        3, 11, 1, 9,
        15, 7, 13, 5,
    ].map { Double($0) / 16.0 - 0.5 }

    /// Append one frame. `pixels` is RGBA8 of exactly `width * height`.
    /// When `dither` is set, an ordered Bayer offset is applied before the
    /// palette lookup, which breaks up banding in smooth gradients.
    func addFrame(pixels: [UInt8], delayCentiseconds: Int, disposal: Int = 2,
                  dither: Bool = false) {
        var indices = [UInt8](repeating: 0, count: width * height)
        // 5-bit quantisation step, matching the lookup table's resolution.
        let amplitude = 8.0

        var y = 0
        while y < height {
            var x = 0
            while x < width {
                let index = y * width + x
                let p = index * 4

                var r = Int(pixels[p])
                var g = Int(pixels[p + 1])
                var b = Int(pixels[p + 2])

                if dither {
                    let threshold = Self.bayerMatrix[(y & 3) * 4 + (x & 3)] * amplitude
                    r = Self.clamp(r + Int(threshold))
                    g = Self.clamp(g + Int(threshold))
                    b = Self.clamp(b + Int(threshold))
                }

                indices[index] = lookup[((r >> 3) << 10) | ((g >> 3) << 5) | (b >> 3)]
                x += 1
            }
            y += 1
        }
        addFrame(indices: indices, delayCentiseconds: delayCentiseconds, disposal: disposal)
    }

    private static func clamp(_ value: Int) -> Int { min(max(value, 0), 255) }

    func addFrame(indices: [UInt8], delayCentiseconds: Int, disposal: Int = 2) {
        var bytes: [UInt8] = []

        // Graphic control extension.
        bytes += [0x21, 0xF9, 0x04]
        bytes.append(UInt8((disposal & 0x07) << 2))
        bytes += littleEndian16(max(delayCentiseconds, 1))
        bytes.append(0)   // transparent colour index (unused)
        bytes.append(0)

        // Image descriptor.
        bytes.append(0x2C)
        bytes += littleEndian16(0)
        bytes += littleEndian16(0)
        bytes += littleEndian16(width)
        bytes += littleEndian16(height)
        bytes.append(0)   // no local colour table, not interlaced

        bytes.append(UInt8(minCodeSize))

        // LZW data, split into sub-blocks of at most 255 bytes.
        let compressed = encoder.encode(indices: indices, minCodeSize: minCodeSize)
        var offset = 0
        while offset < compressed.count {
            let chunk = min(255, compressed.count - offset)
            bytes.append(UInt8(chunk))
            bytes.append(contentsOf: compressed[offset..<(offset + chunk)])
            offset += chunk
        }
        bytes.append(0)   // block terminator

        handle.write(Data(bytes))
    }

    func finish() {
        handle.write(Data([0x3B]))
        try? handle.close()
    }

    private func littleEndian16(_ value: Int) -> [UInt8] {
        [UInt8(value & 0xFF), UInt8((value >> 8) & 0xFF)]
    }
}

// MARK: - Pixel canvas

/// Simple RGBA8 canvas used to compose GIF frames and transitions.
struct PixelCanvas {
    let width: Int
    let height: Int
    var pixels: [UInt8]

    init(width: Int, height: Int, background: (UInt8, UInt8, UInt8) = (0, 0, 0)) {
        self.width = max(width, 1)
        self.height = max(height, 1)
        self.pixels = [UInt8](repeating: 0, count: self.width * self.height * 4)
        fill(background)
    }

    mutating func fill(_ color: (UInt8, UInt8, UInt8)) {
        var i = 0
        while i < pixels.count {
            pixels[i] = color.0
            pixels[i + 1] = color.1
            pixels[i + 2] = color.2
            pixels[i + 3] = 255
            i += 4
        }
    }

    /// Render a CGImage into the canvas using the given fit mode.
    static func render(
        image: CGImage, width: Int, height: Int,
        fit: ImageFit, background: (UInt8, UInt8, UInt8)
    ) -> PixelCanvas {
        var canvas = PixelCanvas(width: width, height: height, background: background)
        guard let resized = ImageSupport.resize(
            image, to: CGSize(width: width, height: height),
            fit: fit == .stretch ? .stretch : fit,
            background: CGColor(red: CGFloat(background.0) / 255,
                                green: CGFloat(background.1) / 255,
                                blue: CGFloat(background.2) / 255, alpha: 1)
        ) else { return canvas }

        let colorSpace = CGColorSpaceCreateDeviceRGB()
        canvas.pixels.withUnsafeMutableBytes { buffer in
            guard let base = buffer.baseAddress,
                  let context = CGContext(
                    data: base, width: width, height: height,
                    bitsPerComponent: 8, bytesPerRow: width * 4, space: colorSpace,
                    bitmapInfo: CGImageAlphaInfo.premultipliedLast.rawValue)
            else { return }
            context.interpolationQuality = .high
            context.draw(resized, in: CGRect(x: 0, y: 0, width: width, height: height))
        }
        return canvas
    }

    /// Alpha-blend another canvas over this one. `amount` is 0…1.
    func blended(with other: PixelCanvas, amount: Double) -> PixelCanvas {
        var result = self
        let t = min(max(amount, 0), 1)
        let inverse = 1 - t
        let count = min(pixels.count, other.pixels.count)
        for i in stride(from: 0, to: count, by: 4) {
            result.pixels[i] = UInt8(Double(pixels[i]) * inverse + Double(other.pixels[i]) * t)
            result.pixels[i + 1] = UInt8(Double(pixels[i + 1]) * inverse + Double(other.pixels[i + 1]) * t)
            result.pixels[i + 2] = UInt8(Double(pixels[i + 2]) * inverse + Double(other.pixels[i + 2]) * t)
            result.pixels[i + 3] = 255
        }
        return result
    }

    /// Horizontal slide: `other` enters from the given direction.
    func slid(with other: PixelCanvas, progress: Double, fromLeft: Bool) -> PixelCanvas {
        var result = self
        let offset = Int(Double(width) * min(max(progress, 0), 1))
        for y in 0..<height {
            for x in 0..<width {
                let sourceX = fromLeft ? x + (width - offset) : x - offset
                let index = (y * width + x) * 4
                if sourceX >= 0 && sourceX < width {
                    let sourceIndex = (y * width + sourceX) * 4
                    result.pixels[index] = other.pixels[sourceIndex]
                    result.pixels[index + 1] = other.pixels[sourceIndex + 1]
                    result.pixels[index + 2] = other.pixels[sourceIndex + 2]
                } else {
                    result.pixels[index] = pixels[index]
                    result.pixels[index + 1] = pixels[index + 1]
                    result.pixels[index + 2] = pixels[index + 2]
                }
                result.pixels[index + 3] = 255
            }
        }
        return result
    }

    /// Wipe: `other` is revealed progressively from one edge.
    func wiped(with other: PixelCanvas, progress: Double, fromLeft: Bool) -> PixelCanvas {
        var result = self
        let edge = Int(Double(width) * min(max(progress, 0), 1))
        for y in 0..<height {
            for x in 0..<width {
                let reveal = fromLeft ? x < edge : x >= width - edge
                let index = (y * width + x) * 4
                let source = reveal ? other.pixels : pixels
                result.pixels[index] = source[index]
                result.pixels[index + 1] = source[index + 1]
                result.pixels[index + 2] = source[index + 2]
                result.pixels[index + 3] = 255
            }
        }
        return result
    }

    /// Circular reveal from the centre.
    func circleOpened(with other: PixelCanvas, progress: Double) -> PixelCanvas {
        var result = self
        let centerX = Double(width) / 2, centerY = Double(height) / 2
        let maxRadius = (centerX * centerX + centerY * centerY).squareRoot()
        let radius = maxRadius * min(max(progress, 0), 1)
        let radiusSquared = radius * radius

        for y in 0..<height {
            for x in 0..<width {
                let dx = Double(x) - centerX
                let dy = Double(y) - centerY
                let index = (y * width + x) * 4
                let source = (dx * dx + dy * dy) <= radiusSquared ? other.pixels : pixels
                result.pixels[index] = source[index]
                result.pixels[index + 1] = source[index + 1]
                result.pixels[index + 2] = source[index + 2]
                result.pixels[index + 3] = 255
            }
        }
        return result
    }
}

Two-way Markdown conversion built from scratch自研 Markdown 双向转换自前の Markdown 双方向変換자체 제작 Markdown 양방향 변환Conversion Markdown bidirectionnelle écrite maison

No pandoc dependency. It parses Markdown into rich text one way, and infers Markdown syntax back from font traits the other.不依赖 pandoc。正向解析到富文本，反向从字体特征推断 Markdown 语法。pandoc に依存しません。順方向はリッチテキストへ解析し、逆方向はフォントの特徴から Markdown 構文を推定します。pandoc에 의존하지 않습니다. 정방향은 서식 있는 텍스트로 파싱하고, 역방향은 폰트 특징에서 Markdown 문법을 추론합니다.Sans dépendance à pandoc. Dans un sens, l'analyse produit du texte enrichi ; dans l'autre, la syntaxe Markdown est déduite des caractéristiques de police.

The core idea核心思路核心となる考え方핵심 발상L'idée directrice　We implement Markdown ↔ rich-text conversion ourselves instead of depending on pandoc. Parsing Markdown is comparatively easy; <b>the reverse direction is the hard part</b> — you have to infer Markdown syntax back out of font traits.不依赖 pandoc，自己实现 Markdown 与富文本的双向转换。正向解析相对容易，<b>反向转换才是难点</b>——要从字体特征反推 Markdown 语法。pandoc に依存せず、Markdown とリッチテキストの双方向変換を自前で実装しています。順方向の解析は比較的容易で、<b>逆方向の変換こそが難所</b>です——フォントの特徴から Markdown の構文を逆算しなければなりません。pandoc에 의존하지 않고 Markdown과 서식 있는 텍스트의 양방향 변환을 직접 구현했습니다. 정방향 파싱은 비교적 쉽고, <b>역방향 변환이 진짜 어려운 부분</b>입니다. 폰트 특징에서 Markdown 문법을 거꾸로 추론해야 하기 때문입니다.Plutôt que de dépendre de pandoc, la conversion bidirectionnelle entre Markdown et texte enrichi est écrite maison. L'analyse dans le sens aller est relativement simple ; <b>c'est la conversion inverse qui est délicate</b> — il faut remonter des caractéristiques de police jusqu'à la syntaxe Markdown.

Why it is built this way为什么这样实现なぜそう実装したのか왜 이렇게 구현했는가Pourquoi c'est fait ainsi

Why the Markdown parser is hand-written为什么正向解析要手写なぜ順方向の解析を手書きするのか왜 정방향 파싱을 직접 작성하는가Pourquoi l'analyseur Markdown est écrit à la main

Markdown has no single canonical spec, but the syntax people actually use is small: headings, lists, emphasis, code, links, block quotes, tables. A hand-written parser runs about 400 lines — far lighter than pulling in pandoc (a Haskell binary tens of megabytes in size) — and it gives us exact control over the output styling.Markdown 没有唯一规范，但常用语法很小：标题、列表、强调、代码、链接、引用、表格。手写解析器约 400 行，比引入 pandoc（几十 MB 的 Haskell 二进制）轻得多，而且能精确控制输出样式。Markdown に唯一の仕様はありませんが、実際に使われる構文はわずかです：見出し、リスト、強調、コード、リンク、引用、テーブル。手書きのパーサーは約 400 行で、pandoc（数十 MB の Haskell バイナリ）を導入するよりはるかに軽く、しかも出力スタイルを正確に制御できます。Markdown에는 단일 표준이 없지만 실제로 쓰는 문법은 작습니다. 제목, 목록, 강조, 코드, 링크, 인용, 표 정도입니다. 직접 작성한 파서는 약 400줄로, pandoc(수십 MB의 Haskell 바이너리)을 들여오는 것보다 훨씬 가볍고 출력 스타일도 정확히 통제할 수 있습니다.Markdown n'a pas de spécification unique, mais la syntaxe réellement utilisée reste réduite : titres, listes, emphase, code, liens, citations, tableaux. Un analyseur écrit à la main tient en 400 lignes, bien plus léger que d'embarquer pandoc (un binaire Haskell de plusieurs dizaines de Mo), et il donne un contrôle précis sur le style produit.

Why the reverse direction leans on font traits为什么反向转换靠字体特征なぜ逆方向の変換はフォントの特徴に頼るのか왜 역방향 변환이 폰트 특징에 의존하는가Pourquoi la conversion inverse s'appuie sur les caractéristiques de police

What we get out of Word is an <code>NSAttributedString</code>, which carries no "this is a heading" flag, only font information. So the rules are: a font size clearly larger than the body text → a heading; both the bold and italic traits set → <code>***text***</code>; a monospaced font → backtick code.从 Word 读进来的是 <code>NSAttributedString</code>，里面没有「这是一个标题」的标记，只有字体信息。所以规则是：字号明显大于正文 → 标题；同时有粗体和斜体 trait → <code>***文本***</code>；等宽字体 → 反引号代码。Word から読み込まれるのは <code>NSAttributedString</code> で、そこには「これは見出し」という印がなく、フォント情報しかありません。そこで規則はこうなります：本文より明らかに大きいフォントサイズ → 見出し。太字と斜体の trait が同時に立つ → <code>***テキスト***</code>。等幅フォント → バッククォートのコード。Word에서 읽어 들이는 것은 <code>NSAttributedString</code>이고, 그 안에는 "이것은 제목"이라는 표시가 없고 폰트 정보만 있습니다. 그래서 규칙은 이렇습니다. 글자 크기가 본문보다 뚜렷하게 크면 → 제목, 굵게와 기울임 trait이 동시에 있으면 → <code>***텍스트***</code>, 고정폭 폰트면 → 백틱 코드입니다.Ce qu'on lit depuis Word, c'est un <code>NSAttributedString</code> : aucune marque « ceci est un titre », seulement des informations de police. D'où les règles : une taille nettement supérieure au corps du texte → un titre ; les traits gras et italique à la fois → <code>***texte***</code> ; une police à chasse fixe → du code entre accents graves.

Why a paragraph's textLists have to be handled为什么要处理段落的 textListsなぜ段落の textLists を扱う必要があるのか왜 문단의 textLists를 처리해야 하는가Pourquoi il faut traiter les textLists d'un paragraphe

In rich text a list isn't expressed by a textual prefix — it lives in the <code>textLists</code> of an <code>NSParagraphStyle</code>. Skip that property and you will never detect a list at all.列表在富文本里不是靠文字前缀表示的，而是靠 <code>NSParagraphStyle</code> 里的 <code>textLists</code>。不读这个属性就完全检测不到列表。リッチテキストでは、リストは文字の接頭辞では表現されず、<code>NSParagraphStyle</code> の中の <code>textLists</code> にあります。このプロパティを読まなければ、リストをまったく検出できません。서식 있는 텍스트에서 목록은 텍스트 접두사가 아니라 <code>NSParagraphStyle</code> 안의 <code>textLists</code>로 표현됩니다. 이 속성을 읽지 않으면 목록을 전혀 감지할 수 없습니다.Dans le texte enrichi, une liste ne s'exprime pas par un préfixe textuel : elle vit dans les <code>textLists</code> d'un <code>NSParagraphStyle</code>. Sans lire cette propriété, aucune liste n'est jamais détectée.

Why inline parsing needs a single pass为什么行内解析要单遍扫描なぜインライン解析を 1 回の走査で行うのか왜 인라인 파싱을 한 번만 훑는가Pourquoi l'analyse en ligne se fait en un seul passage

Chaining several regex replacements makes them interfere with each other — after you mark up bold text, the italic regex can match the asterisks you just inserted. A single left-to-right scan that hunts for the matching closing marker as soon as it hits an opening one never processes the same text twice.用多个正则依次替换会互相干扰——比如给粗体加标记后，斜体的正则可能匹配到刚插入的星号。单遍从左到右扫描，遇到标记就找配对的结束标记，不会重复处理。複数の正規表現を順に置換すると互いに干渉します——太字にマークを付けた後、斜体の正規表現が直前に挿入したアスタリスクにマッチしてしまうのです。左から右へ 1 回だけ走査し、開始マーカーを見つけたら対応する終了マーカーを探す方式なら、同じテキストを二度処理しません。정규식을 여러 개 순서대로 적용하면 서로 간섭합니다. 예를 들어 굵게 표시를 붙인 뒤 기울임 정규식이 방금 삽입한 별표를 잡아챌 수 있습니다. 왼쪽에서 오른쪽으로 한 번만 훑으면서 표시를 만나면 짝이 맞는 끝 표시를 찾으면 중복 처리가 생기지 않습니다.Enchaîner plusieurs remplacements par expression régulière les fait interférer : après avoir balisé le gras, la regex de l'italique peut mordre sur les astérisques qu'on vient d'insérer. Un seul balayage de gauche à droite, qui cherche la marque fermante dès qu'il rencontre une marque ouvrante, ne traite jamais deux fois le même texte.

Diagram图示図解도해Schéma

Implementation steps实现步骤実装手順구현 단계Étapes d'implémentation

  1. Classify each line按行分类行ごとに分類する줄 단위 분류Classer chaque ligneGo line by line and decide: blank line, code fence, heading, block quote, bullet list, ordered list, table, or plain paragraph.逐行判断：空行、代码围栏、标题、引用、无序列表、有序列表、表格、普通段落。1 行ずつ判定します：空行、コードフェンス、見出し、引用、箇条書き、番号付きリスト、テーブル、通常の段落。줄마다 판정합니다. 빈 줄, 코드 펜스, 제목, 인용, 글머리 기호 목록, 번호 목록, 표, 일반 문단입니다.On examine les lignes une à une : ligne vide, bloc de code, titre, citation, liste à puces, liste numérotée, tableau ou paragraphe ordinaire.
  2. Handle code fences处理代码围栏コードフェンスを処理する코드 펜스 처리Traiter les blocs de codeOn <code>```</code>, switch into code mode, buffer every line until the next fence, then emit the whole block in a monospaced font on a grey background.遇到 <code>```</code> 进入代码模式，缓冲所有行直到下一个围栏，整块用等宽字体 + 灰底输出。<code>```</code> に遭遇したらコードモードに入り、次のフェンスまで全行をバッファし、ブロック全体を等幅フォント + グレー背景で出力します。<code>```</code>를 만나면 코드 모드로 들어가 다음 펜스까지 모든 줄을 버퍼링하고, 블록 전체를 고정폭 폰트 + 회색 배경으로 출력합니다.Sur <code>```</code>, on passe en mode code, on met toutes les lignes en tampon jusqu'au bloc suivant, puis on émet l'ensemble en chasse fixe sur fond gris.
  3. Parse inline markup解析行内标记インラインマークアップを解析する인라인 표시 파싱Analyser le balisage en ligne<code>inline()</code> scans for backticks, asterisks, underscores, links, and images, producing the matching attributes for each.<code>inline()</code> 扫描反引号、星号、下划线、链接、图片，分别生成对应的属性。<code>inline()</code> がバッククォート、アスタリスク、アンダースコア、リンク、画像を走査し、それぞれに対応する属性を生成します。<code>inline()</code>이 백틱, 별표, 밑줄, 링크, 이미지를 훑어 각각에 맞는 속성을 만듭니다.<code>inline()</code> repère les accents graves, astérisques, soulignés, liens et images, et produit les attributs correspondants.
  4. Merge paragraphs合并段落段落を結合する문단 병합Fusionner les paragraphesJoin consecutive plain lines into one paragraph with spaces — in Markdown a paragraph can span several lines, so emitting line by line gives you broken layout.连续的普通行用空格连接成一个段落——Markdown 里一个段落可以跨多行，直接逐行输出会得到破碎的排版。連続する通常行をスペースで繋いで 1 つの段落にします——Markdown では 1 つの段落が複数行にまたがるため、行ごとに出力するとレイアウトが崩れます。연속된 일반 줄은 공백으로 이어 하나의 문단으로 만듭니다. Markdown에서 한 문단은 여러 줄에 걸칠 수 있는데, 그대로 줄마다 출력하면 조판이 깨집니다.Les lignes ordinaires consécutives sont réunies en un paragraphe par des espaces — en Markdown, un paragraphe peut couvrir plusieurs lignes, et une sortie ligne par ligne donne une mise en page en morceaux.
  5. Reverse: walk the attribute runs反向：遍历属性区段逆方向：属性の区間を走査する역방향: 속성 구간 순회Sens inverse : parcourir les segments d'attributsUse <code>attributes(at:effectiveRange:)</code> to split the text at attribute boundaries, then decide independently which Markdown syntax each run needs.用 <code>attributes(at:effectiveRange:)</code> 按属性变化的边界切分文本，每段独立判断该用什么 Markdown 语法。<code>attributes(at:effectiveRange:)</code> で属性が変わる境界ごとにテキストを分割し、各区間でどの Markdown 構文を使うべきかを個別に判断します。<code>attributes(at:effectiveRange:)</code>로 속성이 바뀌는 경계마다 텍스트를 나누고, 구간마다 어떤 Markdown 문법을 쓸지 따로 판단합니다.<code>attributes(at:effectiveRange:)</code> découpe le texte aux frontières où les attributs changent, puis chaque segment décide seul de la syntaxe Markdown à employer.

Mistakes we hit踩过的坑踏んだ落とし穴밟은 함정Pièges rencontrés

Markdown exported from Word came out as plain text从 Word 转出来的 Markdown 全是纯文本Word から変換した Markdown がすべてプレーンテキストになるWord에서 변환한 Markdown이 전부 순수 텍스트로 나옴Le Markdown exporté depuis Word ressortait en texte brut

Cause: 原因：原因：원인:Cause : We only checked the bold/italic traits and never read the font size, so headings went unrecognized.只检查了粗体/斜体 trait，没有读字号，所以标题识别不出来。太字/斜体の trait しか見ておらず、フォントサイズを読んでいなかったため、見出しを認識できませんでした。굵게/기울임 trait만 확인하고 글자 크기를 읽지 않아 제목을 알아내지 못했습니다.On ne regardait que les traits gras/italique, sans lire la taille de police : les titres passaient inaperçus.

Fix: 解决：解決：해결:Solution : Add font-size thresholds: ≥24pt is <code>#</code>, ≥20pt is <code>##</code>, and so on.加入字号阈值：≥24pt 是 <code>#</code>，≥20pt 是 <code>##</code>，以此类推。フォントサイズのしきい値を追加：24pt 以上は <code>#</code>、20pt 以上は <code>##</code>、以下同様です。글자 크기 임계값을 넣었습니다. 24pt 이상은 <code>#</code>, 20pt 이상은 <code>##</code>, 이런 식입니다.Ajout de seuils de taille : ≥24pt donne <code>#</code>, ≥20pt donne <code>##</code>, et ainsi de suite.

Lists turned into plain paragraphs列表变成了普通段落リストが普通の段落になる목록이 일반 문단이 됨Les listes devenaient des paragraphes ordinaires

Cause: 原因：原因：원인:Cause : We weren't reading <code>NSParagraphStyle.textLists</code>.没有读取 <code>NSParagraphStyle.textLists</code>。<code>NSParagraphStyle.textLists</code> を読んでいませんでした。<code>NSParagraphStyle.textLists</code>를 읽지 않았습니다.On ne lisait pas <code>NSParagraphStyle.textLists</code>.

Fix: 解决：解決：해결:Solution : Inspect the <code>markerFormat</code> of <code>style.textLists.first</code> and emit <code>-</code> or <code>1.</code> accordingly.检查 <code>style.textLists.first</code> 的 <code>markerFormat</code>，据此输出 <code>-</code> 或 <code>1.</code>。<code>style.textLists.first</code> の <code>markerFormat</code> を調べ、それに応じて <code>-</code> か <code>1.</code> を出力します。<code>style.textLists.first</code>의 <code>markerFormat</code>을 확인해 그에 따라 <code>-</code> 또는 <code>1.</code>을 출력합니다.On examine le <code>markerFormat</code> de <code>style.textLists.first</code> pour émettre <code>-</code> ou <code>1.</code>.

Text after an inline code span came out with garbled styling行内代码块后面的文字样式错乱インラインコードの後ろの文字スタイルが崩れる인라인 코드 뒤 텍스트 스타일이 뒤죽박죽이 됨Le style du texte après un code en ligne partait en vrille

Cause: 原因：原因：원인:Cause : Repeated regex replacement nested the markers inside each other.多次正则替换导致标记嵌套。正規表現による置換を重ねた結果、マーカーが入れ子になっていました。정규식을 여러 번 치환해 표시가 중첩되었습니다.Les remplacements par expression régulière à répétition imbriquaient les marques les unes dans les autres.

Fix: 解决：解決：해결:Solution : Switch to a single-pass scan.改为单遍扫描。1 回の走査に切り替えました。한 번만 훑는 방식으로 바꿨습니다.Passage à un balayage en un seul passage.

Hand-rolled two-way Markdown converter.自研 Markdown 双向转换器。自前の Markdown 双方向変換器。자체 제작 Markdown 양방향 변환기.Convertisseur Markdown bidirectionnel écrit maison.

Features/Document/MarkdownConverter.swift465 lines行行줄lignes
import Foundation
import AppKit
import PDFKit

/// Bidirectional Markdown ⇄ NSAttributedString conversion, written from
/// scratch so the app has no external pandoc dependency.
enum MarkdownConverter {

    // MARK: - Markdown → Attributed

    static func attributed(from markdown: String, baseFontSize: CGFloat = 13) -> NSAttributedString {
        let output = NSMutableAttributedString()
        let lines = markdown.components(separatedBy: .newlines)
        var index = 0
        var inCodeFence = false
        var codeBuffer: [String] = []

        let bodyFont = NSFont.systemFont(ofSize: baseFontSize)
        let monoFont = NSFont.monospacedSystemFont(ofSize: baseFontSize - 1, weight: .regular)

        func appendParagraph(_ text: NSAttributedString, spacingAfter: CGFloat = 6) {
            let paragraph = NSMutableParagraphStyle()
            paragraph.paragraphSpacing = spacingAfter
            paragraph.lineSpacing = 2
            let mutable = NSMutableAttributedString(attributedString: text)
            mutable.addAttribute(.paragraphStyle, value: paragraph,
                                 range: NSRange(location: 0, length: mutable.length))
            output.append(mutable)
        }

        while index < lines.count {
            let rawLine = lines[index]
            let line = rawLine

            // Fenced code blocks.
            if line.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces).hasPrefix("```") {
                if inCodeFence {
                    let code = codeBuffer.joined(separator: "\n")
                    let paragraph = NSMutableParagraphStyle()
                    paragraph.paragraphSpacing = 8
                    paragraph.headIndent = 10
                    paragraph.firstLineHeadIndent = 10
                    let attributed = NSAttributedString(string: code + "\n", attributes: [
                        .font: monoFont,
                        .foregroundColor: NSColor(calibratedWhite: 0.15, alpha: 1),
                        .backgroundColor: NSColor(calibratedWhite: 0.94, alpha: 1),
                        .paragraphStyle: paragraph,
                    ])
                    output.append(attributed)
                    codeBuffer.removeAll()
                    inCodeFence = false
                } else {
                    inCodeFence = true
                }
                index += 1
                continue
            }

            if inCodeFence {
                codeBuffer.append(line)
                index += 1
                continue
            }

            let trimmed = line.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces)

            // Blank line.
            if trimmed.isEmpty {
                appendParagraph(NSAttributedString(string: "\n", attributes: [.font: bodyFont]), spacingAfter: 0)
                index += 1
                continue
            }

            // Horizontal rule.
            if trimmed == "---" || trimmed == "***" || trimmed == "___" {
                let rule = NSMutableParagraphStyle()
                rule.paragraphSpacing = 10
                output.append(NSAttributedString(string: "────────────────────────\n", attributes: [
                    .font: NSFont.systemFont(ofSize: 10),
                    .foregroundColor: NSColor(calibratedWhite: 0.7, alpha: 1),
                    .paragraphStyle: rule,
                ]))
                index += 1
                continue
            }

            // Headings.
            if let heading = headingLevel(trimmed) {
                let text = String(trimmed.dropFirst(heading.markerLength))
                    .trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces)
                let sizes: [CGFloat] = [baseFontSize + 11, baseFontSize + 8, baseFontSize + 5,
                                        baseFontSize + 3, baseFontSize + 1, baseFontSize]
                let size = sizes[min(heading.level - 1, sizes.count - 1)]
                let font = NSFont.boldSystemFont(ofSize: size)
                let attributed = inline(from: text, baseFont: font, baseSize: size)
                appendParagraph(attributed, spacingAfter: 8)
                index += 1
                continue
            }

            // Blockquote.
            if trimmed.hasPrefix(">") {
                var quoteLines: [String] = []
                while index < lines.count,
                      lines[index].trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces).hasPrefix(">") {
                    quoteLines.append(String(lines[index].trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces).dropFirst())
                        .trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces))
                    index += 1
                }
                let paragraph = NSMutableParagraphStyle()
                paragraph.headIndent = 18
                paragraph.firstLineHeadIndent = 18
                paragraph.paragraphSpacing = 8
                let attributed = NSMutableAttributedString(
                    attributedString: inline(from: quoteLines.joined(separator: " "),
                                             baseFont: NSFontManager.shared.convert(bodyFont, toHaveTrait: .italicFontMask),
                                             baseSize: baseFontSize))
                attributed.addAttribute(.foregroundColor,
                                        value: NSColor(calibratedWhite: 0.35, alpha: 1),
                                        range: NSRange(location: 0, length: attributed.length))
                attributed.addAttribute(.paragraphStyle, value: paragraph,
                                        range: NSRange(location: 0, length: attributed.length))
                output.append(attributed)
                continue
            }

            // Unordered list.
            if let item = unorderedListItem(trimmed) {
                let paragraph = NSMutableParagraphStyle()
                paragraph.headIndent = 20
                paragraph.firstLineHeadIndent = 6
                paragraph.paragraphSpacing = 2
                let bullet = NSAttributedString(string: "•\t", attributes: [
                    .font: bodyFont,
                    .foregroundColor: NSColor(calibratedWhite: 0.3, alpha: 1),
                ])
                let content = inline(from: item, baseFont: bodyFont, baseSize: baseFontSize)
                let combined = NSMutableAttributedString(attributedString: bullet)
                combined.append(content)
                combined.append(NSAttributedString(string: "\n", attributes: [.font: bodyFont]))
                combined.addAttribute(.paragraphStyle, value: paragraph,
                                      range: NSRange(location: 0, length: combined.length))
                output.append(combined)
                index += 1
                continue
            }

            // Ordered list.
            if let (number, item) = orderedListItem(trimmed) {
                let paragraph = NSMutableParagraphStyle()
                paragraph.headIndent = 24
                paragraph.firstLineHeadIndent = 6
                paragraph.paragraphSpacing = 2
                let marker = NSAttributedString(string: "\(number).\t", attributes: [
                    .font: NSFont.monospacedDigitSystemFont(ofSize: baseFontSize, weight: .regular),
                    .foregroundColor: NSColor(calibratedWhite: 0.3, alpha: 1),
                ])
                let content = inline(from: item, baseFont: bodyFont, baseSize: baseFontSize)
                let combined = NSMutableAttributedString(attributedString: marker)
                combined.append(content)
                combined.append(NSAttributedString(string: "\n", attributes: [.font: bodyFont]))
                combined.addAttribute(.paragraphStyle, value: paragraph,
                                      range: NSRange(location: 0, length: combined.length))
                output.append(combined)
                index += 1
                continue
            }

            // Table (basic pipe syntax).
            if trimmed.hasPrefix("|"), trimmed.hasSuffix("|") {
                var rows: [[String]] = []
                while index < lines.count {
                    let candidate = lines[index].trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces)
                    guard candidate.hasPrefix("|") else { break }
                    // Skip the alignment separator row.
                    let cells = candidate
                        .trimmingCharacters(in: CharacterSet(charactersIn: "|"))
                        .components(separatedBy: "|")
                        .map { $0.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces) }
                    if !cells.allSatisfy({ $0.allSatisfy { $0 == "-" || $0 == ":" || $0 == " " } }) {
                        rows.append(cells)
                    }
                    index += 1
                }
                for (rowIndex, row) in rows.enumerated() {
                    let font = rowIndex == 0
                        ? NSFont.boldSystemFont(ofSize: baseFontSize)
                        : bodyFont
                    let line = row.joined(separator: "   │   ")
                    appendParagraph(inline(from: line, baseFont: font, baseSize: baseFontSize), spacingAfter: 3)
                }
                continue
            }

            // Plain paragraph.
            var paragraphLines: [String] = [trimmed]
            index += 1
            while index < lines.count {
                let next = lines[index].trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces)
                if next.isEmpty || next.hasPrefix("#") || next.hasPrefix(">")
                    || next.hasPrefix("```") || next.hasPrefix("|")
                    || unorderedListItem(next) != nil || orderedListItem(next) != nil {
                    break
                }
                paragraphLines.append(next)
                index += 1
            }
            appendParagraph(
                inline(from: paragraphLines.joined(separator: " "), baseFont: bodyFont, baseSize: baseFontSize),
                spacingAfter: 8)
        }

        // Unterminated code fence.
        if inCodeFence, !codeBuffer.isEmpty {
            output.append(NSAttributedString(string: codeBuffer.joined(separator: "\n"), attributes: [
                .font: monoFont,
            ]))
        }
        return output
    }

    private struct Heading {
        let level: Int
        let markerLength: Int
    }

    private static func headingLevel(_ line: String) -> Heading? {
        var count = 0
        for character in line {
            if character == "#" { count += 1 } else { break }
        }
        guard count > 0, count <= 6, line.count > count else { return nil }
        let after = line.index(line.startIndex, offsetBy: count)
        guard line[after] == " " || line[after] == "\t" else { return nil }
        return Heading(level: count, markerLength: count)
    }

    private static func unorderedListItem(_ line: String) -> String? {
        for marker in ["- ", "* ", "+ "] where line.hasPrefix(marker) {
            return String(line.dropFirst(marker.count))
        }
        return nil
    }

    private static func orderedListItem(_ line: String) -> (Int, String)? {
        var digits = ""
        var rest = Substring(line)
        while let first = rest.first, first.isNumber {
            digits.append(first)
            rest = rest.dropFirst()
        }
        guard !digits.isEmpty, let number = Int(digits) else { return nil }
        guard rest.hasPrefix(". ") || rest.hasPrefix(") ") else { return nil }
        return (number, String(rest.dropFirst(2)))
    }

    /// Parse inline emphasis, code spans and links.
    static func inline(from text: String, baseFont: NSFont, baseSize: CGFloat) -> NSAttributedString {
        let result = NSMutableAttributedString()
        let scalars = Array(text)
        var buffer = ""
        var index = 0

        func flush() {
            guard !buffer.isEmpty else { return }
            result.append(NSAttributedString(string: buffer, attributes: [.font: baseFont]))
            buffer = ""
        }

        while index < scalars.count {
            let character = scalars[index]

            // Inline code.
            if character == "`" {
                if let end = findClosing(scalars, from: index + 1, marker: "`") {
                    flush()
                    let code = String(scalars[(index + 1)..<end])
                    result.append(NSAttributedString(string: code, attributes: [
                        .font: NSFont.monospacedSystemFont(ofSize: baseSize - 1, weight: .regular),
                        .backgroundColor: NSColor(calibratedWhite: 0.93, alpha: 1),
                    ]))
                    index = end + 1
                    continue
                }
            }

            // Bold / italic via ** or *.
            if character == "*" || character == "_" {
                let isDouble = index + 1 < scalars.count && scalars[index + 1] == character
                let marker = isDouble ? String(repeating: String(character), count: 2) : String(character)
                if let end = findClosing(scalars, from: index + marker.count, marker: marker) {
                    flush()
                    let content = String(scalars[(index + marker.count)..<end])
                    let descriptor = baseFont.fontDescriptor
                    var traits: NSFontDescriptor.SymbolicTraits = []
                    if isDouble { traits.insert(.bold) } else { traits.insert(.italic) }
                    let font = NSFont(descriptor: descriptor.withSymbolicTraits(traits), size: baseSize)
                        ?? baseFont
                    result.append(NSAttributedString(string: content, attributes: [.font: font]))
                    index = end + marker.count
                    continue
                }
            }

            // Links: [text](url)
            if character == "[" {
                if let closeBracket = findCharacter(scalars, from: index + 1, target: "]"),
                   closeBracket + 1 < scalars.count, scalars[closeBracket + 1] == "(",
                   let closeParen = findCharacter(scalars, from: closeBracket + 2, target: ")") {
                    flush()
                    let label = String(scalars[(index + 1)..<closeBracket])
                    let href = String(scalars[(closeBracket + 2)..<closeParen])
                    var attributes: [NSAttributedString.Key: Any] = [
                        .font: baseFont,
                        .foregroundColor: NSColor.linkColor,
                        .underlineStyle: NSUnderlineStyle.single.rawValue,
                    ]
                    if let url = URL(string: href) { attributes[.link] = url }
                    result.append(NSAttributedString(string: label, attributes: attributes))
                    index = closeParen + 1
                    continue
                }
            }

            // Images: ![alt](src) — keep the alt text, note the source.
            if character == "!", index + 1 < scalars.count, scalars[index + 1] == "[" {
                if let closeBracket = findCharacter(scalars, from: index + 2, target: "]"),
                   closeBracket + 1 < scalars.count, scalars[closeBracket + 1] == "(",
                   let closeParen = findCharacter(scalars, from: closeBracket + 2, target: ")") {
                    flush()
                    let alt = String(scalars[(index + 2)..<closeBracket])
                    let source = String(scalars[(closeBracket + 2)..<closeParen])
                    result.append(NSAttributedString(string: L("ui.image_alt_isempty_source_alt", alt.isEmpty ? source : alt), attributes: [
                        .font: NSFontManager.shared.convert(baseFont, toHaveTrait: .italicFontMask),
                        .foregroundColor: NSColor(calibratedWhite: 0.45, alpha: 1),
                    ]))
                    index = closeParen + 1
                    continue
                }
            }

            buffer.append(character)
            index += 1
        }
        flush()
        return result
    }

    private static func findClosing(_ scalars: [Character], from: Int, marker: String) -> Int? {
        let markerChars = Array(marker)
        guard from < scalars.count else { return nil }
        var i = from
        while i <= scalars.count - markerChars.count {
            if Array(scalars[i..<(i + markerChars.count)]) == markerChars { return i }
            i += 1
        }
        return nil
    }

    private static func findCharacter(_ scalars: [Character], from: Int, target: Character) -> Int? {
        guard from < scalars.count else { return nil }
        var i = from
        var depth = 0
        while i < scalars.count {
            if scalars[i] == target, depth == 0 { return i }
            if scalars[i] == "(" { depth += 1 }
            if scalars[i] == ")" { depth -= 1 }
            i += 1
        }
        return nil
    }

    // MARK: - Attributed → Markdown

    static func markdown(from attributed: NSAttributedString) -> String {
        var output: [String] = []
        let full = attributed.string as NSString
        var location = 0

        while location < attributed.length {
            var range = NSRange()
            let attributes = attributed.attributes(at: location, effectiveRange: &range)
            let text = full.substring(with: range)
            let trimmed = text.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)

            if !trimmed.isEmpty {
                output.append(renderParagraph(text, attributes: attributes, source: attributed, range: range))
            } else if !output.isEmpty && output.last != "" {
                output.append("")
            }
            location = range.location + range.length
        }

        return output.joined(separator: "\n")
            .replacingOccurrences(of: "\n\n\n", with: "\n\n")
            .trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines) + "\n"
    }

    private static func renderParagraph(
        _ text: String, attributes: [NSAttributedString.Key: Any],
        source: NSAttributedString, range: NSRange
    ) -> String {
        var line = text.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
        guard !line.isEmpty else { return "" }

        let font = attributes[.font] as? NSFont
        let traits = font?.fontDescriptor.symbolicTraits ?? []
        let size = font?.pointSize ?? 13
        let isBold = traits.contains(.bold)
        let isItalic = traits.contains(.italic)
        let isMono = font?.isFixedPitch ?? false

        // Headings inferred from relative font size.
        var prefix = ""
        if isBold || size > 14 {
            if size >= 24 { prefix = "# " }
            else if size >= 20 { prefix = "## " }
            else if size >= 17 { prefix = "### " }
            else if size >= 15 { prefix = "#### " }
            else if isBold && line.count < 60 { prefix = "**" ; }
        }

        // List detection via the paragraph style's text lists.
        if let style = attributes[.paragraphStyle] as? NSParagraphStyle {
            if let list = style.textLists.first {
                let marker = list.markerFormat
                if marker == .decimal {
                    let counter = style.textLists.count
                    prefix = "1. "
                    _ = counter
                } else {
                    prefix = "- "
                }
                line = line.replacingOccurrences(of: "\t", with: " ")
            } else if style.headIndent > 14 && !style.textLists.isEmpty {
                prefix = "- "
            }
        }

        // Link handling: use the first link found in the range.
        if let link = attributes[.link] {
            let href = (link as? URL)?.absoluteString ?? (link as? String) ?? ""
            if !href.isEmpty {
                return "\(prefix)[\(line)](\(href))"
            }
        }

        // Inline emphasis via font traits.
        let escaped = line
        if isMono {
            return "\(prefix)`\(escaped)`"
        }
        if isBold && isItalic {
            return "\(prefix)***\(escaped)***"
        }
        if isBold && prefix.isEmpty {
            return "**\(escaped)**"
        }
        if isItalic {
            return "\(prefix)*\(escaped)*"
        }
        return prefix + escaped
    }
}

Five checksums in a single pass五种校验值的一次性计算5 種類のチェックサムを 1 回で計算다섯 가지 체크섬의 일괄 계산Cinq sommes de contrôle en une seule passe

Read the file once and feed five hashers at the same time. On a 4 GB file that means four fewer trips across the disk.一次读取文件，同时喂给五个哈希器。对 4 GB 文件意味着少读四遍磁盘。ファイルを 1 回読むだけで、5 つのハッシャーへ同時に流し込みます。4 GB のファイルならディスクを 4 回読まずに済むということです。파일을 한 번 읽어 다섯 해셔에 동시에 넣습니다. 4 GB 파일이라면 디스크를 네 번 덜 읽는 셈입니다.Une seule lecture du fichier, envoyée aux cinq hacheurs en parallèle. Sur un fichier de 4 Go, cela fait quatre lectures de disque en moins.

The core idea核心思路核心となる考え方핵심 발상L'idée directrice　Read the file once and feed five hashers at the same time. This isn't a micro-optimization — on a 4 GB file, reading it five times means four times the disk I/O.一次读取文件，同时喂给五个哈希器。这不是微优化——对 4 GB 的文件，读五遍意味着多花四倍的磁盘 I/O。ファイルを 1 回読むだけで、5 つのハッシャーへ同時に流し込みます。これは微最適化ではありません——4 GB のファイルなら、5 回読むことはディスク I/O が 4 回増えることを意味します。파일을 한 번 읽으면서 다섯 개 해셔에 동시에 넣습니다. 이건 미세 최적화가 아닙니다. 4 GB 파일이라면 다섯 번 읽는 것이 디스크 I/O를 네 배 더 쓰는 일입니다.Lire le fichier une seule fois et l'envoyer aux cinq hacheurs en parallèle. Ce n'est pas une micro-optimisation : sur un fichier de 4 Go, cinq lectures représentent quatre fois plus d'E/S disque.

Why it is built this way为什么这样实现なぜそう実装したのか왜 이렇게 구현했는가Pourquoi c'est fait ainsi

Why compute several hashes in one pass为什么要一次多算なぜ 1 回で複数計算するのか왜 한 번에 여러 개를 계산하는가Pourquoi tout calculer en une seule passe

A spinning disk reads sequentially at roughly 150 MB/s, an SSD at roughly 500 MB/s. A 4 GB file takes 8–27 seconds to read once. If the user wants to see both MD5 and SHA-256, computing them separately means reading the file twice. Since we have to read it either way, we may as well feed every hasher in one go.机械硬盘顺序读取约 150 MB/s，SSD 约 500 MB/s。4 GB 文件读一遍 8–27 秒。如果用户想看 MD5 和 SHA-256，分别计算就要读两遍。既然都要读，不如一次喂给所有哈希器。機械式ディスクのシーケンシャル読み取りは約 150 MB/s、SSD は約 500 MB/s です。4 GB のファイルを 1 回読むのに 8〜27 秒かかります。ユーザーが MD5 と SHA-256 の両方を見たい場合、別々に計算すると 2 回読むことになります。どうせ読むなら、1 回ですべてのハッシャーに流し込んだほうが得です。기계식 하드디스크의 순차 읽기는 약 150 MB/s, SSD는 약 500 MB/s입니다. 4 GB 파일을 한 번 읽는 데 8–27초가 걸립니다. 사용자가 MD5와 SHA-256을 함께 보고 싶다면 따로 계산할 경우 두 번 읽어야 합니다. 어차피 읽어야 한다면 한 번에 모든 해셔에 넣는 편이 낫습니다.Un disque mécanique lit en séquentiel à environ 150 Mo/s, un SSD à environ 500 Mo/s. Un fichier de 4 Go se lit donc en 8 à 27 secondes. Si l'utilisateur veut voir à la fois le MD5 et le SHA-256, les calculer séparément impose deux lectures. Puisqu'il faut lire de toute façon, autant tout envoyer aux hacheurs d'un coup.

Why CryptoKit but a hand-written CRC32为什么用 CryptoKit 而 CRC32 自己写なぜ CryptoKit を使い、CRC32 は自分で書くのか왜 CryptoKit을 쓰고 CRC32는 직접 구현하는가Pourquoi CryptoKit mais un CRC32 écrit à la main

CryptoKit offers streaming interfaces for MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, and SHA-512; they're hardware-accelerated and audited. But CRC32 is a checksum, not a cryptographic hash, and CryptoKit doesn't provide it — so we implement it with a lookup table: 256 entries, one table lookup and XOR per byte.CryptoKit 提供 MD5、SHA-1、SHA-256、SHA-512 的流式接口，硬件加速且经过审计。但 CRC32 是校验和不是加密哈希，CryptoKit 没有，所以用查表法实现——256 项表，每字节一次查表异或。CryptoKit は MD5、SHA-1、SHA-256、SHA-512 のストリーミングインターフェースを提供し、ハードウェア加速され監査も受けています。しかし CRC32 はチェックサムであって暗号学的ハッシュではなく、CryptoKit にはありません。そこでテーブル参照方式で実装します——256 項目の表で、1 バイトにつき表引きと XOR を 1 回ずつです。CryptoKit은 MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512의 스트리밍 인터페이스를 제공하고, 하드웨어 가속을 받으며 감사도 거쳤습니다. 하지만 CRC32는 암호학적 해시가 아니라 체크섬이라 CryptoKit에 없습니다. 그래서 조회 테이블 방식으로 구현했습니다. 256개 항목 테이블에, 바이트마다 조회 한 번과 XOR 한 번입니다.CryptoKit fournit des interfaces en flux pour MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256 et SHA-512 ; elles sont accélérées par le matériel et auditées. Mais le CRC32 est une somme de contrôle, pas un hachage cryptographique : CryptoKit ne le propose pas, on l'implémente donc par table de correspondance — 256 entrées, une consultation et un XOR par octet.

Why read in chunks为什么分块读取なぜチャンク単位で読むのか왜 블록 단위로 읽는가Pourquoi lire par blocs

A single <code>Data(contentsOf:)</code> pulls the whole file into memory — a 1 GB file costs 1 GB of RAM. Streaming it in 1 MB chunks keeps memory constant.一次性 <code>Data(contentsOf:)</code> 会把整个文件读进内存。1 GB 的文件就占 1 GB 内存。改成 1 MB 分块流式处理，内存恒定。<code>Data(contentsOf:)</code> を一度に使うとファイル全体がメモリに載ります。1 GB のファイルなら 1 GB のメモリを占めます。1 MB ずつストリーミング処理すれば、メモリ使用量は一定です。<code>Data(contentsOf:)</code>로 한 번에 읽으면 파일 전체가 메모리에 올라갑니다. 1 GB 파일이면 메모리 1 GB를 차지합니다. 1 MB 블록으로 나눠 스트리밍 처리하도록 바꾸면 메모리 사용량이 일정합니다.Un <code>Data(contentsOf:)</code> d'un seul coup charge tout le fichier en mémoire : 1 Go de fichier, 1 Go de RAM. Le traitement en flux par blocs de 1 Mo maintient une empreinte constante.

Why FileHandle instead of mmap为什么用 FileHandle 而不是 mmapなぜ mmap ではなく FileHandle なのか왜 mmap이 아니라 FileHandle을 쓰는가Pourquoi FileHandle plutôt que mmap

Memory mapping is more efficient for very large files, but it pins the file into virtual memory and behaves inconsistently on network volumes and external disks. Streaming reads are more predictable.内存映射对超大文件更高效，但会把文件锁在虚拟内存里，而且对网络卷、外部磁盘的行为不一致。流式读取更可预测。メモリマップは超大容量ファイルには効率的ですが、ファイルを仮想メモリに固定してしまい、ネットワークボリュームや外部ディスクでの挙動も一貫しません。ストリーミング読み取りのほうが予測可能です。메모리 매핑은 아주 큰 파일에서 더 효율적이지만 파일을 가상 메모리에 묶어 두고, 네트워크 볼륨이나 외장 디스크에서 동작이 일관되지 않습니다. 스트리밍 읽기가 더 예측 가능합니다.Le mappage mémoire est plus efficace sur de très gros fichiers, mais il épingle le fichier dans la mémoire virtuelle et se comporte de façon irrégulière sur les volumes réseau et les disques externes. La lecture en flux est plus prévisible.

Mistakes we hit踩过的坑踏んだ落とし穴밟은 함정Pièges rencontrés

CRC32 results didn't match the system toolsCRC32 结果与系统工具不一致CRC32 の結果がシステムツールと一致しないCRC32 결과가 시스템 도구와 일치하지 않음Les résultats CRC32 ne correspondaient pas aux outils système

Cause: 原因：原因：원인:Cause : CRC32 has several variants that differ in initial value, polynomial, and whether the result is inverted. GIF uses a different one.CRC32 有多个变体（初始值、多项式、是否取反各不相同）。GIF 用的是另一种。CRC32 には複数の変種があり、初期値・多項式・結果を反転するかどうかがそれぞれ異なります。GIF が使うのは別の変種です。CRC32에는 변형이 여럿 있습니다(초기값, 다항식, 반전 여부가 각각 다릅니다). GIF가 쓰는 것은 또 다른 변형입니다.Le CRC32 existe en plusieurs variantes, qui diffèrent par la valeur initiale, le polynôme et l'inversion finale. Le GIF en utilise une autre.

Fix: 解决：解決：해결:Solution : Adopt the IEEE 802.3 standard: initial value <code>0xFFFFFFFF</code>, polynomial <code>0xEDB88320</code>, and an inverted result, which matches <code>zlib.crc32</code>.采用 IEEE 802.3 标准：初值 <code>0xFFFFFFFF</code>、多项式 <code>0xEDB88320</code>、结果取反，与 <code>zlib.crc32</code> 一致。IEEE 802.3 規格を採用：初期値 <code>0xFFFFFFFF</code>、多項式 <code>0xEDB88320</code>、結果を反転。これで <code>zlib.crc32</code> と一致します。IEEE 802.3 표준을 따릅니다. 초기값 <code>0xFFFFFFFF</code>, 다항식 <code>0xEDB88320</code>, 결과 반전이며 <code>zlib.crc32</code>와 일치합니다.Adoption de la norme IEEE 802.3 : valeur initiale <code>0xFFFFFFFF</code>, polynôme <code>0xEDB88320</code> et résultat inversé, ce qui correspond à <code>zlib.crc32</code>.

Single-pass, multi-algorithm implementation of the five checksums (including CRC32).五种校验值的一次性多算法实现（含 CRC32）。5 種類のチェックサムを 1 回で計算する多重アルゴリズム実装（CRC32 を含む）。다섯 가지 체크섬의 일괄 다중 알고리즘 구현(CRC32 포함).Implémentation multi-algorithmes en une seule passe des cinq sommes de contrôle (CRC32 compris).

Core/HashEngine.swift152 lines行行줄lignes
import Foundation
import CryptoKit

// MARK: - Algorithms

/// Every checksum the app can compute.
enum HashAlgorithm: String, CaseIterable, Identifiable, Sendable {
    case md5, sha1, sha256, sha512, crc32

    var id: String { rawValue }

    var label: String {
        switch self {
        case .md5: return "MD5"
        case .sha1: return "SHA-1"
        case .sha256: return "SHA-256"
        case .sha512: return "SHA-512"
        case .crc32: return "CRC32"
        }
    }

    var detail: String {
        switch self {
        case .md5: return L("enum.hash.md5")
        case .sha1: return L("enum.hash.md5.2")
        case .sha256: return L("enum.hash.md5.3")
        case .sha512: return L("enum.hash.md5.4")
        case .crc32: return L("enum.hash.md5.5")
        }
    }

    var hexLength: Int {
        switch self {
        case .md5: return 32
        case .sha1: return 40
        case .sha256: return 64
        case .sha512: return 128
        case .crc32: return 8
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - CRC32

/// Table-driven CRC-32 (IEEE 802.3), matching the value `crc32` prints.
struct CRC32 {
    private static let table: [UInt32] = {
        (0..<256).map { index -> UInt32 in
            var value = UInt32(index)
            for _ in 0..<8 {
                value = (value & 1) != 0 ? (0xEDB8_8320 ^ (value >> 1)) : (value >> 1)
            }
            return value
        }
    }()

    private var crc: UInt32 = 0xFFFF_FFFF

    mutating func update(_ data: Data) {
        var value = crc
        for byte in data {
            value = Self.table[Int((value ^ UInt32(byte)) & 0xFF)] ^ (value >> 8)
        }
        crc = value
    }

    var checksum: UInt32 { crc ^ 0xFFFF_FFFF }

    var hex: String { String(format: "%08x", checksum) }
}

// MARK: - Multi-hash

/// Computes every requested checksum in a **single pass** over the file, so
/// asking for five algorithms costs one read rather than five.
enum HashEngine {

    /// Result for one file.
    struct Result: Sendable {
        var url: URL
        var values: [HashAlgorithm: String]
        var bytes: Int64
        var seconds: Double
        var error: String?

        var ok: Bool { error == nil }
    }

    /// Hash one file with all requested algorithms.
    static func hash(
        _ url: URL,
        algorithms: [HashAlgorithm] = HashAlgorithm.allCases,
        chunkSize: Int = 1 << 20,
        progress: (@Sendable (Double) -> Void)? = nil
    ) -> Result {
        let start = Date()
        let wanted = Set(algorithms)

        guard let handle = try? FileHandle(forReadingFrom: url) else {
            return Result(url: url, values: [:], bytes: 0, seconds: 0,
                          error: L("ui.could_not_read_the_file"))
        }
        defer { try? handle.close() }

        var md5 = wanted.contains(.md5) ? Insecure.MD5() : nil
        var sha1 = wanted.contains(.sha1) ? Insecure.SHA1() : nil
        var sha256 = wanted.contains(.sha256) ? SHA256() : nil
        var sha512 = wanted.contains(.sha512) ? SHA512() : nil
        var crc = wanted.contains(.crc32) ? CRC32() : nil

        // Total size drives the progress fraction.
        let total = (try? handle.seekToEnd()) ?? 0
        try? handle.seek(toOffset: 0)

        var processed: Int64 = 0
        while true {
            guard let chunk = try? handle.read(upToCount: chunkSize), !chunk.isEmpty else { break }
            md5?.update(data: chunk)
            sha1?.update(data: chunk)
            sha256?.update(data: chunk)
            sha512?.update(data: chunk)
            crc?.update(chunk)

            processed += Int64(chunk.count)
            if total > 0 { progress?(Double(processed) / Double(total)) }
        }

        var values: [HashAlgorithm: String] = [:]
        if let md5 { values[.md5] = hex(md5.finalize()) }
        if let sha1 { values[.sha1] = hex(sha1.finalize()) }
        if let sha256 { values[.sha256] = hex(sha256.finalize()) }
        if let sha512 { values[.sha512] = hex(sha512.finalize()) }
        if let crc { values[.crc32] = crc.hex }

        return Result(url: url, values: values, bytes: processed,
                      seconds: Date().timeIntervalSince(start), error: nil)
    }

    private static func hex<D: Sequence>(_ digest: D) -> String where D.Element == UInt8 {
        digest.map { String(format: "%02x", $0) }.joined()
    }

    /// Verify a file against an expected checksum.
    static func verify(_ url: URL, expected: String, algorithm: HashAlgorithm) -> Bool? {
        let normalized = expected.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines).lowercased()
        guard !normalized.isEmpty else { return nil }
        let result = hash(url, algorithms: [algorithm])
        guard let actual = result.values[algorithm] else { return nil }
        return actual == normalized
    }
}

Inspection tools: drop a file in, get a result检查类工具：拖入即出结果検査系ツール：ドロップするだけで結果が出る검사형 도구: 끌어다 놓으면 결과Outils d'inspection : déposer un fichier suffit

Inspection tools have no button, never enter the queue, and never ask where to save — drop a file in and the result appears.检查类工具没有按钮、不进队列、不问保存位置，文件一拖进去就出结果。検査系ツールにはボタンがなく、キューにも入らず、保存先も聞きません。ファイルをドロップすれば結果が出ます。검사형 도구는 버튼도, 큐도, 저장 위치 질문도 없습니다. 파일을 끌어다 놓으면 결과가 나옵니다.Les outils d'inspection n'ont pas de bouton, n'entrent pas dans la file et ne demandent pas où sauvegarder : on dépose un fichier, le résultat apparaît.

The core idea核心思路核心となる考え方핵심 발상L'idée directrice　Inspection tools have <b>no buttons</b>. Drop a file in and the result is computed and shown inline; change an option and it recomputes immediately. It's a direct expression of the idea that different kinds of work call for different interactions.检查类工具<b>没有按钮</b>。文件一拖进去就计算结果并内联显示，改选项也立刻重算。这是「不同性质的功能用不同交互」的直接体现。検査系ツールには<b>ボタンがありません</b>。ファイルをドロップすれば結果が計算されてインライン表示され、オプションを変えれば即座に再計算されます。「性質の異なる機能には異なる対話を」という考え方の直接的な表れです。검사형 도구에는 <b>버튼이 없습니다</b>. 파일을 끌어다 놓으면 곧바로 계산해 인라인으로 보여 주고, 옵션을 바꾸면 즉시 다시 계산합니다. "성격이 다른 기능에는 다른 상호작용"이라는 원칙이 그대로 드러나는 부분입니다.Les outils d'inspection n'ont <b>pas de bouton</b>. On dépose un fichier, le résultat se calcule et s'affiche en ligne ; on change une option, il est recalculé aussitôt. C'est l'application directe de « des fonctions de nature différente, des interactions différentes ».

Why it is built this way为什么这样实现なぜそう実装したのか왜 이렇게 구현했는가Pourquoi c'est fait ainsi

Why no button is needed为什么不需要按钮なぜボタンが不要なのか왜 버튼이 필요 없는가Pourquoi aucun bouton n'est nécessaire

Computing a checksum or reading image metadata is a <b>pure</b> operation: given the input you get a definite result right away, with no side effects. Making the user click first and then wait for a result is pure overhead.计算校验值、读取图片信息都是<b>纯函数式</b>的操作：给定输入立刻有确定结果，不产生副作用。让用户先点一下再等结果，纯属多余。チェックサムの計算も画像情報の読み取りも<b>純粋関数</b>的な操作です：入力を与えれば直ちに確定した結果が得られ、副作用はありません。ユーザーにまずクリックさせてから結果を待たせるのは、純粋な無駄です。체크섬을 계산하고 이미지 정보를 읽는 일은 모두 <b>순수 함수형</b> 연산입니다. 입력이 주어지면 곧바로 확정된 결과가 나오고 부작용이 없습니다. 사용자에게 버튼을 한 번 누르게 하고 결과를 기다리게 하는 것은 군더더기입니다.Calculer une somme de contrôle ou lire les métadonnées d'une image sont des opérations <b>purement fonctionnelles</b> : à entrée donnée, un résultat déterminé tombe immédiatement, sans effet de bord. Faire cliquer l'utilisateur avant d'attendre un résultat n'apporte rien.

Why there's a dedicated report model为什么要有独立的报告模型なぜ独立したレポートモデルが必要なのか왜 독립적인 리포트 모델이 필요한가Pourquoi un modèle de rapport dédié

If we dumped results into the log panel, the user would have to switch to the "Log" tab to see them, and they'd be plain text. Once we define <code>InspectionReport</code>, results can be grouped, carry status, and have a copy button on every row.如果把结果塞进日志面板，用户得切换到「日志」标签才能看到，而且格式是纯文本。定义 <code>InspectionReport</code> 之后，结果能分组、能标记状态、能给每行加复制按钮。結果をログパネルに放り込むと、ユーザーは「ログ」タブに切り替えないと見られず、しかも書式はプレーンテキストです。<code>InspectionReport</code> を定義すれば、結果をグループ化でき、状態を付けられ、各行にコピーボタンを置けます。결과를 로그 패널에 밀어 넣으면 사용자가 "로그" 탭으로 전환해야 볼 수 있고 형식도 순수 텍스트입니다. <code>InspectionReport</code>를 정의한 뒤로는 결과를 그룹으로 묶고, 상태를 표시하고, 줄마다 복사 버튼을 붙일 수 있습니다.En fourrant les résultats dans le panneau de journal, il faudrait basculer sur l'onglet « Journal » pour les voir, et ils seraient en texte brut. Avec <code>InspectionReport</code>, les résultats se regroupent, portent un état et chaque ligne peut recevoir un bouton de copie.

Why image detection doesn't go through ffprobe为什么图片类型判定不看 ffprobeなぜ画像種別の判定で ffprobe を見ないのか왜 이미지 종류 판정에 ffprobe를 보지 않는가Pourquoi la détection du type d'image n'interroge pas ffprobe

ffprobe reports a JPEG as a single-frame <code>mjpeg</code> <b>video stream</b>. If we only asked "is there a video stream?", an image would be displayed as "duration 0 seconds, 0 fps, bitrate 0" — all meaningless fields. So we classify by extension first and fall back to stream inspection only when the container is ambiguous (a .mkv, say).ffprobe 把 JPEG 报告成单帧 <code>mjpeg</code> <b>视频流</b>。如果只判断「有没有视频流」，图片就会被显示成「时长 0 秒、帧率 0 fps、码率 0」——全是无意义的字段。所以先按扩展名分类，容器不明确时（如 .mkv）才回退到流判断。ffprobe は JPEG を 1 フレームの <code>mjpeg</code> <b>映像ストリーム</b>として報告します。「映像ストリームがあるか」だけで判定すると、画像が「再生時間 0 秒、フレームレート 0 fps、ビットレート 0」と表示されます——意味のないフィールドばかりです。そこでまず拡張子で分類し、コンテナが曖昧なとき（.mkv など）だけストリーム判定へ戻します。ffprobe는 JPEG를 한 프레임짜리 <code>mjpeg</code> <b>비디오 스트림</b>으로 보고합니다. "비디오 스트림이 있는가"만 판단하면 이미지가 "길이 0초, 프레임 레이트 0 fps, 비트레이트 0"으로 표시됩니다. 전부 의미 없는 필드입니다. 그래서 먼저 확장자로 분류하고, 컨테이너가 불분명할 때(예: .mkv)만 스트림 판정으로 물러납니다.ffprobe présente un JPEG comme un <b>flux vidéo</b> <code>mjpeg</code> d'une seule image. En se contentant de demander « y a-t-il un flux vidéo ? », une image s'afficherait avec « durée 0 seconde, 0 fps, débit 0 » — que des champs dénués de sens. On classe donc d'abord par extension, et on ne retombe sur l'examen des flux que lorsque le conteneur est ambigu (un .mkv, par exemple).

Why debouncing is necessary为什么要防抖なぜデバウンスが必要なのか왜 디바운스가 필요한가Pourquoi un anti-rebond est nécessaire

Dropping in files triggers a computation, and so does changing a parameter. Flipping the "extract dominant colors" switch repeatedly spawns several concurrent tasks. We compare input snapshots to discard stale results: when a computation finishes, check whether the inputs are still the same batch as when it started, and drop the result if they aren't.拖入文件会触发计算，改参数也会。连续调整「提取主色调」开关时，会启动多个并发任务。用输入快照比对丢弃过期结果：计算完成后检查输入是否还是当初那一批，不是就丢弃。ファイルをドロップすれば計算が走り、パラメータを変えても走ります。「主要色を抽出」のスイッチを連続して切り替えると、複数のタスクが並行して起動します。入力スナップショットを比較して古い結果を破棄します：計算が終わったとき、入力が開始時と同じバッチかどうかを確認し、違えば結果を捨てます。파일을 끌어다 놓아도 계산이 돌고, 파라미터를 바꿔도 돕니다. "주요 색상 추출" 스위치를 연달아 조작하면 여러 작업이 동시에 시작됩니다. 입력 스냅샷 비교로 오래된 결과를 버립니다. 계산이 끝난 뒤 입력이 그때 그 묶음이 맞는지 확인하고, 아니면 버립니다.Déposer un fichier déclenche un calcul, changer un paramètre aussi. En manipulant plusieurs fois de suite l'interrupteur « extraire les couleurs dominantes », on lance plusieurs tâches concurrentes. On compare donc des instantanés d'entrée pour jeter les résultats périmés : à la fin d'un calcul, on vérifie que les entrées sont toujours celles du départ, sinon on abandonne.

Cause: 原因：原因：원인:Cause : <code>hasVideo</code> only checked <code>videoCodec != nil</code>, and ffprobe treats a JPEG as a video stream.<code>hasVideo</code> 只判断 <code>videoCodec != nil</code>，而 ffprobe 把 JPEG 当作视频流。<code>hasVideo</code> が <code>videoCodec != nil</code> しか見ておらず、ffprobe は JPEG を映像ストリームとして扱っていました。<code>hasVideo</code>가 <code>videoCodec != nil</code>만 판단하는데, ffprobe는 JPEG를 비디오 스트림으로 취급합니다.<code>hasVideo</code> se contentait de tester <code>videoCodec != nil</code>, et ffprobe traite un JPEG comme un flux vidéo.

Report model and protocol for inspection tools.检查类工具的报告模型与协议。検査系ツールのレポートモデルとプロトコル。검사형 도구의 리포트 모델과 프로토콜.Modèle de rapport et protocole des outils d'inspection.

Core/Inspection.swift55 lines行行줄lignes
import Foundation

// MARK: - Report model

/// Structured results from an inspection tool.
///
/// Inspection tools do not "run" — they compute automatically whenever the
/// input changes and render their findings inline in the workspace, so there is
/// no button to press and no need to hunt for the right panel.
struct InspectionReport: Sendable {
    struct Row: Sendable, Identifiable {
        let id: String
        let label: String
        let value: String
        /// Rendered in a monospaced font (hashes, paths, numbers).
        var mono: Bool = false
        /// Offers a copy button; defaults on for mono values.
        var copyable: Bool = false
        /// Optional verification outcome.
        var status: Status? = nil

        enum Status: Sendable { case ok, failed, neutral }
    }

    struct Section: Sendable, Identifiable {
        let id: String
        let title: String
        var symbol: String = "info.circle"
        var rows: [Row] = []
        /// Free-form note shown under the rows.
        var note: String? = nil
    }

    var sections: [Section] = []
    /// One-line headline, e.g. "1.5 MB · 读取耗时 0.03 秒".
    var summary: String? = nil
    var error: String? = nil
    var seconds: Double = 0

    var isEmpty: Bool { sections.allSatisfy { $0.rows.isEmpty } }

    static func failure(_ message: String) -> InspectionReport {
        InspectionReport(sections: [], summary: nil, error: message)
    }
}

// MARK: - Inspector protocol

/// A tool that inspects files rather than converting them.
protocol FileInspector: Sendable {
    /// Compute the report for the given inputs.
    func inspect(inputs: [URL], values: [String: ParameterValue],
                 progress: @escaping @Sendable (Double) -> Void) async -> InspectionReport
}
