import Foundation
import CoreGraphics

/// Computes a `WorkEstimate` for the currently selected tool by inspecting the
/// real inputs. Runs off the main actor because probing media shells out.
enum EstimateEngine {

    struct Result: Sendable {
        var estimate: WorkEstimate?
        var mediaInfo: MediaInfo?
    }

    static func compute(
        toolID: String,
        inputs: [URL],
        values: [String: ParameterValue],
        settings: AppSettings
    ) async -> Result {
        guard let first = inputs.first else { return Result(estimate: nil, mediaInfo: nil) }

        let inputBytes = inputs.reduce(Int64(0)) { $0 + FileIO.size(of: $1) }
        let count = inputs.count

        // Tools that only inspect files have no output size or duration to
        // predict, so they get no estimate card at all.
        if let tool = ToolRegistry.tool(withID: toolID),
           !tool.writesFiles(values: values) {
            let info = await MediaProbe.info(for: first)
            return Result(estimate: nil, mediaInfo: info)
        }

        func string(_ key: String, _ fallback: String = "") -> String {
            values[key]?.stringValue.isEmpty == false ? values[key]!.stringValue : fallback
        }
        func number(_ key: String, _ fallback: Double = 0) -> Double {
            values[key]?.doubleValue ?? fallback
        }
        func bool(_ key: String, _ fallback: Bool = false) -> Bool {
            values[key]?.boolValue ?? fallback
        }

        switch toolID {

        // MARK: Video

        case "video.compress", "video.convert", "video.resize", "video.speed",
             "video.watermark", "video.concat", "video.transform", "video.strip",
             "video.fingerprint", "video.trim", "video.audio.extract", "video.audio.merge",
             "video.cover":
            let info = await MediaProbe.info(for: first)
            let codec = VideoCodec(rawValue: string("codec", "h264")) ?? .h264
            let audioCodec = AudioCodec(rawValue: string("audioCodec", "aac")) ?? .aac

            // Stream-copy operations barely change size.
            let isStreamCopy = isCopyOperation(toolID: toolID, values: values)
            if isStreamCopy {
                var estimate = WorkEstimate(inputBytes: inputBytes)
                estimate.outputBytes = Int64(Double(inputBytes) * 1.01)
                estimate.basis = L("ui.stream_copy_the_size_stays_the_same")
                estimate.approximate = false
                estimate.seconds = max((info?.duration ?? 10) * 0.02, 0.3)
                return Result(estimate: estimate, mediaInfo: info)
            }

            // Target-size mode is exact by construction.
            var targetBitrate: Int?
            if string("mode") == "size", let duration = info?.duration, duration > 0 {
                let targetMB = max(number("targetSize", 20), 0.5)
                let audioKbps = number("audioBitrate", 128)
                let totalKbps = (targetMB * 8 * 1024) / duration
                targetBitrate = max(Int(totalKbps - audioKbps), 50)
            } else if string("mode") == "bitrate" {
                targetBitrate = Int(number("videoBitrate", 2500))
            }

            var scaleHeight: Int?
            switch string("scale", "original") {
            case "custom": scaleHeight = Int(number("customHeight", 0)) > 0 ? Int(number("customHeight")) : nil
            case "original": scaleHeight = nil
            default: scaleHeight = ScalePreset(rawValue: string("scale"))?.height
            }

            let estimate = Estimator.video(
                info: info,
                inputBytes: inputBytes,
                codec: codec,
                crf: number("crf", codec.defaultCRF),
                preset: string("preset", "medium"),
                hardware: bool("hardware", settings.useHardwareAcceleration),
                audioCodec: audioCodec,
                audioBitrate: Int(number("audioBitrate", 192)),
                targetBitrateKbps: targetBitrate,
                scaleHeight: scaleHeight,
                duration: info?.duration ?? 0,
                frameRate: info?.frameRate ?? 30)
            return Result(estimate: estimate, mediaInfo: info)

        case "video.gif":
            let info = await MediaProbe.info(for: first)
            let width = Int(number("width", 480))
            let aspect = info?.aspect ?? 16.0 / 9.0
            let height = max(Int(Double(width) / max(aspect, 0.01)), 1)
            let fps = number("fps", 15)
            let clip = number("duration", 5)
            let estimate = Estimator.gif(
                width: width, height: height,
                frameCount: max(Int(clip * fps), 1),
                colorCount: Int(number("colors", 256)),
                transitionFrames: 0)
            return Result(estimate: estimate, mediaInfo: info)

        case "video.screenshot", "video.frames":
            let info = await MediaProbe.info(for: first)
            let mode = string("mode", "single")
            let format = string("format", "png")
            let codec = ImageCodec.from(extension: format) ?? .png
            let frames: Int
            switch mode {
            case "single": frames = 1
            case "count": frames = max(Int(number("count", 9)), 1)
            case "all":
                frames = max(Int((info?.duration ?? 10) * (info?.frameRate ?? 30)), 1)
            case "range":
                let span = max(number("end", 10) - number("start", 0), 0.1)
                frames = max(Int(span * (info?.frameRate ?? 30)), 1)
            default:
                let interval = max(number("interval", 5), 0.05)
                frames = max(Int((info?.duration ?? 10) / interval), 1)
            }
            var width = info?.width ?? 1920
            var height = info?.height ?? 1080
            if let target = ScalePreset(rawValue: string("scale", "original"))?.height,
               target < height {
                width = Int(Double(width) * Double(target) / Double(height))
                height = target
            }
            let estimate = Estimator.image(
                codec: codec, quality: number("quality", 92) / 100,
                inputBytes: inputBytes,
                sourceSize: CGSize(width: info?.width ?? width, height: info?.height ?? height),
                targetSize: CGSize(width: width, height: height),
                count: frames)
            return Result(estimate: estimate, mediaInfo: info)

        case "video.fromimages", "video.slideshow":
            let fps = toolID == "video.fromimages" ? number("fps", 30) : 30.0
            let perImage = number("perImage", 3)
            let seconds = toolID == "video.fromimages"
                ? Double(count) / max(fps, 1)
                : Double(count) * perImage
            var estimate = WorkEstimate(inputBytes: inputBytes)
            // Roughly 0.09 bits/pixel/frame at 1080p30 H.264 CRF 20.
            estimate.outputBytes = Int64(1920 * 1080 * 30 * 0.07 / 8 * seconds)
            estimate.basis = L("ui.from_the_output_duration_and_resolution")
            estimate.seconds = Estimator.encodeSeconds(
                codec: .h264, preset: "medium", hardware: settings.useHardwareAcceleration,
                width: 1920, height: 1080, fps: 30, duration: seconds) + Double(count) * 0.15
            return Result(estimate: estimate, mediaInfo: nil)

        // MARK: Image

        case "image.convert", "image.compress", "image.resize", "image.transform",
             "image.watermark", "image.decorate":
            guard let size = ImageSupport.size(of: first) else {
                return Result(estimate: nil, mediaInfo: nil)
            }
            var codec: ImageCodec
            let requested = string("codec", string("format", "keep"))
            if requested == "keep" {
                codec = ImageCodec.from(extension: first.pathExtension) ?? .jpeg
            } else {
                codec = ImageCodec.from(extension: requested) ?? .jpeg
            }
            if toolID == "image.compress", codec == .png, string("mode", "quality") != "percent" {
                codec = .jpeg
            }
            if toolID == "image.decorate" { codec = ImageCodec.from(extension: string("format", "png")) ?? .png }

            // Resolve the target geometry the same way the tool does.
            var target = size
            let resizeMode = string("resize", string("mode", "keep"))
            switch resizeMode {
            case "maxWidth":
                let maxWidth = number("maxWidth", 1920)
                if size.width > maxWidth { target = CGSize(width: maxWidth, height: size.height * maxWidth / size.width) }
            case "maxHeight":
                let maxHeight = number("maxHeight", 1080)
                if size.height > maxHeight { target = CGSize(width: size.width * maxHeight / size.height, height: maxHeight) }
            case "percent":
                let percent = number("percent", number("scalePercent", 50)) / 100
                target = CGSize(width: size.width * percent, height: size.height * percent)
            case "longEdge":
                let edge = number("longEdge", 1600)
                let longest = max(size.width, size.height)
                if longest > 0 {
                    let scale = edge / longest
                    target = CGSize(width: size.width * scale, height: size.height * scale)
                }
            case "exact":
                target = CGSize(width: number("width", 1920), height: number("height", 1080))
            case "width":
                let width = number("width", 1920)
                target = CGSize(width: width, height: size.height * width / max(size.width, 1))
            case "height":
                let height = number("height", 1080)
                target = CGSize(width: size.width * height / max(size.height, 1), height: height)
            default:
                break
            }

            // Target-size mode: the requested size *is* the answer.
            if toolID == "image.compress", string("mode") == "targetSize" {
                var estimate = WorkEstimate(inputBytes: inputBytes)
                estimate.outputBytes = Int64(number("targetKB", 500) * 1024) * Int64(count)
                estimate.basis = L("ui.from_the_target_size_you_set")
                estimate.approximate = false
                estimate.seconds = 0.2 + Double(count) * 0.08
                return Result(estimate: estimate, mediaInfo: nil)
            }

            let estimate = Estimator.image(
                codec: codec,
                quality: number("quality", 85) / 100,
                inputBytes: inputBytes,
                sourceSize: size,
                targetSize: target,
                count: count)
            return Result(estimate: estimate, mediaInfo: nil)

        case "image.stitch":
            var totalPixels = 0.0
            var maxWidth = 0.0
            var totalHeight = 0.0
            for url in inputs {
                guard let size = ImageSupport.size(of: url) else { continue }
                totalPixels += size.width * size.height
                maxWidth = max(maxWidth, size.width)
                totalHeight += size.height
            }
            var estimate = WorkEstimate(inputBytes: inputBytes)
            estimate.outputBytes = Int64(max(totalPixels, 1) * 1.4)
            estimate.basis = L("ui.from_the_total_pixel_count_after_stitching")
            estimate.seconds = 0.3 + totalPixels / 8_000_000
            _ = (maxWidth, totalHeight)
            return Result(estimate: estimate, mediaInfo: nil)

        case "image.topdf":
            let totalPixels = inputs.reduce(0.0) { sum, url in
                guard let size = ImageSupport.size(of: url) else { return sum }
                return sum + size.width * size.height
            }
            var estimate = WorkEstimate(inputBytes: inputBytes)
            estimate.outputBytes = Int64(max(totalPixels, 1) * 0.5) + Int64(count) * 1200
            estimate.basis = L("ui.from_the_total_pixel_count")
            estimate.seconds = 0.3 + totalPixels / 20_000_000
            return Result(estimate: estimate, mediaInfo: nil)

        case "pdf.toimage":
            let dpi = number("dpi", 150)
            let scale = dpi / 72
            let pageWidth = 595.0 * scale, pageHeight = 842.0 * scale
            let codec = ImageCodec.from(extension: string("format", "png")) ?? .png
            let estimate = Estimator.image(
                codec: codec, quality: number("quality", 90) / 100,
                inputBytes: inputBytes,
                sourceSize: CGSize(width: pageWidth, height: pageHeight),
                targetSize: CGSize(width: pageWidth, height: pageHeight),
                count: count)
            return Result(estimate: estimate, mediaInfo: nil)

        case "image.gif":
            // The GIF editor owns its own recipe; estimate from the input count.
            var estimate = WorkEstimate(inputBytes: inputBytes)
            estimate.outputBytes = Int64(Double(count) * 480 * 270 * 0.32)
            estimate.basis = L("ui.from_the_frame_count_updates_live_in_the_e")
            estimate.seconds = 0.4 + Double(count) * 0.12
            return Result(estimate: estimate, mediaInfo: nil)

        // MARK: Archive

        case "archive.create":
            let format = ArchiveFormat(rawValue: string("format", "zip")) ?? .zip
            let estimate = Estimator.archive(
                inputBytes: inputBytes, level: Int(number("level", 5)), format: format)
            return Result(estimate: estimate, mediaInfo: nil)

        case "archive.extract":
            var estimate = WorkEstimate(inputBytes: inputBytes)
            // Archives typically expand to ~2.5× their compressed size.
            estimate.outputBytes = Int64(Double(inputBytes) * 2.5)
            estimate.basis = L("ui.typical_expansion_ratio_for_archives")
            estimate.seconds = 0.5 + Double(inputBytes) / 60_000_000
            return Result(estimate: estimate, mediaInfo: nil)

        // MARK: Document

        case "doc.pdfcompress":
            var estimate = WorkEstimate(inputBytes: inputBytes)
            let dpi = number("dpi", 110)
            let quality = number("quality", 65) / 100
            // Rasterising to JPEG at the target DPI dominates the result.
            let factor = (dpi / 150.0) * (0.25 + 0.75 * quality) * 0.55
            estimate.outputBytes = Int64(Double(inputBytes) * min(max(factor, 0.06), 1.2))
            estimate.basis = L("ui.from_the_target_dpi_and_jpeg_quality")
            estimate.seconds = 0.6 + Double(inputBytes) / 3_000_000
            return Result(estimate: estimate, mediaInfo: nil)

        case "doc.word2pdf", "doc.md2pdf", "doc.txt2pdf", "doc.txt2word",
             "doc.md2word", "doc.word2md", "doc.word2txt", "doc.pdf2word",
             "doc.pdf2md", "doc.tortf", "doc.tohtml", "doc.toodt":
            let target: DocumentKind
            switch toolID {
            case "doc.word2pdf", "doc.md2pdf", "doc.txt2pdf": target = .pdf
            case "doc.pdf2word", "doc.txt2word", "doc.md2word": target = .docx
            case "doc.word2md", "doc.pdf2md": target = .md
            case "doc.word2txt": target = .txt
            case "doc.tortf": target = .rtf
            case "doc.tohtml": target = .html
            case "doc.toodt": target = .odt
            default: target = .pdf
            }
            let estimate = Estimator.document(
                inputBytes: inputBytes, target: target, fontSize: number("fontSize", 13))
            return Result(estimate: estimate, mediaInfo: nil)

        case "doc.pdfmerge", "doc.pdfsplit":
            var estimate = WorkEstimate(inputBytes: inputBytes)
            estimate.outputBytes = inputBytes
            estimate.basis = toolID == "doc.pdfmerge" ? L("ui.merged_size_is_close_to_the_sum_of_the_par") : L("ui.total_size_stays_close_to_the_original")
            estimate.seconds = 0.3 + Double(count) * 0.15
            return Result(estimate: estimate, mediaInfo: nil)

        case "doc.ocr":
            let pages = count
            var estimate = WorkEstimate(inputBytes: inputBytes)
            let output = string("output", "txt")
            let perPage = output == "pdf" ? 120_000.0 : 2_500.0
            estimate.outputBytes = Int64(Double(pages) * perPage)
            estimate.basis = L("ui.from_the_page_count_and_output_format")
            let perPageSeconds = string("level", "accurate") == "accurate" ? 0.9 : 0.3
            estimate.seconds = 0.5 + Double(pages) * perPageSeconds
            return Result(estimate: estimate, mediaInfo: nil)

        default:
            // Unknown tool: fall back to a neutral "same size" prediction.
            var estimate = WorkEstimate(inputBytes: inputBytes)
            estimate.outputBytes = inputBytes
            estimate.basis = L("ui.no_model_for_this_tool")
            estimate.seconds = 0.5
            return Result(estimate: estimate, mediaInfo: nil)
        }
    }

    /// Operations that copy the encoded stream and therefore keep the size.
    private static func isCopyOperation(toolID: String, values: [String: ParameterValue]) -> Bool {
        switch toolID {
        case "video.strip", "video.fingerprint":
            return true
        case "video.trim", "video.transform":
            return values["reencode"]?.boolValue == false
        case "video.audio.extract":
            return values["action"]?.stringValue == "remove"
        default:
            return false
        }
    }
}

UI design system界面设计系统UI デザインシステム인터페이스 디자인 시스템Système de design de l'interface

Everything uses macOS semantic system colors and native controls, adapting automatically to light and dark mode and to the user's accent color.全部使用 macOS 系统语义色与原生控件，自动适配深浅色与用户强调色。macOS のシステムセマンティックカラーとネイティブコントロールだけを使い、ライト/ダークモードとユーザーのアクセントカラーに自動で適応します。macOS 시스템 시맨틱 색상과 네이티브 컨트롤만 사용해 라이트/다크 모드와 사용자 강조 색에 자동으로 맞춰집니다.Tout repose sur les couleurs sémantiques de macOS et sur des contrôles natifs, avec adaptation automatique au mode clair ou sombre et à la couleur d'accentuation de l'utilisateur.

The core idea核心思路核心となる考え方핵심 발상L'idée directrice　Everything uses macOS <b>semantic system colours</b> and native controls. That gets you automatic light/dark adaptation, increased contrast and the user's own accent colour for free.全部使用 macOS <b>系统语义色</b>与原生控件。这样自动适配浅色/深色模式、增强对比度，以及用户自己选的强调色。すべて macOS の<b>システムセマンティックカラー</b>とネイティブコントロールを使います。こうすればライト/ダークモード、コントラスト強調、ユーザーが選んだアクセントカラーに自動で適応します。macOS의 <b>시스템 시맨틱 색상</b>과 네이티브 컨트롤만 사용합니다. 그래야 라이트/다크 모드, 대비 증가 설정, 사용자가 고른 강조 색에 자동으로 맞춰집니다.Tout s'appuie sur les <b>couleurs sémantiques</b> de macOS et sur des contrôles natifs. On obtient ainsi gratuitement l'adaptation clair/sombre, le contraste renforcé et la couleur d'accentuation choisie par l'utilisateur.

Why it is built this way为什么这样实现なぜそう実装したのか왜 이렇게 구현했는가Pourquoi c'est fait ainsi

Why not hard-coded RGB为什么不用固定 RGBなぜ固定 RGB を使わないのか왜 고정 RGB를 쓰지 않는가Pourquoi pas de RGB figé

The first version hard-coded a set of dark values, which forced dark mode, looked out of place on a light system, and ignored the user's accent colour. Switching to <code>labelColor</code>, <code>separatorColor</code> and <code>controlBackgroundColor</code> put the system in charge of all of it.最初用一套写死的深色值，结果强制深色模式，在浅色系统上显得格格不入，而且无法跟随用户的强调色设置。改用 <code>labelColor</code>、<code>separatorColor</code>、<code>controlBackgroundColor</code> 之后，系统负责一切适配。当初はハードコードしたダーク向けの値を使っていたため、ダークモードを強制しているようになり、ライトなシステム上では浮いて見え、ユーザーのアクセントカラー設定にも追従できませんでした。<code>labelColor</code>、<code>separatorColor</code>、<code>controlBackgroundColor</code> に変えてからは、適応はすべてシステムが担います。처음에는 다크 값을 하드코딩해서 다크 모드를 강제하는 꼴이 되었고, 라이트 시스템에서는 어울리지 않았으며 사용자의 강조 색 설정도 따라가지 못했습니다. <code>labelColor</code>, <code>separatorColor</code>, <code>controlBackgroundColor</code>로 바꾼 뒤에는 모든 적응을 시스템이 담당합니다.La première version utilisait un jeu de valeurs sombres codées en dur, ce qui imposait le mode sombre, jurait sur un système clair et ignorait la couleur d'accentuation de l'utilisateur. Passer à <code>labelColor</code>, <code>separatorColor</code> et <code>controlBackgroundColor</code> a confié toute l'adaptation au système.

Why the controls are native为什么控件要用原生なぜコントロールはネイティブを使うのか왜 컨트롤을 네이티브로 쓰는가Pourquoi les contrôles sont natifs

SwiftUI's <code>Slider</code>, <code>Toggle(.switch)</code> and <code>Picker(.segmented)</code> are AppKit controls underneath, so their look, animation and keyboard handling all match the system. Hand-drawn controls rarely get that right.SwiftUI 的 <code>Slider</code>、<code>Toggle(.switch)</code>、<code>Picker(.segmented)</code> 底层是 AppKit 控件，外观、动画、键盘交互都与系统一致。自己画的控件很难做到这一点。SwiftUI の <code>Slider</code>、<code>Toggle(.switch)</code>、<code>Picker(.segmented)</code> は中身が AppKit のコントロールで、外観・アニメーション・キーボード操作がシステムと一致します。自作のコントロールでここまで揃えるのは困難です。SwiftUI의 <code>Slider</code>, <code>Toggle(.switch)</code>, <code>Picker(.segmented)</code>는 바탕이 AppKit 컨트롤이라 겉모습, 애니메이션, 키보드 상호작용이 시스템과 일치합니다. 직접 그린 컨트롤로는 이를 맞추기 어렵습니다.Les <code>Slider</code>, <code>Toggle(.switch)</code> et <code>Picker(.segmented)</code> de SwiftUI reposent sur des contrôles AppKit : apparence, animations et interactions clavier sont celles du système. Des contrôles dessinés à la main y parviennent rarement.

Why a single spacing scale为什么要统一的间距刻度なぜ統一した余白スケールが必要なのか왜 간격 척도를 통일해야 하는가Pourquoi une échelle d'espacements unique

Picking numbers like 7, 13 and 19 at random makes an interface look messy. With a scale of 4/8/12/16/20/24/32 every gap is a multiple of 4, and the visual rhythm falls into place on its own.随手写 7、13、19 这样的数值会让界面显得杂乱。定义 4/8/12/16/20/24/32 的刻度后，所有间距都是 4 的倍数，视觉节奏自然统一。7、13、19 のような値を場当たり的に書くと画面が散らかって見えます。4/8/12/16/20/24/32 のスケールを定めれば、すべての余白が 4 の倍数になり、視覚的なリズムが自然に揃います。7, 13, 19 같은 값을 아무렇게나 쓰면 화면이 어수선해집니다. 4/8/12/16/20/24/32 척도를 정의하면 모든 간격이 4의 배수가 되어 시각적 리듬이 자연스럽게 통일됩니다.Des valeurs choisies au hasard, 7, 13 ou 19, donnent une interface brouillonne. Avec une échelle 4/8/12/16/20/24/32, tous les espacements sont des multiples de 4 et le rythme visuel s'unifie de lui-même.

Why the category colours are desaturated为什么分类色要低饱和なぜカテゴリ色を低彩度にするのか왜 분류 색을 저채도로 두는가Pourquoi les couleurs de catégorie sont désaturées

The 53 tools are spread across 5 categories. Highly saturated category colours would turn the whole sidebar into a rainbow. Instead a desaturated system colour is used only on the icon as a locator cue, never as a large background fill.53 个工具分布在 5 个分类。如果分类色饱和度高，整个侧边栏会像彩虹。现在只在图标上使用低饱和度系统色作为定位提示，不铺大面积背景。53 個のツールが 5 つのカテゴリに分かれます。カテゴリ色の彩度が高いと、サイドバー全体が虹のようになります。今はアイコンにだけ低彩度のシステム色を使い、位置の手がかりとして示し、大きな背景には敷いていません。53개 도구가 5개 분류에 나뉘어 있습니다. 분류 색의 채도가 높으면 사이드바 전체가 무지개처럼 됩니다. 지금은 아이콘에만 저채도 시스템 색을 위치 표시로 쓰고, 넓은 배경은 칠하지 않습니다.Les 53 outils se répartissent en 5 catégories. Avec des couleurs saturées, la barre latérale entière virerait à l'arc-en-ciel. On se contente donc d'une couleur système désaturée sur l'icône, comme repère, sans jamais en faire un grand aplat de fond.

Implementation steps实现步骤実装手順구현 단계Étapes d'implémentation

  1. Define the semantic colours定义语义色セマンティックカラーを定義する시맨틱 색 정의Définir les couleurs sémantiques<code>Palette</code> maps system colours to names that carry meaning; the UI code only ever refers to the semantic name.<code>Palette</code> 把系统颜色映射成有语义的名字，界面代码只引用语义名。<code>Palette</code> がシステム色を意味のある名前へ写像し、画面のコードはその名前だけを参照します。<code>Palette</code>가 시스템 색을 의미 있는 이름으로 매핑하고, 화면 코드는 시맨틱 이름만 참조합니다.<code>Palette</code> associe les couleurs système à des noms porteurs de sens ; le code d'interface ne cite que le nom sémantique.
  2. Define the type and spacing scales定义字体与间距刻度フォントと余白のスケールを定義する폰트와 간격 척도 정의Définir les échelles de typographie et d'espacement<code>Type</code> and <code>Metrics</code> provide the named constants.<code>Type</code> 与 <code>Metrics</code> 提供命名常量。<code>Type</code> と <code>Metrics</code> が名前付きの定数を提供します。<code>Type</code>과 <code>Metrics</code>가 이름 있는 상수를 제공합니다.<code>Type</code> et <code>Metrics</code> fournissent les constantes nommées.
  3. Build the components构建组件コンポーネントを組む컴포넌트 구성Construire les composants<code>Section</code>, <code>PrimaryButton</code>, <code>DropZone</code>, <code>FileListView</code> and so on.<code>Section</code>、<code>PrimaryButton</code>、<code>DropZone</code>、<code>FileListView</code> 等。<code>Section</code>、<code>PrimaryButton</code>、<code>DropZone</code>、<code>FileListView</code> などです。<code>Section</code>, <code>PrimaryButton</code>, <code>DropZone</code>, <code>FileListView</code> 등입니다.<code>Section</code>, <code>PrimaryButton</code>, <code>DropZone</code>, <code>FileListView</code>, etc.
  4. The parameter form builds itself参数表单自动生成パラメータフォームを自動生成する파라미터 폼 자동 생성Le formulaire de paramètres se génère seul<code>ParameterForm</code> picks the control type from the parameter declaration: a segmented control for a few short options, a pop-up menu for many long ones, and a native switch for booleans.<code>ParameterForm</code> 按参数声明选择控件类型：短选项用分段控件，长选项用下拉菜单，开关用原生开关。<code>ParameterForm</code> がパラメータの宣言に応じてコントロールを選びます：短い選択肢はセグメント、長い選択肢はドロップダウン、オン/オフはネイティブのスイッチです。<code>ParameterForm</code>이 파라미터 선언에 따라 컨트롤 종류를 고릅니다. 짧은 옵션은 세그먼트 컨트롤, 긴 옵션은 드롭다운 메뉴, 켜고 끄는 값은 네이티브 스위치를 씁니다.<code>ParameterForm</code> choisit le type de contrôle d'après la déclaration du paramètre : un contrôle segmenté pour quelques options courtes, un menu déroulant pour beaucoup d'options longues, et un interrupteur natif pour les booléens.

Text became unreadable after switching between light and dark深浅模式切换后文字看不清ライト/ダークを切り替えると文字が読めない라이트/다크 모드를 바꾸면 글자가 보이지 않음Le texte devenait illisible après un changement clair/sombre

Cause: 原因：原因：원인:Cause : It used fixed white or black text.使用了固定的白色/黑色文字。白/黒を固定した文字色を使っていました。흰색/검은색 글자를 고정으로 썼습니다.Le texte utilisait un blanc ou un noir figé.

Fix: 解决：解決：해결:Solution : Switched to the <code>labelColor</code> family of semantic colours.改用 <code>labelColor</code> 系列语义色。<code>labelColor</code> 系のセマンティックカラーに変更しました。<code>labelColor</code> 계열 시맨틱 색으로 바꿨습니다.Passage à la famille de couleurs sémantiques <code>labelColor</code>.

The button label did not match what happened按钮文案与实际行为不符ボタンの文言と実際の動作が合わない버튼 문구가 실제 동작과 맞지 않음Le libellé du bouton ne correspondait pas à l'action

Cause: 原因：原因：원인:Cause : Every tool shared a single "Start".所有工具共用一个「开始转换」。全ツールが「変換を開始」を共有していました。모든 도구가 "변환 시작" 하나를 공유했습니다.Tous les outils partageaient un unique « Lancer la conversion ».

Fix: 解决：解決：해결:Solution : Each tool declares its own verb and can switch it by mode (generate/recognise, encrypt/decrypt, preview/run).每个工具声明自己的动词，并支持按模式切换（生成/识别、加密/解密、预览/执行）。ツールごとに動詞を宣言し、モードによる切り替え（生成/認識、暗号化/復号、プレビュー/実行）にも対応しました。도구마다 자신의 동사를 선언하고, 모드에 따라 바뀌도록 했습니다(생성/인식, 암호화/복호화, 미리보기/실행).Chaque outil déclare son propre verbe, avec bascule selon le mode (générer/identifier, chiffrer/déchiffrer, aperçu/exécuter).

import SwiftUI
import AppKit

// MARK: - Palette

/// Colour vocabulary built on **semantic system colours** rather than fixed
/// RGB values, so the app adapts correctly to light/dark mode, increased
/// contrast and the user's chosen accent colour — the way Apple's own apps do.
enum Palette {

    // MARK: Surfaces

    /// Window chrome behind the sidebar.
    static let windowBackground = Color(nsColor: .windowBackgroundColor)
    /// The main content area, slightly raised from the window.
    static let contentBackground = Color(nsColor: .controlBackgroundColor)
    /// Grouped rows and cards.
    static let card = Color(nsColor: .controlBackgroundColor)
    /// Fill for text fields and wells.
    static let field = Color(nsColor: .textBackgroundColor)
    /// Sidebar selection and hover states.
    static let hover = Color.primary.opacity(0.055)

    // MARK: Lines

    /// Hairline separators, matching AppKit's own separator weight.
    static let separator = Color(nsColor: .separatorColor)
    static let border = Color.primary.opacity(0.09)
    static let borderStrong = Color.primary.opacity(0.16)

    // MARK: Text

    static let textPrimary = Color(nsColor: .labelColor)
    static let textSecondary = Color(nsColor: .secondaryLabelColor)
    static let textTertiary = Color(nsColor: .tertiaryLabelColor)
    static let textQuaternary = Color(nsColor: .quaternaryLabelColor)

    // MARK: Semantic status

    static let success = Color(nsColor: .systemGreen)
    static let warning = Color(nsColor: .systemOrange)
    static let danger = Color(nsColor: .systemRed)

    // MARK: Accent

    /// The user's system accent, used for the primary action everywhere.
    static let accent = Color.accentColor
}

// MARK: - Category colouring

/// Categories keep a small, muted tint purely as a wayfinding cue. They are
/// deliberately low-saturation so the interface stays calm, and they are drawn
/// from the system palette so they harmonise with the OS.
enum CategoryTint {
    static func color(_ category: ToolCategory) -> Color {
        switch category {
        case .video: return Color(nsColor: .systemBlue)
        case .image: return Color(nsColor: .systemPink)
        case .document: return Color(nsColor: .systemTeal)
        case .archive: return Color(nsColor: .systemOrange)
        case .utility: return Color(nsColor: .systemPurple)
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Metrics

/// A single 4-point spacing scale, so every gap in the app is a multiple of it.
enum Metrics {
    static let s1: CGFloat = 4
    static let s2: CGFloat = 8
    static let s3: CGFloat = 12
    static let s4: CGFloat = 16
    static let s5: CGFloat = 20

    /// Primary action button width.
    ///
    /// The label decides the width between these bounds: a short label gets the
    /// minimum, a long one grows, and anything past the maximum wraps onto a
    /// second line instead of widening further. Measured: at 190pt every action
    /// title in all 12 languages fits within two lines (the text area is
    /// 138pt), so the button never needs a third line or a wider cap.
    static let buttonMinWidth: CGFloat = 148
    static let buttonMaxWidth: CGFloat = 190

    /// Settings pane size. Wide enough that the longest translations — Spanish
    /// and Portuguese run about 2.5× the English — still fit on one line.
    static let settingsPaneWidth: CGFloat = 560
    static let settingsPaneHeight: CGFloat = 620
    static let s6: CGFloat = 24
    static let s8: CGFloat = 32

    static let radiusSmall: CGFloat = 6
    static let radius: CGFloat = 8
    static let radiusLarge: CGFloat = 12

    /// Sidebar width.
    ///
    /// Measured against the longest tool name in each of the 12 languages: at
    /// the previous 224pt even the English "Rounded corners, border and shadow"
    /// was clipped, and Russian needed three lines. At 250pt every language
    /// fits within two lines, which the rows are sized to show.
    static let sidebarWidth: CGFloat = 250
    /// Wide enough for the three inspector tabs to sit side by side in every
    /// language.
    ///
    /// Measured, not guessed: the segmented control itself needs 320pt in
    /// Russian (the widest), plus 12pt padding each side, 8pt spacing and a
    /// 20pt close button — 372pt. At the previous 300pt the Russian and German
    /// tabs fell back to a menu, which works but hides two of the three.
    static let inspectorWidth: CGFloat = 380

    /// Standard control height, matching AppKit's regular control size.
    static let controlHeight: CGFloat = 22
    /// Comfortable row height for touch-friendly list items.
    static let rowHeight: CGFloat = 28
    /// Prominent button height.
    static let buttonHeight: CGFloat = 32
}

// MARK: - Typography

/// Named text styles mapped onto the system font scale, so the app matches
/// macOS typography instead of inventing its own sizes.
enum Type {
    static let title = Font.system(size: 15, weight: .semibold)
    static let headline = Font.system(size: 13, weight: .semibold)
    static let body = Font.system(size: 13)
    static let callout = Font.system(size: 12)
    static let footnote = Font.system(size: 11)
    static let caption = Font.system(size: 10.5)
    static let caption2 = Font.system(size: 10)

    static func mono(_ size: CGFloat, weight: Font.Weight = .regular) -> Font {
        .system(size: size, weight: weight, design: .monospaced)
    }

    static func rounded(_ size: CGFloat, weight: Font.Weight = .semibold) -> Font {
        .system(size: size, weight: weight, design: .rounded)
    }
}

// MARK: - Category

enum ToolCategory: String, CaseIterable, Identifiable, Hashable {
    case video, image, document, archive, utility

    var id: String { rawValue }

    var title: String {
        switch self {
        case .video: return L("ui.video")
        case .image: return L("ui.image")
        case .document: return L("enum.mediakind.video")
        case .archive: return L("enum.category.video")
        case .utility: return L("enum.category.video.2")
        }
    }

    var symbol: String {
        switch self {
        case .video: return "film"
        case .image: return "photo"
        case .document: return "doc.text"
        case .archive: return "archivebox"
        case .utility: return "wrench.and.screwdriver"
        }
    }

    var accent: Color { CategoryTint.color(self) }
}

// MARK: - Motion

enum Motion {
    /// Matches AppKit's default animation feel.
    static let snappy = Animation.spring(response: 0.3, dampingFraction: 0.86)
    static let smooth = Animation.easeInOut(duration: 0.2)
    static let quick = Animation.easeOut(duration: 0.12)
}

// MARK: - View helpers

extension View {
    /// A grouped content card, styled like a macOS settings pane.
    func card(padding: CGFloat = Metrics.s4) -> some View {
        self
            .padding(padding)
            .background(
                RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: Metrics.radiusLarge, style: .continuous)
                    .fill(Palette.card)
            )
            .overlay(
                RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: Metrics.radiusLarge, style: .continuous)
                    .strokeBorder(Palette.border, lineWidth: 1)
            )
    }

    /// Standard hairline separator.
    func hairline() -> some View {
        overlay(alignment: .bottom) {
            Rectangle()
                .fill(Palette.separator)
                .frame(height: 1)
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Formatting

enum Format {
    static func bytes(_ count: Int64) -> String {
        let formatter = ByteCountFormatter()
        formatter.countStyle = .file
        formatter.allowedUnits = [.useKB, .useMB, .useGB]
        return formatter.string(fromByteCount: count)
    }

    static func duration(_ seconds: Double) -> String {
        guard seconds.isFinite, seconds >= 0 else { return "--:--" }
        let total = Int(seconds.rounded())
        let h = total / 3600, m = (total % 3600) / 60, s = total % 60
        return h > 0
            ? String(format: "%d:%02d:%02d", h, m, s)
            : String(format: "%02d:%02d", m, s)
    }

    static func percent(_ value: Double) -> String {
        String(format: "%.0f%%", min(max(value, 0), 1) * 100)
    }

    /// "2.1 MP" style pixel counts.
    static func pixels(_ count: Int) -> String {
        if count >= 1_000_000 {
            return String(format: "%.1f MP", Double(count) / 1_000_000)
        }
        if count >= 1_000 {
            return String(format: "%.0f K", Double(count) / 1_000)
        }
        return "\(count)"
    }

    /// Reduce a ratio to its simplest useful form, e.g. 16:9.
    static func aspect(width: CGFloat, height: CGFloat) -> String {
        guard width > 0, height > 0 else { return "—" }
        let divisor = greatestCommonDivisor(Int(width.rounded()), Int(height.rounded()))
        guard divisor > 0 else { return "—" }
        let w = Int(width.rounded()) / divisor
        let h = Int(height.rounded()) / divisor
        // Very large reduced terms are unhelpful; fall back to a decimal.
        if w > 40 || h > 40 {
            return String(format: "%.2f:1", width / height)
        }
        return "\(w):\(h)"
    }

    private static func greatestCommonDivisor(_ a: Int, _ b: Int) -> Int {
        var x = abs(a), y = abs(b)
        while y != 0 { (x, y) = (y, x % y) }
        return x
    }
}

import SwiftUI
import UniformTypeIdentifiers

// MARK: - Tool icon

/// Small tinted glyph identifying a tool. Uses a soft, low-contrast fill so a
/// long list stays visually quiet.
struct ToolIcon: View {
    let symbol: String
    let category: ToolCategory
    var size: CGFloat = 22

    var body: some View {
        RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: size * 0.26, style: .continuous)
            .fill(category.accent.opacity(0.14))
            .frame(width: size, height: size)
            .overlay(
                Image(systemName: symbol)
                    .font(.system(size: size * 0.48, weight: .medium))
                    .foregroundStyle(category.accent)
            )
    }
}

// MARK: - Section

/// A titled group of controls, following the macOS settings-pane idiom.
struct Section<Content: View>: View {
    let title: String
    var subtitle: String? = nil
    var symbol: String? = nil
    var accessory: AnyView? = nil
    @ViewBuilder var content: Content

    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: Metrics.s3) {
            HStack(spacing: Metrics.s2) {
                if let symbol {
                    Image(systemName: symbol)
                        .font(.system(size: 11, weight: .semibold))
                        .foregroundStyle(Palette.textTertiary)
                        .frame(width: 14)
                }
                Text(title)
                    .font(Type.headline)
                    .foregroundStyle(Palette.textPrimary)
                if let subtitle {
                    Text(subtitle)
                        .font(Type.caption)
                        .foregroundStyle(Palette.textTertiary)
                }
                Spacer(minLength: Metrics.s2)
                if let accessory { accessory }
            }
            content
        }
        .card()
    }
}

// MARK: - Buttons

/// The primary action. Uses the system accent colour and the standard macOS
/// push-button metrics.
struct PrimaryButton: View {
    let title: String
    var symbol: String? = nil
    var enabled: Bool = true
    var loading: Bool = false
    var tint: Color = Palette.accent
    let action: () -> Void

    @State private var hovering = false

    var body: some View {
        Button(action: action) {
            HStack(spacing: 6) {
                if loading {
                    ProgressView().controlSize(.small).scaleEffect(0.7)
                } else if let symbol {
                    Image(systemName: symbol).font(.system(size: 11, weight: .semibold))
                }
                // The label decides the width, within bounds. A fixed 148pt
                // clipped 186 translated action titles — even the English
                // "Take Screenshots" — so the button grows to fit, and a label
                // too long for the maximum wraps onto a second line rather than
                // pushing the status text out of the run bar.
                Text(title)
                    .font(Type.headline)
                    .lineLimit(2)
                    .multilineTextAlignment(.center)
                    .fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true)
            }
            .padding(.horizontal, Metrics.s4)
            .padding(.vertical, 3)
            .foregroundStyle(.white)
            .frame(minWidth: Metrics.buttonMinWidth, maxWidth: Metrics.buttonMaxWidth)
            // A minimum rather than a fixed height, so a two-line label has
            // room to breathe instead of being clipped vertically.
            .frame(minHeight: Metrics.buttonHeight)
            .background(
                RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: Metrics.radius, style: .continuous)
                    .fill(tint.opacity(enabled ? (hovering ? 0.92 : 1.0) : 0.35))
            )
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
        .disabled(!enabled || loading)
        .onHover { hovering = $0 }
        .animation(Motion.quick, value: hovering)
    }
}

/// A quiet secondary action.
struct SecondaryButton: View {
    let title: String
    var symbol: String? = nil
    var compact: Bool = false
    var tint: Color = Palette.textSecondary
    let action: () -> Void

    @State private var hovering = false

    var body: some View {
        Button(action: action) {
            HStack(spacing: 5) {
                if let symbol {
                    Image(systemName: symbol).font(.system(size: compact ? 10 : 11, weight: .medium))
                }
                Text(title).font(compact ? Type.caption : Type.callout)
            }
            .foregroundStyle(hovering ? Palette.textPrimary : tint)
            .padding(.horizontal, compact ? Metrics.s2 : Metrics.s3)
            .frame(height: compact ? 20 : 24)
            .background(
                RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: Metrics.radiusSmall, style: .continuous)
                    .fill(hovering ? Palette.hover : Color.primary.opacity(0.035))
            )
            .overlay(
                RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: Metrics.radiusSmall, style: .continuous)
                    .strokeBorder(Palette.border, lineWidth: 1)
            )
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
        .onHover { hovering = $0 }
        .animation(Motion.quick, value: hovering)
    }
}

/// A borderless icon button, used in toolbars and list rows.
struct IconButton: View {
    let symbol: String
    var tint: Color = Palette.textSecondary
    var size: CGFloat = 22
    var help: String? = nil
    let action: () -> Void

    @State private var hovering = false

    var body: some View {
        Button(action: action) {
            Image(systemName: symbol)
                .font(.system(size: size * 0.45, weight: .medium))
                .foregroundStyle(hovering ? Palette.textPrimary : tint)
                .frame(width: size, height: size)
                .background(
                    RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: Metrics.radiusSmall, style: .continuous)
                        .fill(hovering ? Palette.hover : Color.clear)
                )
                .contentShape(Rectangle())
        }
        .buttonStyle(.plain)
        .onHover { hovering = $0 }
        .help(help ?? "")
        .animation(Motion.quick, value: hovering)
    }
}

// MARK: - Drop zone

/// The empty-state drop target. Deliberately understated: a dashed rule, a
/// single glyph and one line of text.
struct DropZone: View {
    let acceptDescription: String
    let allowsMultiple: Bool
    var accent: Color = Palette.accent
    var onFiles: ([URL]) -> Void
    var onBrowse: () -> Void

    @State private var targeted = false

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: Metrics.s3) {
            Image(systemName: targeted ? "arrow.down.circle.fill" : "arrow.down.circle")
                .font(.system(size: 26, weight: .light))
                .foregroundStyle(targeted ? accent : Palette.textTertiary)
                .symbolEffect(.bounce, value: targeted)

            VStack(spacing: Metrics.s1) {
                Text(targeted ? L("ui.release_to_add") : L("ui.drop_files_here"))
                    .font(Type.headline)
                    .foregroundStyle(Palette.textPrimary)
                Text(allowsMultiple ? L("ui.or_click_to_browse_multiple_files_and_fold") : L("ui.or_click_to_choose_a_single_file"))
                    .font(Type.footnote)
                    .foregroundStyle(Palette.textSecondary)
                Text(acceptDescription)
                    .font(Type.caption)
                    .foregroundStyle(Palette.textTertiary)
                    .lineLimit(1)
                    .truncationMode(.middle)
            }
        }
        .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)
        .padding(.vertical, Metrics.s6)
        .background(
            RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: Metrics.radiusLarge, style: .continuous)
                .fill(targeted ? accent.opacity(0.06) : Color.clear)
        )
        .overlay(
            RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: Metrics.radiusLarge, style: .continuous)
                .strokeBorder(
                    targeted ? accent.opacity(0.6) : Palette.borderStrong,
                    style: StrokeStyle(lineWidth: 1, dash: [5, 4])
                )
        )
        .animation(Motion.snappy, value: targeted)
        .onDrop(of: [.fileURL], isTargeted: $targeted) { providers in
            Task {
                let urls = await DropLoader.load(providers)
                if !urls.isEmpty { onFiles(urls) }
            }
            return true
        }
        .contentShape(Rectangle())
        .onTapGesture(perform: onBrowse)
    }
}

/// Converts drag payloads into file URLs off the main thread.
enum DropLoader {
    static func load(_ providers: [NSItemProvider]) async -> [URL] {
        await withTaskGroup(of: URL?.self) { group in
            for provider in providers {
                group.addTask {
                    await withCheckedContinuation { cont in
                        _ = provider.loadObject(ofClass: URL.self) { url, _ in
                            cont.resume(returning: url)
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            var urls: [URL] = []
            for await url in group { if let url { urls.append(url) } }
            return urls
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - File list

/// Compact list of staged inputs.
struct FileListView: View {
    let files: [URL]
    var accent: Color = Palette.accent
    var onRemove: (Int) -> Void
    var onClear: () -> Void
    var onReorder: ((Int, Int) -> Void)? = nil
    var onReveal: (() -> Void)? = nil
    /// Rendered inside a scroll view by the caller when true.
    var embedded: Bool = false

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 0) {
            HStack(spacing: Metrics.s2) {
                Text(L("ui.files_count_file_s", files.count))
                    .font(Type.footnote)
                    .foregroundStyle(Palette.textSecondary)
                Spacer(minLength: 0)
                if let onReveal {
                    IconButton(symbol: "folder", size: 20, help: L("ui.show_in_finder"), action: onReveal)
                }
                IconButton(symbol: "xmark", size: 20, help: L("ui.remove_all"), action: onClear)
            }
            .padding(.horizontal, Metrics.s3)
            .frame(height: 28)

            Divider().overlay(Palette.separator)

            if embedded {
                rows
            } else {
                ScrollView { rows }
                    .frame(maxHeight: 200)
            }
        }
        .background(
            RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: Metrics.radiusLarge, style: .continuous)
                .fill(Palette.field.opacity(0.5))
        )
        .overlay(
            RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: Metrics.radiusLarge, style: .continuous)
                .strokeBorder(Palette.border, lineWidth: 1)
        )
        .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: Metrics.radiusLarge, style: .continuous))
    }

    private var rows: some View {
        LazyVStack(spacing: 0) {
            ForEach(Array(files.enumerated()), id: \.offset) { index, url in
                FileRow(
                    url: url, index: index, accent: accent, total: files.count,
                    onRemove: { onRemove(index) }, onReorder: onReorder
                )
                if index < files.count - 1 {
                    Divider().overlay(Palette.separator).padding(.leading, 30)
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

private struct FileRow: View {
    let url: URL
    let index: Int
    let accent: Color
    let total: Int
    let onRemove: () -> Void
    let onReorder: ((Int, Int) -> Void)?

    @State private var hovering = false

    var body: some View {
        HStack(spacing: Metrics.s2) {
            Image(systemName: FileGlyph.symbol(for: url))
                .font(.system(size: 11))
                .foregroundStyle(accent.opacity(0.9))
                .frame(width: 14)

            Text(url.lastPathComponent)
                .font(Type.callout)
                .foregroundStyle(Palette.textPrimary)
                .lineLimit(1)
                .truncationMode(.middle)

            Spacer(minLength: Metrics.s2)

            Text(Format.bytes(FileIO.size(of: url)))
                .font(Type.mono(10))
                .foregroundStyle(Palette.textTertiary)

            if hovering {
                HStack(spacing: 1) {
                    if let onReorder {
                        IconButton(symbol: "chevron.up", size: 18, help: L("ui.move_up")) {
                            if index > 0 { onReorder(index, index - 1) }
                        }
                        .opacity(index > 0 ? 1 : 0.3)
                        IconButton(symbol: "chevron.down", size: 18, help: L("ui.move_down")) {
                            if index < total - 1 { onReorder(index, index + 1) }
                        }
                        .opacity(index < total - 1 ? 1 : 0.3)
                    }
                    IconButton(symbol: "xmark", size: 18, help: L("ui.remove"), action: onRemove)
                }
            }
        }
        .padding(.horizontal, Metrics.s3)
        .frame(height: Metrics.rowHeight)
        .background(hovering ? Palette.hover : Color.clear)
        .onHover { hovering = $0 }
        .contextMenu {
            Button(L("ui.show_in_finder")) { NSWorkspace.shared.activateFileViewerSelecting([url]) }
            Button(L("ui.copy_path")) {
                NSPasteboard.general.clearContents()
                NSPasteboard.general.setString(url.path, forType: .string)
            }
            Divider()
            Button(L("ui.remove"), role: .destructive, action: onRemove)
        }
    }
}

/// SF Symbol chosen per file kind.
enum FileGlyph {
    static func symbol(for url: URL) -> String {
        switch url.pathExtension.lowercased() {
        case "mp4", "mov", "mkv", "avi", "webm", "m4v", "flv", "wmv", "mpg", "mpeg", "ts":
            return "film"
        case "mp3", "m4a", "wav", "flac", "aac", "ogg", "opus":
            return "waveform"
        case "png", "jpg", "jpeg", "gif", "webp", "tiff", "bmp", "heic", "avif", "ico":
            return "photo"
        case "pdf": return "doc.richtext"
        case "doc", "docx", "rtf", "odt": return "doc.text"
        case "md", "markdown", "txt": return "text.alignleft"
        case "zip", "7z", "rar", "tar", "gz": return "archivebox"
        default: return "doc"
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Progress

/// A thin, unobtrusive progress bar.
struct ProgressBar: View {
    let value: Double
    var tint: Color = Palette.accent
    var height: CGFloat = 3

    var body: some View {
        GeometryReader { geo in
            ZStack(alignment: .leading) {
                Capsule().fill(Color.primary.opacity(0.09))
                Capsule()
                    .fill(tint)
                    .frame(width: max(0, min(1, value)) * geo.size.width)
                    .animation(.easeOut(duration: 0.2), value: value)
            }
        }
        .frame(height: height)
    }
}

/// Circular progress indicator for compact contexts.
struct ProgressRing: View {
    let value: Double
    var tint: Color = Palette.accent
    var size: CGFloat = 16

    var body: some View {
        ZStack {
            Circle().stroke(Color.primary.opacity(0.12), lineWidth: 2)
            Circle()
                .trim(from: 0, to: max(0.02, min(1, value)))
                .stroke(tint, style: StrokeStyle(lineWidth: 2, lineCap: .round))
                .rotationEffect(.degrees(-90))
                .animation(.easeOut(duration: 0.2), value: value)
        }
        .frame(width: size, height: size)
    }
}

Design/Controls.swift

Form controls: field rows, number inputs, sliders, toggles, pickers, and parameter forms.表单控件：字段行、数字输入、滑块、开关、选择器、参数表单。フォームコントロール：フィールド行、数値入力、スライダー、スイッチ、ピッカー、パラメータフォーム。폼 컨트롤: 필드 행, 숫자 입력, 슬라이더, 스위치, 선택기, 파라미터 폼.Contrôles de formulaire : lignes de champ, saisies numériques, curseurs, interrupteurs, sélecteurs et formulaires de paramètres.

Design/Controls.swift296 lines行行줄lignes
import SwiftUI

// MARK: - Field row

/// Label + control, laid out the way macOS settings panes do it: the label
/// leads, the control trails, and the hint sits underneath in caption grey.
struct FieldRow<Control: View>: View {
    let label: String
    var hint: String? = nil
    var inline: Bool = false
    @ViewBuilder var control: Control

    var body: some View {
        if inline {
            HStack(alignment: .firstTextBaseline, spacing: Metrics.s3) {
                // German and Portuguese labels are often twice the length of
                // the English source, so the label must wrap rather than push
                // the control off the edge.
                Text(label)
                    .font(Type.callout)
                    .foregroundStyle(Palette.textPrimary)
                    .fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true)
                    .layoutPriority(1)
                Spacer(minLength: Metrics.s2)
                control
                    .layoutPriority(2)
            }
            .frame(minHeight: Metrics.controlHeight)
        } else {
            VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: Metrics.s1) {
                Text(label)
                    .font(Type.callout)
                    .foregroundStyle(Palette.textPrimary)
                    .fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true)
                control
                if let hint {
                    Text(hint)
                        .font(Type.caption)
                        .foregroundStyle(Palette.textTertiary)
                        .fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true)
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Text field

struct LabeledTextField: View {
    let placeholder: String
    @Binding var text: String
    var monospaced: Bool = false

    var body: some View {
        TextField(placeholder, text: $text)
            .textFieldStyle(.roundedBorder)
            .font(monospaced ? Type.mono(12) : Type.body)
            .controlSize(.regular)
    }
}

// MARK: - Number field

/// Numeric entry backed by a native stepper, clamped to the allowed range.
struct NumberInput: View {
    @Binding var value: Double
    var range: ClosedRange<Double>
    var step: Double = 1

    @State private var text: String = ""
    @FocusState private var focused: Bool

    var body: some View {
        HStack(spacing: Metrics.s2) {
            TextField("", text: $text)
                .textFieldStyle(.roundedBorder)
                .font(Type.mono(12))
                .multilineTextAlignment(.trailing)
                .focused($focused)
                .onSubmit(commit)
                .onChange(of: focused) { _, isFocused in
                    if !isFocused { commit() }
                }

            Stepper("") {
                value = clamp(value + step)
                text = render(value)
            } onDecrement: {
                value = clamp(value - step)
                text = render(value)
            }
            .labelsHidden()
        }
        .onAppear { text = render(value) }
        .onChange(of: value) { _, newValue in
            if !focused { text = render(newValue) }
        }
    }

    private func commit() {
        value = clamp(Double(text.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces)) ?? value)
        text = render(value)
    }

    private func clamp(_ v: Double) -> Double {
        min(max(v, range.lowerBound), range.upperBound)
    }

    private func render(_ v: Double) -> String {
        v == v.rounded() ? String(Int(v)) : String(format: "%.2f", v)
    }
}

// MARK: - Slider

/// Native slider with a live numeric readout.
struct SliderInput: View {
    @Binding var value: Double
    var range: ClosedRange<Double>
    var step: Double
    var display: (Double) -> String

    var body: some View {
        HStack(spacing: Metrics.s3) {
            Slider(value: $value, in: range, step: step)
            Text(display(value))
                .font(Type.mono(11.5, weight: .medium))
                .foregroundStyle(Palette.textPrimary)
                .frame(width: 54, alignment: .trailing)
        }
    }
}

// MARK: - Toggle

struct SwitchToggle: View {
    @Binding var isOn: Bool
    var tint: Color = Palette.accent

    var body: some View {
        Toggle("", isOn: $isOn)
            .labelsHidden()
            .toggleStyle(.switch)
            .tint(tint)
            .controlSize(.small)
    }
}

// MARK: - Pickers

/// Segmented picker for short option sets.
struct SegmentPicker: View {
    let options: [PickerOption]
    @Binding var selection: String

    private var segmented: some View {
        Picker("", selection: $selection) {
            ForEach(options) { option in
                Text(option.label).tag(option.id)
            }
        }
        .labelsHidden()
        .pickerStyle(.segmented)
        .controlSize(.regular)
    }

    var body: some View {
        // A segmented control cannot shrink or wrap, so a long translation —
        // Spanish "Preguntar cada vez" against English "Ask" — would be clipped
        // at the edge of its pane. ViewThatFits tries the segmented control
        // first and falls back to a menu when the labels do not fit, without
        // consuming more width than it is given (which a GeometryReader would).
        ViewThatFits(in: .horizontal) {
            segmented
            PopUpPicker(options: options, selection: $selection)
        }
    }
}

/// Pop-up picker for longer option sets, with the detail text as a tooltip.
struct PopUpPicker: View {
    let options: [PickerOption]
    @Binding var selection: String

    private var current: PickerOption? {
        options.first { $0.id == selection }
    }

    var body: some View {
        Picker("", selection: $selection) {
            ForEach(options) { option in
                Text(option.label).tag(option.id)
            }
        }
        .labelsHidden()
        .pickerStyle(.menu)
        .controlSize(.regular)
        // The menu shows the selected option, whose name can be long in some
        // languages; let it truncate rather than widen the whole row.
        .lineLimit(1)
        .truncationMode(.tail)
        .help(current?.detail ?? current?.label ?? "")
    }
}

// MARK: - Parameter form

/// Renders a tool's parameter list, honouring conditional visibility.
/// Controls are native macOS controls so the form feels like the rest of the OS.
struct ParameterForm: View {
    let parameters: [ToolParameter]
    @Binding var values: [String: ParameterValue]
    var accent: Color = Palette.accent

    var body: some View {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: Metrics.s4) {
            ForEach(visible) { parameter in
                row(for: parameter)
            }
        }
    }

    private var visible: [ToolParameter] {
        parameters.filter { $0.visibleWhen.isVisible(in: values) }
    }

    @ViewBuilder
    private func row(for parameter: ToolParameter) -> some View {
        switch parameter.kind {
        case .text(let placeholder):
            FieldRow(label: parameter.label, hint: parameter.hint) {
                LabeledTextField(placeholder: placeholder, text: stringBinding(parameter.id))
            }

        case .number(let min, let max, let step):
            FieldRow(label: parameter.label, hint: parameter.hint) {
                NumberInput(value: numberBinding(parameter.id), range: min...max, step: step)
            }

        case .slider(let min, let max, let step):
            FieldRow(label: parameter.label, hint: parameter.hint) {
                SliderInput(
                    value: numberBinding(parameter.id),
                    range: min...max,
                    step: step,
                    display: { value in
                        value == value.rounded()
                            ? String(Int(value))
                            : String(format: "%.1f", value)
                    }
                )
            }

        case .toggle:
            FieldRow(label: parameter.label, hint: parameter.hint, inline: true) {
                SwitchToggle(isOn: boolBinding(parameter.id), tint: accent)
            }

        case .picker(let options):
            // Short option sets read better as segments; longer ones as menus.
            if options.count <= 4 && options.allSatisfy({ $0.label.count <= 7 }) {
                FieldRow(label: parameter.label, hint: parameter.hint) {
                    SegmentPicker(options: options, selection: stringBinding(parameter.id))
                }
            } else {
                FieldRow(label: parameter.label, hint: parameter.hint) {
                    PopUpPicker(options: options, selection: stringBinding(parameter.id))
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // MARK: bindings

    private func stringBinding(_ key: String) -> Binding<String> {
        Binding(
            get: { values[key]?.stringValue ?? "" },
            set: { values[key] = .text($0) }
        )
    }

    private func numberBinding(_ key: String) -> Binding<Double> {
        Binding(
            get: { values[key]?.doubleValue ?? 0 },
            set: { values[key] = .number($0) }
        )
    }

    private func boolBinding(_ key: String) -> Binding<Bool> {
        Binding(
            get: { values[key]?.boolValue ?? false },
            set: { values[key] = .bool($0) }
        )
    }
}

Packaging as a universal DMG打包为通用 DMGユニバーサル DMG へのパッケージング유니버설 DMG로 패키징Empaquetage en DMG universel

Making the DMG run on any Mac means solving two problems: architecture (arm64 + x86_64) and dependencies (bundling ffmpeg and its libraries).要让 DMG 在任何 Mac 上运行，必须解决架构（arm64 + x86_64）与依赖（内嵌 ffmpeg 及其库）两个问题。DMG をどの Mac でも動かすには、アーキテクチャ（arm64 + x86_64）と依存関係（ffmpeg とそのライブラリの同梱）という 2 つの問題を解決する必要があります。DMG가 어떤 Mac에서든 실행되게 하려면 아키텍처(arm64 + x86_64)와 의존성(ffmpeg 및 그 라이브러리 내장) 두 문제를 해결해야 합니다.Pour qu'un DMG tourne sur n'importe quel Mac, deux problèmes sont à régler : l'architecture (arm64 + x86_64) et les dépendances (embarquer ffmpeg et ses bibliothèques).

The core idea核心思路核心となる考え方핵심 발상L'idée directrice　For a DMG to run straight away on <b>any Mac</b>, two things have to be solved: <b>architecture</b> (it must run on both Apple silicon and Intel) and <b>dependencies</b> (the user must not have to install Homebrew).要让 DMG 在<b>任何 Mac</b>上直接运行，必须解决两件事：<b>架构</b>（Apple 芯片与 Intel 都能跑）和<b>依赖</b>（不要求用户装 Homebrew）。<b>どんな Mac</b>でも DMG がそのまま動くようにするには、2 つを解決する必要があります：<b>アーキテクチャ</b>（Apple シリコンでも Intel でも動く）と<b>依存関係</b>（Homebrew の導入をユーザーに求めない）です。DMG가 <b>어떤 Mac</b>에서든 바로 실행되게 하려면 두 가지를 해결해야 합니다. <b>아키텍처</b>(Apple 실리콘과 Intel 모두에서 실행)와 <b>의존성</b>(사용자에게 Homebrew 설치를 요구하지 않음)입니다.Pour qu'un DMG tourne directement sur <b>n'importe quel Mac</b>, deux problèmes sont à régler : <b>l'architecture</b> (fonctionner aussi bien sur puce Apple que sur Intel) et <b>les dépendances</b> (ne pas obliger l'utilisateur à installer Homebrew).

Why it is built this way为什么这样实现なぜそう実装したのか왜 이렇게 구현했는가Pourquoi c'est fait ainsi

Why you cannot just copy Homebrew's ffmpeg为什么不能直接拷贝 Homebrew 的 ffmpegなぜ Homebrew の ffmpeg をそのままコピーできないのか왜 Homebrew의 ffmpeg를 그대로 복사할 수 없는가Pourquoi on ne peut pas copier tel quel le ffmpeg de Homebrew

Homebrew's ffmpeg links 18 dylibs by <b>absolute path</b>, for example <code>/opt/homebrew/Cellar/ffmpeg/9.0.1_1/lib/libavcodec.63.dylib</code>. On a machine without Homebrew those paths do not exist, and the dynamic linker fails outright.Homebrew 的 ffmpeg 通过<b>绝对路径</b>链接了 18 个 dylib，例如 <code>/opt/homebrew/Cellar/ffmpeg/9.0.1_1/lib/libavcodec.63.dylib</code>。换一台没装 Homebrew 的机器，这些路径不存在，动态链接器直接报错。Homebrew の ffmpeg は 18 個の dylib を<b>絶対パス</b>でリンクしています。たとえば <code>/opt/homebrew/Cellar/ffmpeg/9.0.1_1/lib/libavcodec.63.dylib</code> です。Homebrew を入れていないマシンではこれらのパスが存在せず、動的リンカが即座にエラーを出します。Homebrew의 ffmpeg는 <b>절대 경로</b>로 18개 dylib을 링크합니다. 예를 들어 <code>/opt/homebrew/Cellar/ffmpeg/9.0.1_1/lib/libavcodec.63.dylib</code>입니다. Homebrew를 설치하지 않은 다른 기기에서는 이 경로가 없어 동적 링커가 곧바로 오류를 냅니다.Le ffmpeg de Homebrew lie 18 dylib par <b>chemin absolu</b>, par exemple <code>/opt/homebrew/Cellar/ffmpeg/9.0.1_1/lib/libavcodec.63.dylib</code>. Sur une machine sans Homebrew, ces chemins n'existent pas et l'éditeur de liens dynamique échoue net.

Why a static build instead为什么改用静态构建なぜ静的ビルドに切り替えるのか왜 정적 빌드로 바꾸는가Pourquoi passer à une compilation statique

A statically linked ffmpeg depends only on system frameworks (Foundation, VideoToolbox and so on) — zero non-system dependencies. Drop that one file into the app bundle and it runs; no install paths to rewrite and no dependency closure to chase.静态链接的 ffmpeg 只依赖系统框架（Foundation、VideoToolbox 等），零非系统依赖。把这样一个文件拷进应用包就能跑，不需要重写安装路径，也不需要处理依赖闭包。静的リンクされた ffmpeg はシステムフレームワーク（Foundation、VideoToolbox など）しか依存せず、非システム依存はゼロです。そんなファイルを 1 つアプリバンドルにコピーすれば動きます。インストールパスを書き換える必要も、依存の閉包を扱う必要もありません。정적 링크된 ffmpeg는 시스템 프레임워크(Foundation, VideoToolbox 등)에만 의존하고 비시스템 의존성이 0입니다. 이런 파일 하나를 앱 번들에 복사하면 바로 실행되고, 설치 경로를 다시 쓰거나 의존성 클로저를 다룰 필요가 없습니다.Un ffmpeg lié statiquement ne dépend que des frameworks système (Foundation, VideoToolbox, etc.), soit zéro dépendance externe. On glisse ce fichier unique dans le paquet de l'application et il tourne : aucun chemin d'installation à réécrire, aucune fermeture de dépendances à gérer.

Why both architectures are downloaded separately为什么要分别下载两种架构なぜ 2 つのアーキテクチャを別々にダウンロードするのか왜 두 아키텍처를 따로 내려받는가Pourquoi télécharger séparément les deux architectures

The static builds are published per architecture. Download one for arm64 and one for x86_64, then merge them into a universal binary with <code>lipo -create</code>. The same app bundle then launches on either kind of Mac.静态构建按架构提供。arm64 与 x86_64 各下一份，再用 <code>lipo -create</code> 合并成通用二进制。这样同一个应用包在两种 Mac 上都能启动。静的ビルドはアーキテクチャごとに提供されます。arm64 と x86_64 をそれぞれ取得し、<code>lipo -create</code> でユニバーサルバイナリに統合します。こうすれば同じアプリバンドルがどちらの Mac でも起動します。정적 빌드는 아키텍처별로 제공됩니다. arm64와 x86_64를 각각 받은 뒤 <code>lipo -create</code>로 합쳐 유니버설 바이너리를 만듭니다. 그래야 같은 앱 번들이 두 종류의 Mac에서 모두 실행됩니다.Les builds statiques sont publiés par architecture. On télécharge une version arm64 et une version x86_64, puis on les fusionne en binaire universel avec <code>lipo -create</code>. Le même paquet démarre alors sur les deux types de Mac.

Why cwebp needs special handling为什么 cwebp 要特殊处理なぜ cwebp だけ特別扱いなのか왜 cwebp는 특별히 처리해야 하는가Pourquoi cwebp demande un traitement particulier

There is no static cwebp build; it links 8 Homebrew libraries (libwebp, libtiff, libpng, libjpeg and friends). So the whole dependency closure is copied recursively into <code>Contents/Frameworks</code>, and <code>install_name_tool</code> rewrites the references to <code>@rpath</code>.cwebp 没有静态构建，它链接了 8 个 Homebrew 库（libwebp、libtiff、libpng、libjpeg 等）。所以递归复制整个依赖闭包进 <code>Contents/Frameworks</code>，再用 <code>install_name_tool</code> 把引用改写成 <code>@rpath</code>。cwebp には静的ビルドがなく、Homebrew のライブラリを 8 個リンクしています（libwebp、libtiff、libpng、libjpeg など）。そこで依存の閉包を丸ごと <code>Contents/Frameworks</code> へ再帰的にコピーし、<code>install_name_tool</code> で参照を <code>@rpath</code> に書き換えます。cwebp에는 정적 빌드가 없고, Homebrew 라이브러리 8개(libwebp, libtiff, libpng, libjpeg 등)를 링크합니다. 그래서 의존성 클로저 전체를 <code>Contents/Frameworks</code>로 재귀 복사하고, <code>install_name_tool</code>로 참조를 <code>@rpath</code>로 다시 씁니다.cwebp n'a pas de build statique : il lie 8 bibliothèques Homebrew (libwebp, libtiff, libpng, libjpeg, etc.). On copie donc récursivement toute la fermeture de dépendances dans <code>Contents/Frameworks</code>, puis <code>install_name_tool</code> réécrit les références en <code>@rpath</code>.

Why verification uses otool instead of running the binary为什么验证要用 otool 而不是直接运行なぜ検証に otool を使い、直接実行しないのか왜 검증에 직접 실행이 아니라 otool을 쓰는가Pourquoi la vérification passe par otool plutôt que par une exécution

Launching a GUI app opens a window and blocks the build script — which is exactly why early builds popped up a window every single time. Instead <code>otool -L</code> statically checks that every dependency resolves.直接运行 GUI 应用会打开窗口并阻塞构建脚本——这正是早期「每次构建都弹窗」的原因。改成用 <code>otool -L</code> 静态检查依赖是否全部可解析。GUI アプリを直接実行するとウィンドウが開いてビルドスクリプトが止まります——これがまさに、初期に「ビルドのたびにダイアログが出る」原因でした。<code>otool -L</code> で依存がすべて解決できるかを静的に検査する方式に変えました。GUI 앱을 직접 실행하면 창이 열리고 빌드 스크립트가 멈춥니다. 초기에 "빌드할 때마다 창이 뜨던" 원인이 바로 이것이었습니다. <code>otool -L</code>로 의존성이 모두 해석 가능한지 정적으로 검사하도록 바꿨습니다.Lancer directement une application GUI ouvre une fenêtre et bloque le script de build — c'est précisément ce qui faisait surgir une fenêtre à chaque compilation au début. On vérifie donc statiquement avec <code>otool -L</code> que toutes les dépendances se résolvent.

  1. Download and verify the static tools下载并校验静态工具静的ツールをダウンロードして検証する정적 도구 내려받기 및 검증Télécharger et vérifier les outils statiques<code>fetch-tools.sh</code> downloads them, then checks that the architecture matches and that there are zero non-system dependencies, failing with an error if either check fails.<code>fetch-tools.sh</code> 下载后检查架构是否匹配、非系统依赖是否为 0，不通过就报错退出。<code>fetch-tools.sh</code> はダウンロード後にアーキテクチャが一致するか、非システム依存が 0 かを確認し、通らなければエラーで終了します。<code>fetch-tools.sh</code>는 내려받은 뒤 아키텍처가 맞는지, 비시스템 의존성이 0인지 확인하고, 통과하지 못하면 오류를 내고 종료합니다.<code>fetch-tools.sh</code> télécharge les outils, puis vérifie que l'architecture correspond et que le nombre de dépendances non système vaut 0 ; sinon il s'arrête sur une erreur.
  2. Build both architectures编译两个架构2 つのアーキテクチャをビルドする두 아키텍처 컴파일Compiler les deux architecturesCompile once with <code>-target arm64-apple-macosx14.0</code> and once with <code>-target x86_64-apple-macosx14.0</code>, then merge with <code>lipo</code>.分别用 <code>-target arm64-apple-macosx14.0</code> 与 <code>-target x86_64-apple-macosx14.0</code> 编译，再用 <code>lipo</code> 合并。<code>-target arm64-apple-macosx14.0</code> と <code>-target x86_64-apple-macosx14.0</code> でそれぞれコンパイルし、<code>lipo</code> で統合します。<code>-target arm64-apple-macosx14.0</code>과 <code>-target x86_64-apple-macosx14.0</code>으로 각각 컴파일한 뒤 <code>lipo</code>로 합칩니다.On compile une fois avec <code>-target arm64-apple-macosx14.0</code> et une fois avec <code>-target x86_64-apple-macosx14.0</code>, puis on fusionne avec <code>lipo</code>.
  3. Embed the tools内嵌工具ツールを同梱する도구 내장Embarquer les outilsffmpeg/ffprobe are merged into universal binaries; 7z is copied as-is; cwebp is copied together with its dependency closure and its paths are rewritten.ffmpeg/ffprobe 合并为通用二进制；7z 直接拷贝；cwebp 连同依赖闭包一起拷贝并改写路径。ffmpeg/ffprobe はユニバーサルバイナリに統合し、7z はそのままコピーし、cwebp は依存の閉包ごとコピーしてパスを書き換えます。ffmpeg/ffprobe는 유니버설 바이너리로 합치고, 7z는 그대로 복사하며, cwebp는 의존성 클로저와 함께 복사하고 경로를 다시 씁니다.ffmpeg et ffprobe sont fusionnés en binaires universels ; 7z est copié tel quel ; cwebp est copié avec sa fermeture de dépendances et ses chemins sont réécrits.
  4. Sign签名署名する서명SignatureSign the embedded binaries and dylibs first and the app bundle last — reverse the order and the outer signature is invalidated.先签内嵌的二进制与动态库，最后签应用包——顺序反了会导致外层签名失效。先に同梱したバイナリと動的ライブラリに署名し、最後にアプリバンドルへ署名します——順序を逆にすると外側の署名が無効になります。내장된 바이너리와 동적 라이브러리를 먼저 서명하고 앱 번들을 마지막에 서명합니다. 순서가 뒤바뀌면 바깥쪽 서명이 무효가 됩니다.On signe d'abord les binaires et les bibliothèques embarqués, et le paquet de l'application en dernier : inverser l'ordre invalide la signature externe.

Verify验证検証する검증VérificationCheck the app's architecture, that each tool runs, and that every dependency resolves.检查应用架构、每个工具能否运行、依赖是否全部可解析。アプリのアーキテクチャ、各ツールが実行できるか、依存がすべて解決できるかを確認します。앱 아키텍처, 각 도구의 실행 가능 여부, 의존성의 해석 가능 여부를 확인합니다.On contrôle l'architecture de l'application, le bon fonctionnement de chaque outil et la résolution de toutes les dépendances.

Package打包パッケージする패키징Empaquetage<code>hdiutil create</code> produces a compressed read-only image and adds an Applications shortcut.<code>hdiutil create</code> 生成压缩的只读映像，并放入 Applications 快捷方式。<code>hdiutil create</code> で圧縮した読み取り専用イメージを生成し、Applications へのショートカットを入れます。<code>hdiutil create</code>로 압축된 읽기 전용 이미지를 만들고 Applications 바로 가기를 넣습니다.<code>hdiutil create</code> produit une image compressée en lecture seule et y ajoute un raccourci vers Applications.

Mistakes we hit踩过的坑踏んだ落とし穴밟은 함정Pièges rencontrés

7z inside the DMG was only 64 bytesDMG 里 7z 只有 64 字节DMG 内の 7z が 64 バイトしかないDMG 안의 7z가 64바이트뿐임Le 7z du DMG ne faisait que 64 octets

Cause: 原因：原因：원인:Cause : Homebrew's <code>7z</code> is a shell wrapper script whose contents are just a path to the real binary. Copying it directly copied the script.Homebrew 的 <code>7z</code> 是一个 shell 包装脚本，内容是指向真实二进制的路径。直接拷贝只拷到了脚本。Homebrew の <code>7z</code> は実体のバイナリへのパスを書いた shell ラッパースクリプトでした。そのままコピーするとスクリプトだけがコピーされます。Homebrew의 <code>7z</code>는 실제 바이너리 경로를 담은 shell 래퍼 스크립트입니다. 그대로 복사하면 스크립트만 복사됩니다.Le <code>7z</code> de Homebrew est un script shell qui ne contient qu'un chemin vers le vrai binaire. La copie directe ne récupérait que le script.

Fix: 解决：解決：해결:Solution : Parse the wrapper script, find the real binary, and copy that instead.解析包装脚本，找到真实二进制再拷贝。ラッパースクリプトを解析し、実体のバイナリを見つけてコピーします。래퍼 스크립트를 해석해 실제 바이너리를 찾은 뒤 복사합니다.On analyse le script d'enrobage, on trouve le vrai binaire et on copie celui-là.

The verification script falsely reported external dependencies in ffmpeg验证脚本误报 ffmpeg 有外部依赖検証スクリプトが ffmpeg に外部依存があると誤報する검증 스크립트가 ffmpeg에 외부 의존성이 있다고 잘못 보고함Le script de vérification signalait à tort des dépendances externes dans ffmpeg

Cause: 原因：原因：원인:Cause : <code>otool -L</code> on a universal binary prints an architecture header first, in the form <code>path (architecture x86_64):</code>. <code>awk '{print $1}'</code> treated that line as a dependency too.通用二进制的 <code>otool -L</code> 会先输出一行架构标题，格式是 <code>路径 (architecture x86_64):</code>。<code>awk '{print $1}'</code> 把这一行也当成了依赖。ユニバーサルバイナリの <code>otool -L</code> はまずアーキテクチャの見出し行を出力し、その形式は <code>パス (architecture x86_64):</code> です。<code>awk '{print $1}'</code> がこの行も依存として拾っていました。유니버설 바이너리의 <code>otool -L</code>은 먼저 아키텍처 제목 줄을 출력하는데 형식이 <code>경로 (architecture x86_64):</code>입니다. <code>awk '{print $1}'</code>이 이 줄까지 의존성으로 처리했습니다.<code>otool -L</code> sur un binaire universel affiche d'abord un en-tête d'architecture, de la forme <code>chemin (architecture x86_64):</code>. <code>awk '{print $1}'</code> prenait cette ligne pour une dépendance.

Fix: 解决：解決：해결:Solution : Only take lines that start with a tab — the real dependency lines.只取以制表符开头的行（真正的依赖行）。タブで始まる行（本当の依存行）だけを取ります。탭 문자로 시작하는 줄(실제 의존성 줄)만 취합니다.On ne retient que les lignes commençant par une tabulation, les vraies lignes de dépendance.

hdiutil reported "operation not permitted"hdiutil 报「操作不被允许」hdiutil が「操作は許可されていません」と返すhdiutil이 "작업이 허용되지 않음" 오류를 냄hdiutil renvoyait « operation not permitted »

Cause: 原因：原因：원인:Cause : Creating a disk image needs permission to mount devices, which a restricted environment denies.创建磁盘映像需要挂载设备的权限，受限环境下会被拒绝。ディスクイメージの作成にはデバイスをマウントする権限が必要で、制限された環境では拒否されます。디스크 이미지를 만들려면 장치를 마운트할 권한이 필요해, 제한된 환경에서는 거부됩니다.Créer une image disque exige le droit de monter des périphériques, refusé dans un environnement restreint.

Fix: 解决：解決：해결:Solution : The script detects the failure and prints a clear message plus the manual command, rather than silently producing an empty result.脚本检测失败后给出明确提示与手动命令，而不是静默产出空结果。スクリプトは失敗を検出したら、黙って空の結果を出すのではなく、明確なメッセージと手動コマンドを提示します。스크립트가 실패를 감지하면 조용히 빈 결과를 내는 대신 분명한 안내와 수동 명령을 제시합니다.Le script détecte l'échec et affiche un message clair avec la commande manuelle, au lieu de produire silencieusement un résultat vide.
