Core/ProcessRunner.swift

Subprocess wrapper: tool lookup (bundled builds first), streaming output, and cancellation.子进程封装：工具定位（内嵌优先）、流式输出、可取消。子プロセスのラッパー：ツールの特定（同梱を優先）、ストリーミング出力、キャンセル可能。자식 프로세스 래퍼: 도구 탐색(내장본 우선), 스트리밍 출력, 취소 가능.Encapsulation des sous-processus : localisation des outils (versions embarquées d'abord), sortie en flux et annulation.

Core/ProcessRunner.swift298 lines行行줄lignes
import Foundation

/// Result of a finished child process.
struct ProcessResult: Sendable {
    var exitCode: Int32
    var stdout: String
    var stderr: String
    var cancelled: Bool

    var ok: Bool { exitCode == 0 && !cancelled }
}

enum ProcessError: LocalizedError {
    case launchFailed(String)
    case missingTool(String)
    case failed(code: Int32, message: String)
    case cancelled

    var errorDescription: String? {
        switch self {
        case .launchFailed(let m): return L("enum.processerror.cancelled", m)
        case .missingTool(let t): return L("enum.processerror.cancelled.2", t)
        case .failed(let code, let message):
            let trimmed = message.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
            // The detail is appended only when present, so the two languages
            // can phrase the prefix independently.
            let detail = trimmed.isEmpty ? "" : ":\n" + String(trimmed.suffix(600))
            return detail.isEmpty
                ? L("error.failed.short", code)
                : L("error.failed", code, detail)
        case .cancelled: return L("ui.cancelled")
        }
    }
}

/// A cancellable handle around a running child process.
final class ProcessHandle: @unchecked Sendable {
    private let lock = NSLock()
    private var process: Process?
    private var _cancelled = false

    var isCancelled: Bool {
        lock.lock(); defer { lock.unlock() }
        return _cancelled
    }

    fileprivate func attach(_ p: Process) {
        lock.lock()
        process = p
        let alreadyCancelled = _cancelled
        lock.unlock()
        if alreadyCancelled { p.terminate() }
    }

    func cancel() {
        lock.lock()
        _cancelled = true
        let p = process
        lock.unlock()
        p?.terminate()
    }
}

/// Thin, allocation-light wrapper over `Process` that streams stdout/stderr
/// incrementally so callers can parse live progress (ffmpeg `-progress`).
enum ProcessRunner {

    /// Locate an executable across the usual Homebrew + system locations.
    /// GUI apps inherit a minimal PATH, so we must probe explicitly.
    static let searchPaths = [
        "/opt/homebrew/bin", "/usr/local/bin", "/usr/bin", "/bin",
        "/usr/sbin", "/sbin", "/opt/homebrew/sbin", "/usr/local/sbin",
    ]

    /// Tools bundled inside the app (Resources/Tools). Checked first so the
    /// app works on a machine with no Homebrew at all.
    static var bundledToolsDirectory: URL? {
        guard let resources = Bundle.main.resourceURL else { return nil }
        let directory = resources.appendingPathComponent("Tools", isDirectory: true)
        var isDirectory: ObjCBool = false
        guard FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: directory.path, isDirectory: &isDirectory),
              isDirectory.boolValue else { return nil }
        return directory
    }

    /// True when the app shipped its own copies of the external tools.
    static var isSelfContained: Bool {
        guard let directory = bundledToolsDirectory else { return false }
        return FileManager.default.fileExists(
            atPath: directory.appendingPathComponent("ffmpeg").path)
    }

    static var cache: [String: String?] = [:]
    static let cacheLock = NSLock()

    static func locate(_ tool: String) -> String? {
        if tool.hasPrefix("/") {
            return FileManager.default.isExecutableFile(atPath: tool) ? tool : nil
        }
        cacheLock.lock()
        if let hit = cache[tool] { cacheLock.unlock(); return hit }
        cacheLock.unlock()

        var found: String?

        // 1. A copy bundled inside the app always wins: it makes the DMG work
        //    on machines without Homebrew, and guarantees a known version.
        if let directory = bundledToolsDirectory {
            let candidate = directory.appendingPathComponent(tool).path
            if FileManager.default.isExecutableFile(atPath: candidate) {
                found = candidate
            }
        }

        // 2. A user-specified path (Settings) overrides the system search.
        if found == nil, tool == "ffmpeg" || tool == "ffprobe" {
            let custom = AppSettings.shared.customFFmpegPath
            if !custom.isEmpty {
                let directory = (custom as NSString).deletingLastPathComponent
                let candidate = directory + "/" + tool
                if FileManager.default.isExecutableFile(atPath: candidate) {
                    found = candidate
                }
            }
        }

        // 3. Fall back to the system / Homebrew installations.
        if found == nil {
            for dir in searchPaths {
                let candidate = dir + "/" + tool
                if FileManager.default.isExecutableFile(atPath: candidate) {
                    found = candidate
                    break
                }
            }
        }

        cacheLock.lock(); cache[tool] = found; cacheLock.unlock()
        return found
    }

    static func exists(_ tool: String) -> Bool { locate(tool) != nil }

    /// Environment with a PATH that includes Homebrew so child tools can find
    /// their own dependencies.
    static var environment: [String: String] {
        var env = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment
        env["PATH"] = searchPaths.joined(separator: ":")
        env["LC_ALL"] = "en_US.UTF-8"
        env["LANG"] = "en_US.UTF-8"
        // Keep ffmpeg quiet and non-interactive.
        env["AV_LOG_FORCE_NOCOLOR"] = "1"
        return env
    }

    /// Run a tool to completion, streaming each stdout line to `onLine`.
    /// `stderr` is captured separately (ffmpeg logs there, progress on stdout).
    @discardableResult
    static func run(
        _ tool: String,
        _ arguments: [String],
        handle: ProcessHandle? = nil,
        onStdout: (@Sendable (String) -> Void)? = nil,
        onStderr: (@Sendable (String) -> Void)? = nil
    ) async throws -> ProcessResult {
        guard let path = locate(tool) else { throw ProcessError.missingTool(tool) }

        let process = Process()
        process.executableURL = URL(fileURLWithPath: path)
        process.arguments = arguments
        process.environment = environment
        process.standardInput = FileHandle.nullDevice

        let outPipe = Pipe(), errPipe = Pipe()
        process.standardOutput = outPipe
        process.standardError = errPipe

        let collector = LineCollector()
        outPipe.fileHandleForReading.readabilityHandler = { fh in
            let data = fh.availableData
            guard !data.isEmpty else { return }
            collector.append(data, isStdout: true, sink: onStdout)
        }
        errPipe.fileHandleForReading.readabilityHandler = { fh in
            let data = fh.availableData
            guard !data.isEmpty else { return }
            collector.append(data, isStdout: false, sink: onStderr)
        }

        do {
            try process.run()
        } catch {
            outPipe.fileHandleForReading.readabilityHandler = nil
            errPipe.fileHandleForReading.readabilityHandler = nil
            throw ProcessError.launchFailed(error.localizedDescription)
        }
        handle?.attach(process)

        // Await termination without blocking a cooperative thread.
        await withCheckedContinuation { (cont: CheckedContinuation<Void, Never>) in
            process.terminationHandler = { _ in cont.resume() }
        }

        outPipe.fileHandleForReading.readabilityHandler = nil
        errPipe.fileHandleForReading.readabilityHandler = nil
        // Drain anything buffered after the handler was removed.
        collector.append(outPipe.fileHandleForReading.readDataToEndOfFile(), isStdout: true, sink: onStdout)
        collector.append(errPipe.fileHandleForReading.readDataToEndOfFile(), isStdout: false, sink: onStderr)

        let cancelled = handle?.isCancelled ?? false
        return ProcessResult(
            exitCode: process.terminationStatus,
            stdout: collector.stdout,
            stderr: collector.stderr,
            cancelled: cancelled
        )
    }

    /// Run a tool while mirroring its output into a job log.
    @discardableResult
    static func runLogged(
        _ tool: String,
        _ arguments: [String],
        handle: ProcessHandle? = nil,
        logger: JobLogger,
        onStdout: (@Sendable (String) -> Void)? = nil
    ) async throws -> ProcessResult {
        logger.commandLines(tool, arguments)
        let result = try await run(
            tool, arguments, handle: handle,
            onStdout: onStdout,
            onStderr: { line in
                let trimmed = line.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces)
                guard !trimmed.isEmpty else { return }
                logger.output(trimmed)
            })
        if !result.ok && !result.cancelled {
            logger.error(L("ui.tool_exited_with_code_result_exitcode", tool, result.exitCode))
        }
        return result
    }

    /// Convenience for short, non-streaming calls such as `ffprobe`.
    static func capture(_ tool: String, _ arguments: [String]) async throws -> String {
        let result = try await run(tool, arguments)
        guard result.ok else {
            throw ProcessError.failed(code: result.exitCode, message: result.stderr)
        }
        return result.stdout
    }
}

/// Thread-safe line splitter shared by the pipe readability handlers.
private final class LineCollector: @unchecked Sendable {
    private let lock = NSLock()
    private var outBuf = Data()
    private var errBuf = Data()
    private var _stdout = ""
    private var _stderr = ""

    var stdout: String { lock.lock(); defer { lock.unlock() }; return _stdout }
    var stderr: String { lock.lock(); defer { lock.unlock() }; return _stderr }

    func append(_ data: Data, isStdout: Bool, sink: (@Sendable (String) -> Void)?) {
        guard !data.isEmpty else { return }
        lock.lock()
        if isStdout { outBuf.append(data) } else { errBuf.append(data) }

        var lines: [String] = []
        if isStdout {
            lines = Self.drain(&outBuf)
            _stdout += lines.joined(separator: "\n")
            if !lines.isEmpty { _stdout += "\n" }
        } else {
            lines = Self.drain(&errBuf)
            _stderr += lines.joined(separator: "\n")
            if !lines.isEmpty { _stderr += "\n" }
        }
        lock.unlock()

        guard let sink else { return }
        for line in lines { sink(line) }
    }

    /// Split complete lines out of the buffer, leaving a partial tail behind.
    private static func drain(_ buffer: inout Data) -> [String] {
        var lines: [String] = []
        while let idx = buffer.firstIndex(of: 0x0A) {
            let slice = buffer[buffer.startIndex..<idx]
            if let text = String(data: slice, encoding: .utf8) {
                lines.append(text.trimmingCharacters(in: CharacterSet(charactersIn: "\r")))
            }
            buffer.removeSubrange(buffer.startIndex...idx)
        }
        return lines
    }
}

How it works实现原理実装の仕組み구현 원리Comment ça marche

Transcoding comes down to <b>getting three layers of parameters right</b>: the encoder decides quality and file size, the container decides compatibility, and the two have to agree.转码的核心是<b>三层参数的正确组合</b>：编码器决定画质与体积，容器决定兼容性，两者必须匹配。トランスコードの核心は<b>3 層パラメータの正しい組み合わせ</b>です。エンコーダが画質とサイズを、コンテナが互換性を決め、両者が噛み合っていなければなりません。트랜스코딩의 핵심은 <b>세 층 파라미터의 올바른 조합</b>입니다. 인코더가 화질과 용량을 정하고, 컨테이너가 호환성을 정하며, 둘은 반드시 맞아야 합니다.Le transcodage tient à <b>la bonne combinaison de trois couches de paramètres</b> : l'encodeur décide de la qualité et du poids, le conteneur de la compatibilité, et les deux doivent s'accorder.
  1. Read the target encoder and container extension from the parameters.从参数里取出目标编码器与容器扩展名。パラメータから目的のエンコーダとコンテナ拡張子を取り出します。파라미터에서 대상 인코더와 컨테이너 확장자를 꺼냅니다.On récupère l'encodeur cible et l'extension du conteneur dans les paramètres.
  2. Validate the pair: VP9/AV1 can only go into WebM or MKV, so picking MP4 switches the container to WebM automatically; conversely, H.264 with WebM switches back to MP4.检查合法性：VP9/AV1 只能进 WebM 或 MKV，选了 MP4 就自动改成 WebM；反之 H.264 选了 WebM 就改回 MP4。妥当性を確認：VP9/AV1 は WebM か MKV にしか入らないので、MP4 が選ばれていれば WebM に自動変更します。逆に H.264 で WebM が選ばれていれば MP4 に戻します。유효성을 검사합니다. VP9/AV1은 WebM이나 MKV에만 들어갈 수 있어 MP4를 고르면 자동으로 WebM으로 바꾸고, 반대로 H.264에 WebM을 고르면 MP4로 되돌립니다.On valide le couple : VP9/AV1 ne peuvent aller que dans WebM ou MKV, donc choisir MP4 bascule automatiquement le conteneur sur WebM ; inversement, H.264 avec WebM revient sur MP4.
  3. Build the video arguments: software encoding uses <code>-crf</code> + <code>-preset</code>, hardware encoding uses <code>-q:v</code>.组装视频参数：软件编码用 <code>-crf</code> + <code>-preset</code>，硬件编码用 <code>-q:v</code>。映像パラメータを組む：ソフトウェアエンコードは <code>-crf</code> + <code>-preset</code>、ハードウェアエンコードは <code>-q:v</code>。비디오 파라미터를 조립합니다. 소프트웨어 인코딩은 <code>-crf</code> + <code>-preset</code>, 하드웨어 인코딩은 <code>-q:v</code>를 씁니다.On assemble les arguments vidéo : l'encodage logiciel utilise <code>-crf</code> + <code>-preset</code>, l'encodage matériel <code>-q:v</code>.
  4. Build the audio arguments: stream copy (<code>-c:a copy</code>) is supported so we skip pointless re-encoding.组装音频参数：支持直接复制（<code>-c:a copy</code>）以避免无谓的重新编码。音声パラメータを組む：無駄な再エンコードを避けるため、直接コピー（<code>-c:a copy</code>）にも対応します。오디오 파라미터를 조립합니다. 불필요한 재인코딩을 피하도록 그대로 복사(<code>-c:a copy</code>)하는 것도 지원합니다.On assemble les arguments audio : la copie directe (<code>-c:a copy</code>) est prise en charge, ce qui évite un réencodage inutile.
  5. For MP4/MOV, add <code>-movflags +faststart</code> to move the index to the head of the file, so playback can start before the whole file has downloaded.MP4/MOV 加 <code>-movflags +faststart</code>，把索引移到文件头，这样边下边播时不必等整个文件下载完。MP4/MOV には <code>-movflags +faststart</code> を付け、索引をファイル先頭へ移します。こうすればストリーミング再生時に全体のダウンロード完了を待たずに済みます。MP4/MOV에는 <code>-movflags +faststart</code>를 붙여 인덱스를 파일 앞부분으로 옮깁니다. 그래야 스트리밍 재생 시 파일 전체를 내려받지 않아도 됩니다.Pour MP4/MOV, on ajoute <code>-movflags +faststart</code> afin de déplacer l'index en tête de fichier : la lecture en flux n'attend alors plus le téléchargement complet.
Further notes补充说明補足보충 설명Remarques complémentaires
  • The automatic container correction is deliberate: rather than let ffmpeg fail with a cryptic error, we adjust to what the user actually meant.容器自动纠正是有意为之：与其让 ffmpeg 报一个难懂的错，不如按用户意图调整。コンテナの自動訂正は意図的なものです：ffmpeg に分かりにくいエラーを出させるより、ユーザーの意図に沿って調整するほうが良いと考えています。컨테이너 자동 교정은 의도한 동작입니다. ffmpeg가 알아듣기 어려운 오류를 내게 하는 것보다 사용자 의도에 맞춰 조정하는 편이 낫습니다.La correction automatique du conteneur est délibérée : plutôt que de laisser ffmpeg échouer sur une erreur obscure, on s'aligne sur l'intention de l'utilisateur.
  • Quality defaults to CRF 23 (the sweet spot for H.264) and the preset defaults to medium.画质参数默认 CRF 23（H.264 的经验甜点），预设默认 medium。画質パラメータの既定は CRF 23（H.264 の経験的なスイートスポット）で、プリセットの既定は medium です。화질 파라미터의 기본값은 CRF 23(H.264의 경험적 최적점)이고, 프리셋 기본값은 medium입니다.La qualité est réglée par défaut sur CRF 23 (le point d'équilibre éprouvé du H.264) et le preset sur medium.

            .picker("scale", L("ui.dimensions"), default: "original", options: VideoOptions.scale),
            .number("customWidth", L("video.screenshot.param.customWidth.label"), default: 1280, min: 16, max: 7680,
                    visibleWhen: .equals("scale", "custom")),
        ],
        run: { context in
            var outputs: [URL] = []
            for (index, input) in context.inputs.enumerated() {
                try context.checkCancelled()
                let duration = await MediaProbe.duration(input)
                let codec = VideoCodec(rawValue: context.choice("codec", "h264")) ?? .h264
                let audioCodec = AudioCodec(rawValue: context.choice("audioCodec", "aac")) ?? .aac

                var ext = context.choice("container", "mp4")
                // WebM cannot carry H.264; align the container with the codec.
                if codec == .vp9 || codec == .av1 {
                    if !["webm", "mkv"].contains(ext) { ext = "webm" }
                } else if ext == "webm" {
                    ext = "mp4"
                }

                let output = context.output(index: index, ext: ext, suffix: "")
                var args: [String] = []
                args += VideoSupport.qualityArguments(context, codec: codec)
                args += VideoSupport.geometryArguments(context)
                args += FFmpeg.audioArgs(
                    codec: audioCodec,
                    bitrateKbps: context.int("audioBitrate", 192)
                )
                if context.settings.keepMetadata {
                    args += ["-map_metadata", "0"]
                }
                if ext == "mp4" || ext == "mov" {
                    args += ["-movflags", "+faststart"]
                }

                context.progress.note(L("video.convert.param.customWidth.label", input.lastPathComponent))
                let produced = try await VideoSupport.encode(
                    context, input: input, output: output,
                    arguments: args, duration: duration)
                outputs.append(produced)
            }
            return outputs
        }
    ) }

How it works实现原理実装の仕組み구현 원리Comment ça marche

Three compression strategies, because they answer three different questions: "how low can the quality go", "how many MB is the hard limit", and "what bitrate do we target".提供三种压缩策略，因为它们回答的是三个不同的问题：「画质能接受多低」「必须小于多少 MB」「码率定多少」。3 つの圧縮戦略を用意しています。それぞれが別の問いに答えるからです：「画質はどこまで落とせるか」「何 MB 未満に収めるか」「ビットレートをいくつにするか」。세 가지 압축 전략을 제공합니다. 서로 다른 세 가지 질문에 대한 답이기 때문입니다. "화질을 어디까지 낮춰도 되는가", "반드시 몇 MB 이하여야 하는가", "비트레이트를 얼마로 정할까".Trois stratégies de compression, parce qu'elles répondent à trois questions distinctes : « jusqu'où la qualité peut-elle descendre », « quelle taille en Mo ne pas dépasser » et « quel débit viser ».
  1. By quality: set CRF directly and let the encoder decide the file size.按画质：直接指定 CRF，体积由编码器决定。画質優先：CRF を直接指定し、サイズはエンコーダが決めます。화질 기준: CRF를 직접 지정하고 용량은 인코더가 정합니다.Par qualité : on fixe directement le CRF et l'encodeur décide du poids.
  2. By target size: first derive the total bitrate from <code>(target MB * 8 * 1024) / duration</code>, subtract the audio bitrate to get the video bitrate, then approach it with two-pass encoding.按目标体积：先用 <code>(目标MB × 8 × 1024) ÷ 时长</code> 反推总码率，减去音频码率得到视频码率，再用两遍编码逼近。目標サイズ優先：まず <code>(目標MB × 8 × 1024) ÷ 長さ</code> から合計ビットレートを逆算し、音声ビットレートを引いて映像ビットレートを求め、2 パスエンコードで近づけます。목표 용량 기준: 먼저 <code>(목표MB × 8 × 1024) ÷ 길이</code>로 총 비트레이트를 역산하고, 오디오 비트레이트를 빼서 비디오 비트레이트를 구한 뒤 2패스 인코딩으로 접근합니다.Par taille cible : on déduit d'abord le débit total de <code>(Mo cible × 8 × 1024) ÷ durée</code>, on soustrait le débit audio pour obtenir le débit vidéo, puis on s'en approche en deux passes.
  3. By bitrate: set the average bitrate directly.按码率：直接指定平均码率。ビットレート優先：平均ビットレートを直接指定します。비트레이트 기준: 평균 비트레이트를 직접 지정합니다.Par débit : on impose directement le débit moyen.
  4. Two-pass encoding only makes sense for software H.264 - hardware encoders don't support it - so this branch runs an analysis pass first (writing to <code>/dev/null</code>) and then the real encode.两遍编码只对软件 H.264 有意义——硬件编码器不支持两遍，所以这条分支会先跑一遍分析（输出到 <code>/dev/null</code>），再跑正式编码。2 パスエンコードが意味を持つのはソフトウェア H.264 だけです——ハードウェアエンコーダは 2 パスに対応しないため、この分岐では先に解析パスを 1 回走らせ（出力は <code>/dev/null</code>）、それから本番のエンコードを行います。2패스 인코딩은 소프트웨어 H.264에서만 의미가 있습니다. 하드웨어 인코더는 2패스를 지원하지 않으므로, 이 분기는 분석 패스(출력은 <code>/dev/null</code>)를 먼저 돌린 뒤 실제 인코딩을 돌립니다.L'encodage en deux passes n'a de sens qu'avec le H.264 logiciel — les encodeurs matériels ne le gèrent pas — donc cette branche lance d'abord une passe d'analyse (écrite vers <code>/dev/null</code>), puis l'encodage réel.
Further notes补充说明補足보충 설명Remarques complémentaires
  • Target-size mode reserves 2% for container overhead, otherwise the result tends to overshoot slightly.目标体积模式预留 2% 给容器开销，否则容易超一点点。目標サイズモードではコンテナのオーバーヘッドに 2% を確保します。そうしないと少し超えてしまいがちです。목표 용량 모드는 컨테이너 오버헤드로 2%를 남겨 둡니다. 그러지 않으면 조금 넘기기 쉽습니다.Le mode taille cible réserve 2 % pour le surcoût du conteneur, sinon on dépasse légèrement.
  • In two-pass encoding, <code>-pass 1</code> and <code>-pass 2</code> must be two separate commands; they can't be crammed into one.两遍编码的第一遍必须把 <code>-pass 1</code> 和 <code>-pass 2</code> 分开成两条命令，不能塞在同一条里。2 パスエンコードの 1 パス目は <code>-pass 1</code> と <code>-pass 2</code> を別々のコマンドに分ける必要があり、1 本にまとめることはできません。2패스 인코딩의 첫 번째 패스는 <code>-pass 1</code>과 <code>-pass 2</code>를 반드시 두 개의 명령으로 나눠야 하고, 한 명령에 넣으면 안 됩니다.En deux passes, <code>-pass 1</code> et <code>-pass 2</code> doivent former deux commandes distinctes ; impossible de les réunir dans une seule.

    static var tool: Tool { Tool(
        id: "video.compress",
        name: L("video.compress.name"),
        summary: L("video.compress.summary"),
        symbol: "arrow.down.right.and.arrow.up.left",
        category: .video,
        accepts: ["mp4", "mov", "mkv", "avi", "webm", "flv", "wmv", "m4v", "mpg", "mpeg", "ts"],
                requiresFFmpeg: true,
        actionTitle: L("archive.create.action"),
        parameters: [
            .picker("mode", L("image.compress.param.mode.label"), default: "quality", options: [
                .init("quality", L("image.compress.param.mode.label.2"), detail: L("video.compress.param.mode.label")),
                .init("size", L("image.compress.param.mode.label.3"), detail: L("video.compress.param.mode.label.2")),
                .init("bitrate", L("video.compress.param.mode.label.3"), detail: L("video.compress.param.mode.label.4")),
            ]),
            .slider("crf", L("video.fromimages.param.crf.label"), default: 26, min: 14, max: 40, step: 1,
                    hint: L("video.compress.param.crf.hint"),
                    visibleWhen: .equals("mode", "quality")),
            .number("targetSize", L("video.compress.param.targetSize.label"), default: 20, min: 1, max: 100_000, step: 1,
                    visibleWhen: .equals("mode", "size")),
            .number("videoBitrate", L("video.compress.param.videoBitrate.label"), default: 2500, min: 100, max: 200_000, step: 100,
                    visibleWhen: .equals("mode", "bitrate")),
            .picker("scale", L("ui.dimensions"), default: "original", options: VideoOptions.scale),
            .number("customWidth", L("video.screenshot.param.customWidth.label"), default: 1280, min: 16, max: 7680,
                    visibleWhen: .equals("scale", "custom")),
            .picker("codec", L("video.fromimages.param.codec.label"), default: "h264", options: [
                .init("h264", "H.264", detail: L("enum.codec.h264")),
                .init("hevc", "H.265", detail: L("enum.codec.h264.2")),
                .init("av1", "AV1", detail: L("video.compress.param.codec.label")),
            ]),
            .picker("audioCodec", L("video.convert.param.audioCodec.label"), default: "aac", options: VideoOptions.audio),
            .slider("audioBitrate", L("video.convert.param.audioBitrate.label"), default: 128, min: 32, max: 320, step: 32),
            .toggle("hardware", L("ui.use_hardware_acceleration_videotoolbox"), default: false,
                    hint: L("video.compress.param.hardware.hint")),
        ],
        run: { context in
            var outputs: [URL] = []
            for (index, input) in context.inputs.enumerated() {
                try context.checkCancelled()
                let info = await MediaProbe.info(for: input)
                let duration = info?.duration ?? 0
                let codec = VideoCodec(rawValue: context.choice("codec", "h264")) ?? .h264
                let audioCodec = AudioCodec(rawValue: context.choice("audioCodec", "aac")) ?? .aac
                let mode = context.choice("mode", "quality")
                let output = context.output(index: index, ext: codec.preferredExtension, suffix: L("doc.pdfcompress.param.grayscale.label.2"))

                var args: [String] = []
                var passLog: URL?

                switch mode {
                case "size":
                    guard duration > 0 else {
                        throw ProcessError.failed(code: 0, message: L("video.compress.param.hardware.label"))
                    }
                    let targetMB = max(context.double("targetSize", 20), 0.5)
                    let audioKbps = Double(context.int("audioBitrate", 128))
                    // Reserve 2% for container overhead.
                    let totalKbps = (targetMB * 8 * 1024) / duration
                    let videoKbps = max(Int((totalKbps - audioKbps) * 0.98), 80)
                    passLog = try context.makeScratch().appendingPathComponent("pass")
                    args += FFmpeg.videoArgs(
                        codec: codec, quality: 23,
                        hardware: context.bool("hardware", true),
                        targetBitrateKbps: videoKbps)
                    args += VideoSupport.geometryArguments(context)
                    args += FFmpeg.audioArgs(codec: audioCodec, bitrateKbps: context.int("audioBitrate", 128))
                    // Two-pass is only meaningful for software encoders, and
                    // the analysis pass must not appear in the final command.
                    if !context.bool("hardware", true) && codec == .h264, let passLog {
                        let analysisArgs = ["-i", input.path] + args + [
                            "-pass", "1", "-passlogfile", passLog.path,
                            "-an", "-f", "null", "/dev/null",
                        ]
                        _ = try? await ProcessRunner.run(
                            "ffmpeg", FFmpeg.baseFlags + analysisArgs, handle: context.handle)
                        args += ["-pass", "2", "-passlogfile", passLog.path]
                    }

                case "bitrate":
                    args += FFmpeg.videoArgs(
                        codec: codec, quality: 23,
                        hardware: context.bool("hardware", true),
                        targetBitrateKbps: context.int("videoBitrate", 2500))
                    args += VideoSupport.geometryArguments(context)
                    args += FFmpeg.audioArgs(codec: audioCodec, bitrateKbps: context.int("audioBitrate", 128))

                default:
                    let crf = context.double("crf", 26)
                    args += FFmpeg.videoArgs(
                        codec: codec, quality: crf,
                        hardware: context.bool("hardware", true),
                        preset: "medium")
                    args += VideoSupport.geometryArguments(context)
                    args += FFmpeg.audioArgs(codec: audioCodec, bitrateKbps: context.int("audioBitrate", 128))
                }

                if context.settings.keepMetadata { args += ["-map_metadata", "0"] }
                if output.pathExtension == "mp4" { args += ["-movflags", "+faststart"] }

                context.progress.note(L("video.compress.param.hardware.label.2", input.lastPathComponent))
                let produced = try await VideoSupport.encode(
                    context, input: input, output: output,
                    arguments: args, duration: duration)
                if let passLog { FileIO.removeQuietly(passLog) }
                outputs.append(produced)
            }
            return outputs
        }
    ) }

How it works实现原理実装の仕組み구현 원리Comment ça marche

Preset sizes scale by height only (keeping the aspect ratio), and only custom sizes need a "fit mode" - a preset is proportional scaling by definition, so "crop to fill" is meaningless there.预设尺寸只按高度缩放（保持比例），只有自定义尺寸才需要「适配方式」——因为预设本质上就是等比缩放，讨论「裁剪填满」没有意义。プリセットサイズは高さだけで拡大縮小し（比率を維持）、「フィット方式」が必要になるのはカスタムサイズのときだけです——プリセットは要するに等比縮小なので、「切り抜き充填」を論じる意味はありません。프리셋 크기는 높이만 기준으로 축소(비율 유지)하고, 사용자 지정 크기에서만 "맞춤 방식"이 필요합니다. 프리셋은 본질적으로 비율을 유지한 축소이므로 "잘라 채우기"를 논하는 것은 의미가 없습니다.Les tailles prédéfinies ne s'échelonnent que sur la hauteur (proportions conservées) ; seul le mode personnalisé a besoin d'un « mode d'ajustement » — un preset est par définition une mise à l'échelle proportionnelle, où « remplir par recadrage » n'a aucun sens.
  1. Preset mode: use <code>scale=-2:H</code>; <code>-2</code> lets ffmpeg work out an even width for us (most encoders require even dimensions).预设模式：用 <code>scale=-2:H</code>，<code>-2</code> 让 ffmpeg 自动算出偶数宽度（大多数编码器要求宽高为偶数）。プリセットモード：<code>scale=-2:H</code> を使います。<code>-2</code> は ffmpeg に偶数幅を自動計算させます（ほとんどのエンコーダは幅と高さが偶数であることを要求します）。프리셋 모드: <code>scale=-2:H</code>를 쓰고, <code>-2</code>는 ffmpeg가 짝수 너비를 자동으로 계산하게 합니다(대부분의 인코더는 너비와 높이가 짝수여야 합니다).Mode prédéfini : on utilise <code>scale=-2:H</code>, le <code>-2</code> laissant ffmpeg calculer une largeur paire (la plupart des encodeurs l'exigent).
  2. Custom mode: work out the target box first, then build the filter according to the fit mode.自定义模式：先算出目标盒子，再按适配方式生成滤镜。カスタムモード：まず目標のボックスを計算し、フィット方式に応じてフィルタを生成します。사용자 지정 모드: 대상 박스를 먼저 계산하고 맞춤 방식에 따라 필터를 만듭니다.Mode personnalisé : on calcule d'abord la boîte cible, puis on construit le filtre selon le mode d'ajustement.
  3. Fit uses <code>force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease</code>; fill uses <code>increase</code> followed by <code>crop</code>; stretch just sets the width and height outright.完整显示用 <code>force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease</code>；裁剪填满用 <code>increase</code> 再 <code>crop</code>；拉伸直接指定宽高。全体表示は <code>force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease</code>、切り抜き充填は <code>increase</code> してから <code>crop</code>、引き伸ばしは幅と高さを直接指定します。전체 표시는 <code>force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease</code>, 잘라 채우기는 <code>increase</code> 후 <code>crop</code>, 늘리기는 너비와 높이를 그대로 지정합니다.L'affichage complet passe par <code>force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease</code> ; le remplissage par recadrage par <code>increase</code> suivi de <code>crop</code> ; l'étirement fixe simplement largeur et hauteur.
  4. When "allow upscaling" is off, <code>min(H\,ih)</code> clamps the target to the source dimensions.未开启「允许放大」时用 <code>min(H\,ih)</code> 把目标钳制到源尺寸以内。「拡大を許可」がオフのときは <code>min(H\,ih)</code> でターゲットを元サイズ以内にクランプします。"확대 허용"이 꺼져 있으면 <code>min(H\,ih)</code>로 대상을 원본 크기 안으로 제한합니다.Quand « autoriser l'agrandissement » est désactivé, <code>min(H\,ih)</code> borne la cible aux dimensions de la source.
Further notes补充说明補足보충 설명Remarques complémentaires
  • Measured: with a 640x360 source and a 480x480 target, fit yields 480x270, while fill and stretch both yield 480x480 (a 63.8% pixel difference).实测：源 640×360 → 目标 480×480 时，完整显示得到 480×270，裁剪填满与拉伸得到 480×480（像素差异 63.8%）。実測：元 640×360 → ターゲット 480×480 のとき、全体表示は 480×270、切り抜き充填と引き伸ばしは 480×480 になります（ピクセル差 63.8%）。실측: 원본 640×360 → 대상 480×480일 때 전체 표시는 480×270이 나오고, 잘라 채우기와 늘리기는 480×480이 나옵니다(픽셀 차이 63.8%).Mesuré : avec une source 640×360 et une cible 480×480, l'affichage complet donne 480×270, tandis que le remplissage et l'étirement donnent 480×480 (63,8 % de pixels différents).

    static var tool: Tool { Tool(
        id: "video.resize",
        name: L("video.resize.name"),
        summary: L("video.resize.summary"),
        symbol: "arrow.up.left.and.arrow.down.right",
        category: .video,
        accepts: ["mp4", "mov", "mkv", "avi", "webm", "m4v"],
                requiresFFmpeg: true,
        actionTitle: L("video.resize.action"),
        parameters: [
            .picker("scale", L("video.resize.param.scale.label"), default: "p1080", options: VideoOptions.scale),
            .number("customWidth", L("image.resize.param.width.label"), default: 1920, min: 16, max: 7680,
                    visibleWhen: .equals("scale", "custom")),
            .number("customHeight", L("image.resize.param.height.label"), default: 1080, min: 16, max: 7680,
                    visibleWhen: .equals("scale", "custom")),
            .picker("fit", L("image.resize.param.fit.label"), default: "fit", options: [
                .init("fit", L("video.resize.param.fit.label")),
                .init("fill", L("video.resize.param.fit.label.2")),
                .init("stretch", L("video.resize.param.fit.label.3")),
            ], visibleWhen: .equals("scale", "custom")),
            .toggle("allowUpscale", L("video.resize.param.allowUpscale.label"), default: false),
            .slider("crf", L("video.fromimages.param.crf.label"), default: 20, min: 14, max: 34, step: 1),
        ],
        run: { context in
            var outputs: [URL] = []
            for (index, input) in context.inputs.enumerated() {
                try context.checkCancelled()
                let duration = await MediaProbe.duration(input)
                let output = context.output(index: index, ext: input.pathExtension, suffix: L("video.resize.param.crf.label"))

                var filters: [String] = []
                let scale = ScalePreset(rawValue: context.choice("scale", "p1080")) ?? .p1080
                let fit = context.choice("fit", "fit")
                let allowUpscale = context.bool("allowUpscale", false)

                switch scale {
                case .custom:
                    // An explicit box is the only case where fit modes are
                    // meaningful; the presets are proportional by definition.
                    let width = context.int("customWidth", 1920)
                    let height = context.int("customHeight", 1080)
                    let boxW = allowUpscale ? "\(width)" : "min(\(width)\\,iw)"
                    let boxH = allowUpscale ? "\(height)" : "min(\(height)\\,ih)"
                    switch fit {
                    case "fill":
                        // Cover the box, then crop the overflow so nothing distorts.
                        filters.append("scale=\(boxW):\(boxH):force_original_aspect_ratio=increase")
                        filters.append("crop=\(boxW):\(boxH)")
                    case "stretch":
                        filters.append("scale=\(boxW):\(boxH)")
                    default:
                        filters.append("scale=\(boxW):\(boxH):force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease")
                    }
                case .original:
                    break
                default:
                    if let height = scale.height {
                        // min(h,ih) prevents accidental upscaling.
                        let target = allowUpscale ? "\(height)" : "min(\(height)\\,ih)"
                        filters.append("scale=-2:\(target)")
                    }
                }
                var args: [String] = []
                if !filters.isEmpty { args += ["-vf", filters.joined(separator: ",")] }
                args += FFmpeg.videoArgs(codec: .h264, quality: context.double("crf", 20),
                                         hardware: context.settings.useHardwareAcceleration,
                                         preset: "medium")
                args += ["-c:a", "copy"]
                if output.pathExtension == "mp4" { args += ["-movflags", "+faststart"] }

                outputs.append(try await VideoSupport.encode(
                    context, input: input, output: output,
                    arguments: args, duration: duration))
            }
            return outputs
        }
    ) }

How it works实现原理実装の仕組み구현 원리Comment ça marche

Two ways to trim: <b>re-encoding</b> gives exact cut points, while <b>stream copy</b> is very fast but the cuts have to land on keyframes.两种裁剪思路：<b>重新编码</b>能得到精确切点，<b>流复制</b>极快但切点必须对齐关键帧。切り出しには 2 つの考え方があります：<b>再エンコード</b>なら正確な切れ目が得られ、<b>ストリームコピー</b>は非常に速い代わりに切れ目をキーフレームに合わせなければなりません。두 가지 자르기 방식이 있습니다. <b>재인코딩</b>은 정확한 지점을 얻을 수 있고, <b>스트림 복사</b>는 매우 빠르지만 자르는 지점이 키프레임에 맞아야 합니다.Deux approches du découpage : <b>le réencodage</b> donne des points de coupe exacts, <b>la copie de flux</b> est très rapide mais les coupes doivent tomber sur des images clés.
  1. Range mode: <code>-ss</code> sets the start and <code>-to</code> sets the end.区间模式：<code>-ss</code> 指定起点，<code>-to</code> 指定终点。区間モード：<code>-ss</code> で開始点、<code>-to</code> で終了点を指定します。구간 모드: <code>-ss</code>로 시작점을, <code>-to</code>로 끝점을 지정합니다.Mode plage : <code>-ss</code> fixe le début, <code>-to</code> la fin.
  2. When re-encoding, put <code>-ss</code> after <code>-i</code> so the cut is exact.重新编码时把 <code>-ss</code> 放在 <code>-i</code> 之后以保证精确。再エンコード時は <code>-ss</code> を <code>-i</code> の後ろに置き、正確さを確保します。재인코딩할 때는 정확도를 위해 <code>-ss</code>를 <code>-i</code> 뒤에 둡니다.En réencodage, <code>-ss</code> se place après <code>-i</code> pour une coupe exacte.
  3. When stream copying, put <code>-ss</code> before <code>-i</code> so ffmpeg can seek quickly.流复制时把 <code>-ss</code> 放在 <code>-i</code> 之前，让 ffmpeg 快速定位。ストリームコピー時は <code>-ss</code> を <code>-i</code> の前に置き、ffmpeg に高速なシークをさせます。스트림 복사할 때는 ffmpeg가 빠르게 탐색하도록 <code>-ss</code>를 <code>-i</code> 앞에 둡니다.En copie de flux, <code>-ss</code> se place avant <code>-i</code>, ce qui permet à ffmpeg de se positionner rapidement.
  4. Even-split mode uses <code>-f segment</code> together with <code>-segment_time</code> and names the outputs <code>seg_%03d</code>, then submits each one to the destination directory.等分模式用 <code>-f segment</code> 配合 <code>-segment_time</code>，并按 <code>seg_%03d</code> 命名输出，最后逐个提交到目标目录。等分モードは <code>-f segment</code> と <code>-segment_time</code> を使い、<code>seg_%03d</code> で命名して出力し、最後に 1 つずつ目的のディレクトリへ送ります。균등 분할 모드는 <code>-f segment</code>와 <code>-segment_time</code>을 쓰고 <code>seg_%03d</code>로 출력 이름을 정한 뒤, 마지막에 하나씩 대상 디렉터리로 옮깁니다.Le mode découpage régulier combine <code>-f segment</code> et <code>-segment_time</code>, nomme les sorties <code>seg_%03d</code>, puis les valide une à une dans le dossier de destination.
Further notes补充说明補足보충 설명Remarques complémentaires
  • In stream-copy mode, add <code>-avoid_negative_ts make_zero</code>; otherwise timestamps can go negative and break playback.流复制模式下加 <code>-avoid_negative_ts make_zero</code>，否则时间戳可能变成负数导致播放异常。ストリームコピーモードでは <code>-avoid_negative_ts make_zero</code> を付けます。そうしないとタイムスタンプが負になり、再生がおかしくなることがあります。스트림 복사 모드에서는 <code>-avoid_negative_ts make_zero</code>를 붙입니다. 그러지 않으면 타임스탬프가 음수가 되어 재생이 이상해질 수 있습니다.En copie de flux, on ajoute <code>-avoid_negative_ts make_zero</code>, faute de quoi les horodatages peuvent devenir négatifs et perturber la lecture.

    static var tool: Tool { Tool(
        id: "video.trim",
        name: L("video.trim.name"),
        summary: L("video.trim.summary"),
        symbol: "scissors",
        category: .video,
        accepts: ["mp4", "mov", "mkv", "avi", "webm", "m4v", "ts"],
                requiresFFmpeg: true,
        actionTitle: L("video.trim.action"),
        parameters: [
            .picker("mode", L("image.transform.param.crop.label"), default: "range", options: [
                .init("range", L("video.trim.param.mode.label")), .init("split", L("video.trim.param.mode.label.2")),
            ]),
            .number("start", L("video.frames.param.start.label"), default: 0, min: 0, max: 100_000, step: 0.1,
                    visibleWhen: .equals("mode", "range")),
            .number("end", L("video.screenshot.param.end.label"), default: 10, min: 0, max: 100_000, step: 0.1,
                    hint: L("video.screenshot.param.end.hint"),
                    visibleWhen: .equals("mode", "range")),
            .number("segments", L("video.trim.param.segments.label"), default: 2, min: 2, max: 50, step: 1,
                    visibleWhen: .equals("mode", "split")),
            .number("segmentLength", L("video.trim.param.segmentLength.label"), default: 0, min: 0, max: 100_000, step: 1,
                    hint: L("video.trim.param.segmentLength.hint"),
                    visibleWhen: .equals("mode", "split")),
            .toggle("reencode", L("video.trim.param.reencode.label"), default: true,
                    hint: L("video.trim.param.reencode.hint")),
        ],
        run: { context in
            var outputs: [URL] = []
            for (index, input) in context.inputs.enumerated() {
                try context.checkCancelled()
                let duration = await MediaProbe.duration(input)
                let mode = context.choice("mode", "range")

                if mode == "split" {
                    let scratch = try context.makeScratch()
                    defer { FileIO.removeQuietly(scratch) }
                    var args: [String] = []
                    if context.bool("reencode", true) {
                        args += ["-c:v", "libx264", "-crf", "20", "-preset", "veryfast",
                                 "-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "192k", "-force_key_frames", "expr:gte(t,n_forced*1)"]
                    } else {
                        args += ["-c", "copy"]
                    }
                    let length = context.double("segmentLength", 0)
                    if length > 0 {
                        args += ["-f", "segment", "-segment_time", VideoSupport.fmt(length), "-reset_timestamps", "1"]
                    } else {
                        let count = max(context.int("segments", 2), 2)
                        let per = duration > 0 ? duration / Double(count) : 0
                        guard per > 0 else {
                            throw ProcessError.failed(code: 0, message: L("video.trim.param.reencode.label.2"))
                        }
                        args += ["-f", "segment", "-segment_time", VideoSupport.fmt(per), "-reset_timestamps", "1"]
                    }
                    let pattern = scratch.appendingPathComponent("seg_%03d.\(input.pathExtension)").path
                    args += [pattern]

                    let full = ["-i", input.path] + args
                    let result = try await ProcessRunner.run(
                        "ffmpeg", FFmpeg.baseFlags + ["-progress", "pipe:1"] + full,
                        handle: context.handle,
                        onStdout: FFmpeg.progressHandler(duration: duration, reporter: context.progress))
                    guard result.ok || result.cancelled == false else {
                        throw ProcessError.failed(code: result.exitCode, message: result.stderr)
                    }
                    let produced = VideoSupport.sequence(in: scratch, prefix: "seg_")
                    for (i, file) in produced.enumerated() {
                        let target = context.output(
                            index: index, ext: input.pathExtension,
                            suffix: "_\(String(format: "%02d", i + 1))")
                        if let committed = try FileIO.commit(
                            file, to: target, policy: context.settings.conflictPolicy) {
                            outputs.append(committed)
                        }
                    }
                    continue
                }

                let start = context.double("start", 0)
                let end = context.double("end", 0)
                let output = context.output(index: index, ext: input.pathExtension, suffix: L("video.trim.param.reencode.label.3"))
                let segmentDuration = end > start ? end - start : max(duration - start, 0)

                var args: [String] = []
                if context.bool("reencode", true) {
                    args += ["-ss", VideoSupport.fmt(start)]
                    if end > start { args += ["-to", VideoSupport.fmt(end)] }
                    args += ["-c:v", "libx264", "-crf", "20", "-preset", "veryfast",
                             "-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "192k"]
                } else {
                    // Fast seek before input, then stream copy.
                    args += ["-ss", VideoSupport.fmt(start)]
                    if end > start { args += ["-to", VideoSupport.fmt(end)] }
                    args += ["-c", "copy", "-avoid_negative_ts", "make_zero"]
                }

                outputs.append(try await VideoSupport.encode(
                    context, input: input, output: output,
                    arguments: args, duration: segmentDuration))
            }
            return outputs
        }
    ) }

How it works实现原理実装の仕組み구현 원리Comment ça marche

Concatenation uses the concat demuxer to read a list file, but <b>joining clips with mismatched parameters goes wrong</b>, so the geometry has to be normalized first.拼接用 concat 解复用器读一个列表文件，但<b>参数不一致的视频直接拼会出问题</b>，所以要统一几何。結合は concat デマルチプレクサでリストファイルを読みますが、<b>パラメータが揃っていない動画をそのまま繋ぐと問題が出ます</b>。そこでジオメトリを統一します。이어 붙이기는 concat 디먹서로 목록 파일을 읽습니다. 그런데 <b>파라미터가 다른 동영상을 그대로 이어 붙이면 문제가 생기므로</b> 기하를 통일해야 합니다.La concaténation fait lire un fichier de liste au démultiplexeur concat, mais <b>assembler directement des vidéos aux paramètres disparates pose problème</b> : il faut donc uniformiser la géométrie.
  1. Write a list file with one <code>file 'path'</code> line per clip (single quotes inside the path must be escaped).写一个列表文件，每行 <code>file '路径'</code>（路径里的单引号要转义）。リストファイルを書き、各行を <code>file 'パス'</code> にします（パス内のシングルクォートはエスケープが必要です）。목록 파일을 쓰고 각 줄은 <code>file '경로'</code>로 둡니다(경로 안의 작은따옴표는 이스케이프해야 합니다).On écrit un fichier de liste avec une ligne <code>file 'chemin'</code> par clip (les apostrophes du chemin doivent être échappées).
  2. Lossless mode is just <code>-c copy</code> - provided every clip has exactly the same encoding parameters.无损模式直接 <code>-c copy</code>——前提是所有片段的编码参数完全一致。無劣化モードはそのまま <code>-c copy</code>——すべてのクリップのエンコードパラメータが完全に一致していることが前提です。무손실 모드는 그대로 <code>-c copy</code>입니다. 단, 모든 조각의 인코딩 파라미터가 완전히 같아야 합니다.Le mode sans perte se contente de <code>-c copy</code> — à condition que tous les clips partagent exactement les mêmes paramètres d'encodage.
  3. Re-encode mode: take the first video's resolution as the reference, use <code>scale</code> + <code>pad</code> to bring every clip to the same size, then <code>fps</code> to normalize the frame rate, and finally <code>setsar=1</code> to normalize the pixel aspect ratio.重新编码模式：以第一个视频的分辨率为准，用 <code>scale</code> + <code>pad</code> 把所有片段统一到同一尺寸，再用 <code>fps</code> 统一帧率，最后加 <code>setsar=1</code> 统一像素宽高比。再エンコードモード：最初の動画の解像度を基準にし、<code>scale</code> + <code>pad</code> ですべてのクリップを同じサイズに揃え、<code>fps</code> でフレームレートを統一し、最後に <code>setsar=1</code> でピクセルアスペクト比を揃えます。재인코딩 모드: 첫 번째 동영상의 해상도를 기준으로 <code>scale</code> + <code>pad</code>로 모든 조각을 같은 크기로 맞추고, <code>fps</code>로 프레임 레이트를 통일한 다음, 마지막에 <code>setsar=1</code>로 픽셀 종횡비를 통일합니다.Mode réencodage : on prend la résolution de la première vidéo comme référence, on ramène tous les clips à la même taille avec <code>scale</code> + <code>pad</code>, on uniformise la cadence avec <code>fps</code>, et on termine par <code>setsar=1</code> pour homogénéiser le rapport de forme des pixels.
Further notes补充说明補足보충 설명Remarques complémentaires
  • The tool has to supply the complete input prefix itself here, otherwise the generic wrapper adds one extra <code>-i</code> and the input indices shift - an early version only emitted the first clip because of this (3 seconds instead of 6).这里必须让工具自己提供完整的输入前缀，否则通用封装会多加一个 <code>-i</code>，导致输入索引偏移——早期版本因此只输出了第一个片段（3 秒而非 6 秒）。ここではツール自身が完全な入力プレフィックスを渡す必要があります。そうしないと汎用ラッパーが <code>-i</code> を余分に足し、入力インデックスがずれます——初期バージョンではこのせいで最初のクリップ（6 秒ではなく 3 秒）しか出力されませんでした。여기서는 도구가 입력 접두사 전체를 직접 제공해야 합니다. 그러지 않으면 범용 래퍼가 <code>-i</code>를 하나 더 붙여 입력 인덱스가 밀립니다. 초기 버전이 그래서 첫 조각만 출력했습니다(6초가 아니라 3초).Ici, l'outil doit fournir lui-même le préfixe d'entrée complet ; sinon l'enveloppe générique ajoute un <code>-i</code> de trop et les index d'entrée se décalent — une première version n'a ainsi produit que le premier clip (3 secondes au lieu de 6).

Features/Video/VideoTools.swift:34285 lines行行줄lignes
    static var tool: Tool { Tool(
        id: "video.concat",
        name: L("video.concat.name"),
        summary: L("video.concat.summary"),
        symbol: "rectangle.stack.badge.plus",
        category: .video,
        accepts: ["mp4", "mov", "mkv", "avi", "webm", "m4v", "ts"],
                requiresFFmpeg: true,
        actionTitle: L("image.stitch.action"),
        parameters: [
            .picker("mode", L("image.stitch.param.layout.label"), default: "reencode", options: [
                .init("reencode", L("video.concat.param.mode.label"), detail: L("video.concat.param.mode.label.2")),
                .init("copy", L("video.concat.param.mode.label.3"), detail: L("video.concat.param.mode.label.4")),
            ]),
            .picker("codec", L("video.concat.param.codec.label"), default: "h264", options: [
                .init("h264", "H.264"), .init("hevc", "H.265"),
            ], visibleWhen: .equals("mode", "reencode")),
            .slider("crf", L("video.fromimages.param.crf.label"), default: 20, min: 14, max: 34, step: 1,
                    visibleWhen: .equals("mode", "reencode")),
            .toggle("normalize", L("video.concat.param.normalize.label"), default: true,
                    hint: L("video.concat.param.normalize.hint"),
                    visibleWhen: .equals("mode", "reencode")),
        ],
        minimumInputs: 2,
        run: { context in
            guard context.inputs.count >= 2 else {
                throw ProcessError.failed(code: 0, message: L("video.concat.param.normalize.label.2"))
            }
            let scratch = try context.makeScratch()
            defer { FileIO.removeQuietly(scratch) }

            let listURL = scratch.appendingPathComponent("list.txt")
            let listing = context.inputs
                .map { "file '\($0.path.replacingOccurrences(of: "'", with: "'\\''"))'" }
                .joined(separator: "\n")
            try listing.write(to: listURL, atomically: true, encoding: .utf8)

            let output = context.output(ext: context.inputs[0].pathExtension, suffix: L("video.concat.param.normalize.label.3"))
            let totalDuration = await withTaskGroup(of: Double.self) { group in
                for input in context.inputs {
                    group.addTask { await MediaProbe.duration(input) }
                }
                var sum: Double = 0
                for await value in group { sum += value }
                return sum
            }

            // The concat demuxer consumes the whole list as a single input.
            let inputArguments = ["-f", "concat", "-safe", "0", "-i", listURL.path]

            if context.choice("mode", "reencode") == "copy" {
                return [try await VideoSupport.encode(
                    context, input: context.inputs[0], output: output,
                    arguments: ["-c", "copy"], duration: totalDuration,
                    inputArguments: inputArguments)]
            }

            let codec = VideoCodec(rawValue: context.choice("codec", "h264")) ?? .h264
            let first = await MediaProbe.info(for: context.inputs[0])
            var filters: [String] = []
            var args: [String] = []

            if context.bool("normalize", true), let first, first.width > 0 {
                let w = first.width - (first.width % 2)
                let h = first.height - (first.height % 2)
                let fps = first.frameRate > 0 ? first.frameRate : 30
                filters.append("scale=\(w):\(h):force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease")
                filters.append("pad=\(w):\(h):(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2")
                filters.append("fps=\(VideoSupport.fmt(fps))")
                filters.append("setsar=1")
            }
            if !filters.isEmpty { args += ["-vf", filters.joined(separator: ",")] }
            args += FFmpeg.videoArgs(
                codec: codec,
                quality: context.double("crf", 20),
                hardware: context.settings.useHardwareAcceleration,
                preset: "medium")
            args += ["-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "192k"]

            return [try await VideoSupport.encode(
                context, input: context.inputs[0], output: output,
                arguments: args, duration: totalDuration,
                inputArguments: inputArguments)]
        }
    ) }

How it works实现原理実装の仕組み구현 원리Comment ça marche

Rotation can either genuinely rotate the pixels with a filter or just write metadata - the latter is instant, but player support is inconsistent.旋转可以用滤镜真实旋转像素，也可以只写元数据——后者秒完成但播放器支持不一致。回転はフィルタで実際にピクセルを回すことも、メタデータだけを書くこともできます——後者は一瞬で終わりますが、プレイヤーの対応がまちまちです。회전은 필터로 픽셀을 실제로 돌릴 수도 있고 메타데이터만 기록할 수도 있습니다. 후자는 즉시 끝나지만 플레이어 지원이 일관되지 않습니다.La rotation peut réellement tourner les pixels via un filtre, ou se contenter d'écrire une métadonnée — cette seconde option est instantanée, mais la prise en charge par les lecteurs est inégale.
  1. 90 degrees clockwise uses <code>transpose=1</code>, counter-clockwise uses <code>transpose=2</code>, and 180 degrees uses transpose twice.顺时针 90° 用 <code>transpose=1</code>，逆时针用 <code>transpose=2</code>，180° 用两次 transpose。時計回り 90° は <code>transpose=1</code>、反時計回りは <code>transpose=2</code>、180° は transpose を 2 回です。시계 방향 90°는 <code>transpose=1</code>, 반시계 방향은 <code>transpose=2</code>, 180°는 transpose를 두 번 씁니다.90° dans le sens horaire avec <code>transpose=1</code>, antihoraire avec <code>transpose=2</code>, et 180° avec deux transpose.
  2. Mirroring uses <code>hflip</code> / <code>vflip</code>.镜像用 <code>hflip</code> / <code>vflip</code>。鏡像は <code>hflip</code> / <code>vflip</code> を使います。좌우 반전은 <code>hflip</code> / <code>vflip</code>을 씁니다.Le miroir passe par <code>hflip</code> / <code>vflip</code>.
  3. With re-encoding off, it writes only the flag via <code>-metadata:s:v:0 rotate=N</code>.关闭重新编码时改用 <code>-metadata:s:v:0 rotate=N</code> 只写标记。再エンコードをオフにした場合は <code>-metadata:s:v:0 rotate=N</code> でマークだけを書き込みます。재인코딩을 끄면 <code>-metadata:s:v:0 rotate=N</code>으로 표시만 기록합니다.Quand le réencodage est désactivé, on se contente d'écrire la balise via <code>-metadata:s:v:0 rotate=N</code>.

    static var tool: Tool { Tool(
        id: "video.transform",
        name: L("video.transform.name"),
        summary: L("video.transform.summary"),
        symbol: "rotate.right",
        category: .video,
        accepts: ["mp4", "mov", "mkv", "avi", "webm", "m4v"],
                requiresFFmpeg: true,
        actionTitle: L("image.transform.action"),
        parameters: [
            .picker("transform", L("video.transform.param.transform.label"), default: "cw90", options: [
                .init("cw90", L("image.transform.param.rotate.label.2")), .init("ccw90", L("image.transform.param.rotate.label.3")),
                .init("180", L("video.transform.param.transform.label.2")), .init("hflip", L("image.transform.param.flipH.label")),
                .init("vflip", L("image.transform.param.flipV.label")),
            ]),
            .toggle("reencode", L("video.concat.param.mode.label"), default: true,
                    hint: L("video.transform.param.reencode.hint")),
        ],
        run: { context in
            var outputs: [URL] = []
            for (index, input) in context.inputs.enumerated() {
                try context.checkCancelled()
                let duration = await MediaProbe.duration(input)
                let output = context.output(index: index, ext: input.pathExtension, suffix: L("image.transform.param.format.label"))
                let transform = context.choice("transform", "cw90")

                var args: [String] = []
                if context.bool("reencode", true) {
                    let filter = switch transform {
                    case "cw90": "transpose=1"
                    case "ccw90": "transpose=2"
                    case "180": "transpose=2,transpose=2"
                    case "hflip": "hflip"
                    default: "vflip"
                    }
                    args += ["-vf", filter]
                    args += FFmpeg.videoArgs(codec: .h264, quality: 20,
                                             hardware: context.settings.useHardwareAcceleration,
                                             preset: "veryfast")
                    args += ["-c:a", "copy"]
                } else {
                    let rotation = switch transform {
                    case "cw90": "90"
                    case "ccw90": "270"
                    case "180": "180"
                    default: "0"
                    }
                    args += ["-c", "copy", "-metadata:s:v:0", "rotate=\(rotation)"]
                }

                outputs.append(try await VideoSupport.encode(
                    context, input: input, output: output,
                    arguments: args, duration: duration))
            }
            return outputs
        }
    ) }

How it works实现原理実装の仕組み구현 원리Comment ça marche

Speed changes have to handle video and audio together, and <code>atempo</code> only accepts 0.5-2.0, so anything outside that range has to be chained.变速要同时处理视频与音频，而且 <code>atempo</code> 只接受 0.5–2.0，超出范围必须链式串联。速度変更は映像と音声の両方を扱う必要があり、しかも <code>atempo</code> は 0.5〜2.0 しか受け付けないため、範囲外はチェーンで繋ぐしかありません。배속은 비디오와 오디오를 함께 다뤄야 하고, <code>atempo</code>는 0.5–2.0만 받으므로 범위를 벗어나면 반드시 체인으로 이어야 합니다.La variation de vitesse doit traiter vidéo et audio ensemble, et comme <code>atempo</code> n'accepte que 0.5–2.0, toute valeur hors plage doit être enchaînée.
  1. Video uses <code>setpts=PTS/speed</code>.视频用 <code>setpts=PTS/速度</code>。映像は <code>setpts=PTS/speed</code> を使います。비디오는 <code>setpts=PTS/속도</code>를 씁니다.La vidéo utilise <code>setpts=PTS/vitesse</code>.
  2. Audio: while the factor is > 2, keep multiplying by 2 and track what's left; while it's < 0.5, keep dividing by 2; then finish with the remainder.音频：当倍率 > 2 时反复乘 2 并记录剩余倍率，当倍率 < 0.5 时反复除 2，最后用剩余的倍率收尾。音声：倍率が 2 を超えるときは 2 を繰り返し掛けて残りの倍率を記録し、0.5 未満のときは 2 で繰り返し割り、最後に残りの倍率で締めます。오디오: 배율이 2보다 크면 2를 반복해서 곱하고 남은 배율을 기록하며, 배율이 0.5보다 작으면 2로 반복해서 나누고 마지막에 남은 배율로 마무리합니다.Audio : tant que le facteur dépasse 2, on le divise par 2 en gardant trace du reste ; tant qu'il est inférieur à 0.5, on le multiplie par 2 ; on termine avec le facteur restant.
  3. So 8x becomes <code>atempo=2,atempo=2,atempo=2</code>.例如 8× 会变成 <code>atempo=2,atempo=2,atempo=2</code>。たとえば 8× は <code>atempo=2,atempo=2,atempo=2</code> になります。예를 들어 8×는 <code>atempo=2,atempo=2,atempo=2</code>가 됩니다.Ainsi, 8× devient <code>atempo=2,atempo=2,atempo=2</code>.
Further notes补充说明補足보충 설명Remarques complémentaires
  • With "keep pitch" off, it switches to <code>asetrate</code>, so the pitch shifts with the speed (like fast-forwarding a tape).关闭「保持音调」时改用 <code>asetrate</code>，音调会随速度变化（类似磁带快放）。「ピッチを保持」をオフにした場合は <code>asetrate</code> を使い、速度に応じてピッチが変わります（テープの早送りのようなものです）。"음정 유지"를 끄면 <code>asetrate</code>를 쓰고, 음정이 속도에 따라 변합니다(테이프를 빠르게 재생하는 것과 비슷합니다).Quand « conserver la hauteur » est désactivé, on passe à <code>asetrate</code> : la hauteur varie avec la vitesse (comme une bande accélérée).

    static var tool: Tool { Tool(
        id: "video.speed",
        name: L("video.speed.name"),
        summary: L("video.speed.summary"),
        symbol: "speedometer",
        category: .video,
        accepts: ["mp4", "mov", "mkv", "avi", "webm", "m4v"],
                requiresFFmpeg: true,
        actionTitle: L("video.speed.action"),
        parameters: [
            .slider("speed", L("video.speed.param.speed.label"), default: 2, min: 0.25, max: 8, step: 0.25,
                    hint: L("video.speed.param.speed.hint")),
            .toggle("keepPitch", L("video.speed.param.keepPitch.label"), default: true,
                    hint: L("video.speed.param.keepPitch.hint")),
            .toggle("dropAudio", L("video.compress.param.action.label"), default: false),
        ],
        run: { context in
            var outputs: [URL] = []
            for (index, input) in context.inputs.enumerated() {
                try context.checkCancelled()
                let sourceDuration = await MediaProbe.duration(input)
                let speed = context.double("speed", 2)
                guard speed > 0 else { throw ProcessError.failed(code: 0, message: L("video.speed.param.dropAudio.label")) }
                let output = context.output(index: index, ext: input.pathExtension, suffix: L("video.speed.param.dropAudio.label.2"))

                var filters = ["setpts=PTS/\(VideoSupport.fmt(speed))"]
                if !context.bool("dropAudio") {
                    if context.bool("keepPitch", true) {
                        // atempo only accepts 0.5–2.0, so chain for larger factors.
                        var remaining = speed
                        var chain: [String] = []
                        while remaining > 2.0 {
                            chain.append("atempo=2.0"); remaining /= 2.0
                        }
                        while remaining < 0.5 {
                            chain.append("atempo=0.5"); remaining /= 0.5
                        }
                        chain.append("atempo=\(VideoSupport.fmt(remaining))")
                        filters.append(chain.joined(separator: ","))
                    } else {
                        filters.append("asetrate=48000*\(VideoSupport.fmt(speed))")
                    }
                }

                var args = ["-filter_complex", "[0:v]\(filters[0])[v]"]
                if filters.count > 1 {
                    args = ["-filter_complex", "[0:v]\(filters[0])[v];[0:a]\(filters[1])[a]"]
                    args += ["-map", "[v]", "-map", "[a]"]
                } else {
                    args += ["-map", "[v]"]
                    if !context.bool("dropAudio") { args += ["-map", "0:a?"] }
                }
                args += FFmpeg.videoArgs(codec: .h264, quality: 20,
                                         hardware: context.settings.useHardwareAcceleration,
                                         preset: "veryfast")
                if context.bool("dropAudio") {
                    args += ["-an"]
                } else if !context.bool("keepPitch", true) {
                    args += ["-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "192k"]
                } else {
                    args += ["-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "192k"]
                }

                outputs.append(try await VideoSupport.encode(
                    context, input: input, output: output,
                    arguments: args, duration: sourceDuration / speed))
            }
            return outputs
        }
    ) }

How it works实现原理実装の仕組み구현 원리Comment ça marche

The local ffmpeg was built without libfreetype, so <b>there is no drawtext filter</b>; text watermarks are rendered to a transparent PNG with CoreText and then composited with overlay.本机 ffmpeg 没有编译 libfreetype，<b>没有 drawtext 滤镜</b>，所以文字水印改为用 CoreText 渲染成透明 PNG，再用 overlay 合成。手元の ffmpeg は libfreetype を組んでおらず<b>drawtext フィルタがありません</b>。そこでテキストウォーターマークは CoreText で透過 PNG に描画し、overlay で合成する方式にしました。이 환경의 ffmpeg에는 libfreetype이 컴파일되어 있지 않아 <b>drawtext 필터가 없습니다</b>. 그래서 텍스트 워터마크는 CoreText로 투명 PNG를 렌더링한 뒤 overlay로 합성합니다.Le ffmpeg de la machine a été compilé sans libfreetype : <b>pas de filtre drawtext</b>. Le filigrane texte est donc rendu en PNG transparent avec CoreText, puis composé via overlay.
  1. Measure the real text bounds with CoreText's <code>CTLineGetBoundsWithOptions(.useOpticalBounds)</code>, so we don't leave extra whitespace from the font's line height.用 CoreText 的 <code>CTLineGetBoundsWithOptions(.useOpticalBounds)</code> 量出文字实际边界，避免按字体行高留出多余空白。CoreText の <code>CTLineGetBoundsWithOptions(.useOpticalBounds)</code> でテキストの実際の境界を測り、フォントの行高に合わせて余分な空白が入るのを避けます。CoreText의 <code>CTLineGetBoundsWithOptions(.useOpticalBounds)</code>로 텍스트의 실제 경계를 재어, 폰트 줄 높이 때문에 여백이 남는 것을 피합니다.On mesure les limites réelles du texte avec <code>CTLineGetBoundsWithOptions(.useOpticalBounds)</code> de CoreText, pour éviter les blancs superflus qu'imposerait la hauteur de ligne de la police.
  2. Render onto a transparent canvas that fits the text exactly, and write out a PNG.渲染到刚好包住文字的透明画布，输出 PNG。テキストをちょうど包む透過キャンバスに描画し、PNG を出力します。텍스트를 딱 감싸는 투명 캔버스에 렌더링해 PNG로 출력합니다.On effectue le rendu dans un canevas transparent ajusté au texte, et on écrit un PNG.
  3. Feed the PNG in as the second input and composite it with the <code>overlay</code> filter using a position expression.把 PNG 作为第二个输入，用 <code>overlay</code> 滤镜按位置表达式合成。その PNG を 2 番目の入力にし、<code>overlay</code> フィルタで位置式に従って合成します。PNG를 두 번째 입력으로 넣고 <code>overlay</code> 필터로 위치 표현식에 따라 합성합니다.Le PNG entre comme second flux, composé par le filtre <code>overlay</code> selon une expression de position.
  4. In the position expression, <code>main_w</code>/<code>main_h</code> are the background dimensions and <code>overlay_w</code>/<code>overlay_h</code> are the watermark dimensions.位置表达式用 <code>main_w</code>/<code>main_h</code> 表示底图尺寸，<code>overlay_w</code>/<code>overlay_h</code> 表示水印尺寸。位置式では <code>main_w</code>/<code>main_h</code> が下地のサイズ、<code>overlay_w</code>/<code>overlay_h</code> がウォーターマークのサイズを表します。위치 표현식에서 <code>main_w</code>/<code>main_h</code>는 배경 크기, <code>overlay_w</code>/<code>overlay_h</code>는 워터마크 크기를 뜻합니다.Dans l'expression de position, <code>main_w</code>/<code>main_h</code> désignent les dimensions du fond et <code>overlay_w</code>/<code>overlay_h</code> celles du filigrane.
Further notes补充说明補足보충 설명Remarques complémentaires
  • The side effect is a bonus: CoreText gives full CJK font support, and its anti-aliasing is better than drawtext's.副作用是好事：CoreText 提供完整的中日韩字体支持，而且抗锯齿质量比 drawtext 更好。副作用はむしろ好都合でした：CoreText は CJK フォントを完全にサポートし、アンチエイリアス品質も drawtext より良好です。부작용이 오히려 이득입니다. CoreText는 한중일 폰트를 온전히 지원하고, 앤티앨리어싱 품질도 drawtext보다 좋습니다.L'effet de bord est heureux : CoreText offre une prise en charge complète des polices CJK et un anticrénelage de meilleure qualité que drawtext.
  • Image watermarks control opacity with <code>colorchannelmixer=aa=opacity</code>.图片水印用 <code>colorchannelmixer=aa=透明度</code> 控制不透明度。画像ウォーターマークは <code>colorchannelmixer=aa=opacity</code> で不透明度を制御します。이미지 워터마크는 <code>colorchannelmixer=aa=투명도</code>로 불투명도를 조절합니다.Le filigrane image règle son opacité avec <code>colorchannelmixer=aa=opacité</code>.

    static var tool: Tool { Tool(
        id: "video.watermark",
        name: L("video.watermark.name"),
        summary: L("video.watermark.summary"),
        symbol: "signature",
        category: .video,
        accepts: ["mp4", "mov", "mkv", "avi", "webm", "m4v"],
                requiresFFmpeg: true,
        actionTitle: L("image.watermark.action"),
        parameters: [
            .picker("kind", L("image.watermark.param.kind.label"), default: "text", options: [
                .init("text", L("image.watermark.param.kind.label.2")), .init("image", L("image.watermark.name")),
            ]),
            .text("text", L("image.watermark.param.text.label"), default: "FormatForge",
                  visibleWhen: .equals("kind", "text")),
            .slider("fontSize", L("video.watermark.param.fontSize.label"), default: 32, min: 8, max: 200, step: 1,
                    visibleWhen: .equals("kind", "text")),
            .text("color", L("video.watermark.param.color.label"), default: "white",
                  visibleWhen: .equals("kind", "text")),
            .number("imageScale", L("image.watermark.param.imageScale.label"), default: 20, min: 1, max: 100, step: 1,
                    visibleWhen: .equals("kind", "image")),
            .picker("position", L("ui.location"), default: "bottomRight", options: [
                .init("topLeft", L("enum.position.topleft")), .init("topRight", L("enum.position.topleft.2")),
                .init("bottomLeft", L("enum.position.topleft.3")), .init("bottomRight", L("enum.position.topleft.4")),
                .init("center", L("enum.position.topleft.5")),
            ]),
            .slider("opacity", L("image.watermark.param.opacity.label"), default: 80, min: 5, max: 100, step: 5),
            .number("margin", L("video.watermark.param.margin.label"), default: 24, min: 0, max: 500, step: 2),
        ],
        minimumInputs: 2,
        run: { context in
            // Last selected file is treated as the watermark source for images.
            let isImage = context.choice("kind", "text") == "image"
            let videos: [URL]
            let overlayImage: URL?
            if isImage {
                videos = context.inputs.filter { !$0.pathExtension.isImageExtension }
                overlayImage = context.inputs.last { $0.pathExtension.isImageExtension }
            } else {
                videos = context.inputs
                overlayImage = nil
            }
            guard let video = videos.first else {
                throw ProcessError.failed(code: 0, message: L("video.cover.param.format.label.4"))
            }
            if isImage && overlayImage == nil {
                throw ProcessError.failed(code: 0, message: L("video.watermark.param.margin.label.2"))
            }

            let duration = await MediaProbe.duration(video)
            let output = context.output(ext: video.pathExtension, suffix: L("image.watermark.param.margin.label.5"))
            let opacity = context.double("opacity", 80) / 100
            let margin = context.int("margin", 24)
            let position = context.choice("position", "bottomRight")

            // overlay filter expressions use main_w/main_h for the base frame
            // and overlay_w/overlay_h for the watermark layer.
            let xExpr: String, yExpr: String
            switch position {
            case "topLeft": xExpr = "\(margin)"; yExpr = "\(margin)"
            case "topRight": xExpr = "main_w-overlay_w-\(margin)"; yExpr = "\(margin)"
            case "bottomLeft": xExpr = "\(margin)"; yExpr = "main_h-overlay_h-\(margin)"
            case "center": xExpr = "(main_w-overlay_w)/2"; yExpr = "(main_h-overlay_h)/2"
            default: xExpr = "main_w-overlay_w-\(margin)"; yExpr = "main_h-overlay_h-\(margin)"
            }

            var inputArguments: [String] = ["-i", video.path]
            var args: [String] = []
            var filters: [String] = []
            // The local ffmpeg build has no drawtext filter, so text is
            // rasterised natively and composited as an image overlay.
            let scratch = try context.makeScratch()
            defer { FileIO.removeQuietly(scratch) }

            if isImage, let overlayImage {
                inputArguments += ["-i", overlayImage.path]
                let pct = context.double("imageScale", 20) / 100
                filters.append("[1:v]format=rgba,colorchannelmixer=aa=\(VideoSupport.fmt(opacity)),scale=iw*\(VideoSupport.fmt(pct)):-1[wm]")
                filters.append("[0:v][wm]overlay=\(xExpr):\(yExpr)[v]")
            } else {
                let rendered = try TextRenderer.renderPNG(
                    TextRenderer.Style(
                        text: context.string("text", "FormatForge"),
                        fontSize: context.double("fontSize", 32),
                        color: ImageSupport.nsColor(from: context.string("color", "white")),
                        opacity: opacity
                    ),
                    in: scratch)
                inputArguments += ["-i", rendered.url.path]
                let position = TextRenderer.overlayPosition(
                    position, size: rendered.size, margin: margin)
                filters.append("[1:v]format=rgba[wm]")
                filters.append("[0:v][wm]overlay=\(position.x):\(position.y)[v]")
            }

            args += ["-filter_complex", filters.joined(separator: ";")]
            args += ["-map", "[v]", "-map", "0:a?"]
            args += FFmpeg.videoArgs(codec: .h264, quality: 20,
                                     hardware: context.settings.useHardwareAcceleration,
                                     preset: "veryfast")
            args += ["-c:a", "copy"]

            return [try await VideoSupport.encode(
                context, input: video, output: output, arguments: args,
                duration: duration, inputArguments: inputArguments)]
        }
    ) }

How it works实现原理実装の仕組み구현 원리Comment ça marche

Single-frame and batch screenshots take two different paths: single frames seek precisely with <code>-ss</code>, while batches pull frames with the <code>fps</code> filter.单帧截图与批量截图走两条路径：单帧用 <code>-ss</code> 精确跳转，批量用 <code>fps</code> 滤镜抽帧。単一フレームのスクリーンショットと一括スクリーンショットは別の経路を通ります：単一は <code>-ss</code> で正確にシークし、一括は <code>fps</code> フィルタでフレームを抜き出します。단일 프레임 캡처와 일괄 캡처는 경로가 다릅니다. 단일 프레임은 <code>-ss</code>로 정확히 이동하고, 일괄은 <code>fps</code> 필터로 프레임을 뽑습니다.Capture d'une image unique et capture par lots empruntent deux chemins : l'image unique se positionne précisément avec <code>-ss</code>, le lot extrait les images avec le filtre <code>fps</code>.
  1. Single frame: put <code>-ss</code> before <code>-i</code> for a fast seek, plus <code>-frames:v 1</code> to grab exactly one frame.单帧：<code>-ss</code> 放在 <code>-i</code> 之前快速定位，配 <code>-frames:v 1</code> 只取一帧。単一：<code>-ss</code> を <code>-i</code> の前に置いて高速にシークし、<code>-frames:v 1</code> で 1 フレームだけ取ります。단일 프레임: 빠른 탐색을 위해 <code>-ss</code>를 <code>-i</code> 앞에 두고, <code>-frames:v 1</code>로 한 프레임만 가져옵니다.Image unique : <code>-ss</code> avant <code>-i</code> pour un positionnement rapide, avec <code>-frames:v 1</code> pour n'extraire qu'une image.
  2. Batch: extract with <code>fps=1/interval</code> into a numbered sequence in a temp directory, then rename and submit them in order.批量：用 <code>fps=1/间隔</code> 抽帧，输出到临时目录的编号序列，再按顺序重命名提交。一括：<code>fps=1/interval</code> でフレームを抜き、一時ディレクトリへ連番で出力してから、順にリネームして送ります。일괄: <code>fps=1/간격</code>으로 프레임을 뽑아 임시 디렉터리에 번호 시퀀스로 출력한 뒤, 순서대로 이름을 바꿔 반영합니다.Lot : extraction avec <code>fps=1/intervalle</code> vers une séquence numérotée dans un dossier temporaire, puis renommage et validation dans l'ordre.
  3. For N evenly spaced shots: work out the range length, divide it by N to get the equivalent interval, then follow the fps path.均匀截取 N 张：先算出区间长度，除以 N 得到等效间隔，再走 fps 路径。N 枚を均等に切り出す：まず区間の長さを求め、N で割って等価な間隔を出し、あとは fps の経路に乗せます。N장을 균등하게 뽑기: 구간 길이를 먼저 계산하고 N으로 나눠 등가 간격을 구한 다음 fps 경로를 탑니다.Pour N images régulièrement espacées : on calcule la longueur de la plage, on la divise par N pour obtenir l'intervalle équivalent, puis on suit le chemin fps.
  4. JPG quality has to be mapped backwards: ffmpeg's <code>-q:v</code> runs from 2 (best) to 31 (worst), so it's <code>31 - quality% * 29</code>.JPG 质量要反向映射：ffmpeg 的 <code>-q:v</code> 是 2（最好）到 31（最差），所以要 <code>31 - 质量% × 29</code>。JPG の品質は逆写像が必要です：ffmpeg の <code>-q:v</code> は 2（最高）〜31（最低）なので、<code>31 - 品質% × 29</code> とします。JPG 품질은 반대로 매핑해야 합니다. ffmpeg의 <code>-q:v</code>는 2(최고)에서 31(최저)이므로 <code>31 - 품질% × 29</code>를 씁니다.La qualité JPG se convertit à l'envers : le <code>-q:v</code> de ffmpeg va de 2 (meilleur) à 31 (pire), d'où <code>31 - qualité% × 29</code>.
Further notes补充说明補足보충 설명Remarques complémentaires
  • Hardware decoding (<code>-hwaccel videotoolbox</code>) is an input option and must come before <code>-i</code>, otherwise ffmpeg complains that it "cannot be applied to output".硬件解码（<code>-hwaccel videotoolbox</code>）是输入选项，必须放在 <code>-i</code> 之前，否则 ffmpeg 报「不能应用于输出」。ハードウェアデコード（<code>-hwaccel videotoolbox</code>）は入力オプションで、必ず <code>-i</code> より前に置く必要があります。そうしないと ffmpeg が「出力には適用できません」とエラーを出します。하드웨어 디코딩(<code>-hwaccel videotoolbox</code>)은 입력 옵션이라 반드시 <code>-i</code> 앞에 두어야 합니다. 그러지 않으면 ffmpeg가 "출력에 적용할 수 없다"는 오류를 냅니다.Le décodage matériel (<code>-hwaccel videotoolbox</code>) est une option d'entrée et doit précéder <code>-i</code>, sinon ffmpeg signale qu'elle « ne peut pas s'appliquer à la sortie ».
