    static var tool: Tool { Tool(
        id: "video.screenshot",
        name: L("video.screenshot.name"),
        summary: L("video.screenshot.summary"),
        symbol: "camera",
        category: .video,
        accepts: ["mp4", "mov", "mkv", "avi", "webm", "m4v", "ts", "flv", "wmv"],
                requiresFFmpeg: true,
        actionTitle: L("video.screenshot.action"),
        parameters: [
            .picker("mode", L("video.screenshot.param.mode.label"), default: "single", options: [
                .init("single", L("video.screenshot.param.mode.label.2")), .init("interval", L("video.screenshot.param.mode.label.3")), .init("count", L("video.screenshot.param.mode.label.4")),
            ]),
            .number("timestamp", L("video.screenshot.param.timestamp.label"), default: 1, min: 0, max: 100_000, step: 0.1,
                    visibleWhen: .equals("mode", "single")),
            .number("interval", L("video.screenshot.param.interval.label"), default: 5, min: 0.05, max: 10_000, step: 0.5,
                    visibleWhen: .equals("mode", "interval")),
            .number("count", L("video.screenshot.param.count.label"), default: 9, min: 1, max: 500, step: 1,
                    visibleWhen: .equals("mode", "count")),
            .number("start", L("video.screenshot.param.start.label"), default: 0, min: 0, max: 100_000, step: 0.1,
                    visibleWhen: .notEquals("mode", "single")),
            .number("end", L("video.screenshot.param.end.label"), default: 0, min: 0, max: 100_000, step: 0.1,
                    hint: L("video.screenshot.param.end.hint"),
                    visibleWhen: .notEquals("mode", "single")),
            .picker("format", L("pdf.toimage.param.format.label"), default: "png", options: [
                .init("png", L("video.screenshot.param.format.label")), .init("jpg", L("video.screenshot.param.format.label.2")), .init("webp", "WebP"), .init("tiff", "TIFF"),
            ]),
            .slider("quality", L("video.screenshot.param.quality.label"), default: 92, min: 40, max: 100, step: 1,
                    visibleWhen: .equals("format", "jpg")),
            .picker("scale", L("video.screenshot.param.scale.label"), default: "original", options: VideoOptions.scale),
            .number("customWidth", L("video.screenshot.param.customWidth.label"), default: 1920, min: 16, max: 7680,
                    visibleWhen: .equals("scale", "custom")),
            .toggle("hardwareDecode", L("video.screenshot.param.hardwareDecode.label"), default: true),
        ],
        run: { context in
            var outputs: [URL] = []
            for (index, input) in context.inputs.enumerated() {
                try context.checkCancelled()
                let duration = await MediaProbe.duration(input)
                let mode = context.choice("mode", "single")
                let format = context.choice("format", "png")
                let ext = format
                let scaleArgs = screenshotScale(context)

                // Hardware decoding noticeably speeds up 4K frame extraction.
                let hwaccel = context.bool("hardwareDecode", true)
                    ? ["-hwaccel", "videotoolbox"] : []

                if mode == "single" {
                    let output = context.output(index: index, ext: ext, suffix: L("video.screenshot.param.hardwareDecode.label.2"))
                    // Seek and hardware decoding are input options, so they must
                    // precede -i; seeking here also makes the read instant.
                    let inputArguments = hwaccel
                        + ["-ss", VideoSupport.fmt(context.double("timestamp", 1)), "-i", input.path]
                    var args = scaleArgs
                    args += ["-frames:v", "1", "-q:v", qualityValue(context, format)]
                    outputs.append(try await VideoSupport.encode(
                        context, input: input, output: output, arguments: args,
                        duration: 0, inputArguments: inputArguments))
                    continue
                }

                // Batch modes write a numbered sequence into a scratch folder.
                let scratch = try context.makeScratch()
                defer { FileIO.removeQuietly(scratch) }
                let base = input.deletingPathExtension().lastPathComponent
                let pattern = scratch.appendingPathComponent("\(base)_%04d.\(ext)").path

                var args: [String] = hwaccel
                let start = context.double("start", 0)
                let end = context.double("end", 0)
                if start > 0 { args += ["-ss", VideoSupport.fmt(start)] }
                if end > start { args += ["-to", VideoSupport.fmt(end)] }
                args += ["-i", input.path]

                if mode == "interval" {
                    let interval = max(context.double("interval", 5), 0.05)
                    args += ["-vf", "fps=1/\(VideoSupport.fmt(interval))\(scaleFilterSuffix(context))"]
                } else {
                    let count = max(context.int("count", 9), 1)
                    let window = end > start ? end - start : max(duration - start, 0)
                    let interval = window > 0 ? window / Double(count) : 1
                    args += ["-vf", "fps=1/\(VideoSupport.fmt(interval))\(scaleFilterSuffix(context))"]
                }
                args += ["-frames:v", mode == "interval" ? "100000" : "\(context.int("count", 9))"]
                args += ["-q:v", qualityValue(context, format)]
                args += [pattern]

                let result = try await ProcessRunner.run(
                    "ffmpeg", FFmpeg.baseFlags + args, handle: context.handle,
                    onStdout: FFmpeg.progressHandler(duration: duration, reporter: context.progress))
                if result.cancelled { throw ProcessError.cancelled }
                guard result.exitCode == 0 else {
                    throw ProcessError.failed(code: result.exitCode, message: result.stderr)
                }

                let frames = VideoSupport.sequence(in: scratch, prefix: "\(base)_")
                for (i, frame) in frames.enumerated() {
                    let target = context.output(
                        "\(base)_\(String(format: "%03d", i + 1)).\(ext)")
                    if let committed = try FileIO.commit(
                        frame, to: target, policy: context.settings.conflictPolicy) {
                        outputs.append(committed)
                    }
                }
            }
            return VideoSupport.summarise(outputs, limit: 60)
        }
    ) }

How it works实现原理実装の仕組み구현 원리Comment ça marche

Frame extraction uses the <code>select</code> filter with a modulo on the frame number, which is more precise than time-based extraction (no drift from keyframe alignment).抽帧用 <code>select</code> 滤镜按帧序号取模，比按时间抽帧更精确（不会因关键帧对齐而漂移）。フレーム抽出は <code>select</code> フィルタでフレーム番号の剰余を取ります。時間ベースで抜くより正確です（キーフレーム境界でずれません）。프레임 추출은 <code>select</code> 필터로 프레임 번호를 나머지 연산해 뽑는 편이 시간 기준보다 정확합니다(키프레임 정렬 때문에 밀리지 않습니다).L'extraction d'images utilise le filtre <code>select</code> avec un modulo sur le numéro d'image, plus précis qu'une extraction temporelle (pas de dérive due à l'alignement sur les images clés).
  1. Every Nth frame: <code>select=not(mod(n\,N))</code>, which must be followed by <code>setpts=N/FRAME_RATE/TB</code> to rebuild the timestamps.每 N 帧取一帧：<code>select=not(mod(n\,N))</code>，后面必须跟 <code>setpts=N/FRAME_RATE/TB</code> 重建时间戳。N フレームごとに 1 枚：<code>select=not(mod(n\,N))</code>。この後ろには必ず <code>setpts=N/FRAME_RATE/TB</code> を付けてタイムスタンプを再構築します。N프레임마다 한 장: <code>select=not(mod(n\,N))</code>, 뒤에 반드시 <code>setpts=N/FRAME_RATE/TB</code>를 붙여 타임스탬프를 다시 만듭니다.Une image sur N : <code>select=not(mod(n\,N))</code>, obligatoirement suivi de <code>setpts=N/FRAME_RATE/TB</code> pour reconstruire les horodatages.
  2. You can also extract by frame rate: <code>fps=N</code>.也可以按帧率抽帧：<code>fps=N</code>。フレームレートで抜くこともできます：<code>fps=N</code>。프레임 레이트 기준으로 뽑을 수도 있습니다. <code>fps=N</code>입니다.On peut aussi extraire selon la cadence : <code>fps=N</code>.
  3. Names can use a sequence number or a timecode (the <code>00h01m23s456</code> form, which is safe across filesystems).命名支持序号或时间码（<code>00h01m23s456</code> 形式，跨文件系统安全）。命名は連番かタイムコード（<code>00h01m23s456</code> 形式、ファイルシステムをまたいでも安全）に対応します。이름은 순번이나 타임코드(<code>00h01m23s456</code> 형식, 파일 시스템 간 안전)를 지원합니다.Le nommage accepte un numéro d'ordre ou un timecode (la forme <code>00h01m23s456</code>, sans risque d'un système de fichiers à l'autre).
  4. There is a "max frames to export" cap, so one wrong click can't dump tens of thousands of images and fill the disk.设了「最多导出帧数」上限，防止误操作导出几万张图占满磁盘。「最大書き出しフレーム数」の上限を設け、誤操作で数万枚を書き出してディスクを埋めるのを防ぎます。"최대 내보낼 프레임 수" 상한을 두어, 실수로 수만 장을 뽑아 디스크를 채우는 일을 막습니다.Un plafond « nombre maximal d'images à exporter » évite qu'une fausse manœuvre ne déverse des dizaines de milliers d'images et ne sature le disque.

            .number("end", L("video.screenshot.param.end.label"), default: 10, min: 0, max: 100_000, step: 0.1,
                    visibleWhen: .equals("mode", "range")),
            .number("fps", L("video.frames.param.fps.label"), default: 0, min: 0, max: 240, step: 1,
                    hint: L("video.frames.param.fps.hint")),
            .picker("format", L("pdf.toimage.param.format.label"), default: "png", options: [
                .init("png", L("video.screenshot.param.format.label")), .init("jpg", "JPG"), .init("webp", "WebP"), .init("tiff", "TIFF"),
            ]),
            .slider("quality", L("video.screenshot.param.quality.label"), default: 95, min: 40, max: 100, step: 1,
                    visibleWhen: .equals("format", "jpg")),
            .picker("naming", L("video.frames.param.naming.label"), default: "index", options: [
                .init("index", L("video.frames.param.naming.label.2")), .init("timecode", L("video.frames.param.naming.label.3")),
            ]),
            .toggle("subfolder", L("video.frames.param.subfolder.label"), default: true),
            .number("maxFrames", L("video.frames.param.maxFrames.label"), default: 2000, min: 1, max: 200_000, step: 100,
                    hint: L("video.frames.param.maxFrames.hint")),
        ],
        run: { context in
            var outputs: [URL] = []
            for (index, input) in context.inputs.enumerated() {
                try context.checkCancelled()
                let duration = await MediaProbe.duration(input)
                let info = await MediaProbe.info(for: input)
                let format = context.choice("format", "png")
                let base = input.deletingPathExtension().lastPathComponent

                let destination: URL
                if context.bool("subfolder", true) {
                    destination = context.outputDirectory
                        .appendingPathComponent("\(base)_frames", isDirectory: true)
                    try FileIO.ensureDirectory(destination)
                } else {
                    destination = context.outputDirectory
                }

                let scratch = try context.makeScratch()
                defer { FileIO.removeQuietly(scratch) }
                let pattern = scratch.appendingPathComponent("f_%06d.\(format)").path

                var args: [String] = []
                let mode = context.choice("mode", "everyN")
                if mode == "range" {
                    args += ["-ss", VideoSupport.fmt(context.double("start", 0))]
                    args += ["-to", VideoSupport.fmt(context.double("end", 10))]
                }
                args += ["-i", input.path]

                var filters: [String] = []
                let fps = context.double("fps", 0)
                if fps > 0 {
                    filters.append("fps=\(VideoSupport.fmt(fps))")
                } else if mode == "everyN" {
                    let step = max(context.int("step", 30), 1)
                    filters.append("select=not(mod(n\\,\(step)))")
                    filters.append("setpts=N/FRAME_RATE/TB")
                }
                if !filters.isEmpty { args += ["-vf", filters.joined(separator: ",")] }

                if format == "jpg" {
                    let q = Int(31 - (context.double("quality", 95) / 100) * 29)
                    args += ["-q:v", "\(min(max(q, 2), 31))"]
                } else if format == "png" {
                    args += ["-compression_level", "3"]
                }
                args += ["-frames:v", "\(context.int("maxFrames", 2000))"]
                args += [pattern]

                let result = try await ProcessRunner.run(
                    "ffmpeg", FFmpeg.baseFlags + ["-progress", "pipe:1"] + args,
                    handle: context.handle,
                    onStdout: FFmpeg.progressHandler(duration: duration, reporter: context.progress))
                if result.cancelled { throw ProcessError.cancelled }
                guard result.exitCode == 0 else {
                    throw ProcessError.failed(code: result.exitCode, message: result.stderr)
                }

                let frames = VideoSupport.sequence(in: scratch, prefix: "f_")
                let fpsForTimecode = info?.frameRate ?? 30
                let useTimecode = context.choice("naming", "index") == "timecode"

                for (i, frame) in frames.enumerated() {
                    let name: String
                    if useTimecode {
                        let seconds = fpsForTimecode > 0 ? Double(i) / fpsForTimecode : Double(i)
                        name = "\(base)_\(timecode(seconds)).\(format)"
                    } else {
                        name = "\(base)_\(String(format: "%05d", i + 1)).\(format)"
                    }
                    let target = destination.appendingPathComponent(name)
                    if let committed = try FileIO.commit(
                        frame, to: target, policy: context.settings.conflictPolicy) {
                        outputs.append(committed)
                    }
                }
            }
            return VideoSupport.summarise(outputs, limit: 40)
        }
    ) }

How it works实现原理実装の仕組み구현 원리Comment ça marche

A high-quality GIF uses a <b>two-pass palette</b>: analyze the whole clip to build a dedicated palette, then quantize with it. Visibly better than a single-pass generic palette.高质量 GIF 用<b>两遍调色板</b>：先分析整段素材生成专用调色板，再用它量化。比单遍的通用调色板画质明显更好。高品質な GIF は<b>2 パスパレット</b>を使います：まず素材全体を解析して専用パレットを生成し、それで量子化します。1 パスの汎用パレットより画質が明らかに良くなります。고품질 GIF는 <b>2패스 팔레트</b>를 씁니다. 먼저 소재 전체를 분석해 전용 팔레트를 만들고, 그것으로 양자화합니다. 단일 패스의 범용 팔레트보다 화질이 확실히 좋습니다.Un GIF de qualité passe par une <b>palette en deux passes</b> : on analyse d'abord toute la séquence pour bâtir une palette dédiée, puis on quantifie avec elle. Le gain de qualité est net face à une palette générique en une passe.
  1. Pass one: <code>palettegen</code> analyzes every frame in the range and writes out a palette PNG.第一遍：<code>palettegen</code> 分析区间内所有帧，输出一张调色板 PNG。1 パス目：<code>palettegen</code> が区間内の全フレームを解析し、パレット PNG を 1 枚出力します。1패스: <code>palettegen</code>이 구간 안의 모든 프레임을 분석해 팔레트 PNG 한 장을 출력합니다.Première passe : <code>palettegen</code> analyse toutes les images de la plage et produit un PNG de palette.
  2. Pass two: feed the palette in as the second input and quantize with <code>paletteuse</code>.第二遍：把调色板作为第二个输入，用 <code>paletteuse</code> 量化。2 パス目：そのパレットを 2 番目の入力にし、<code>paletteuse</code> で量子化します。2패스: 팔레트를 두 번째 입력으로 넣고 <code>paletteuse</code>로 양자화합니다.Seconde passe : la palette entre comme second flux et <code>paletteuse</code> effectue la quantification.
  3. The chain is <code>fps -> scale(lanczos) -> [reverse] -> palettegen/paletteuse</code>.链条是 <code>fps → scale(lanczos) → [reverse] → palettegen/paletteuse</code>。チェーンは <code>fps → scale(lanczos) → [reverse] → palettegen/paletteuse</code> です。체인은 <code>fps → scale(lanczos) → [reverse] → palettegen/paletteuse</code>입니다.La chaîne est <code>fps → scale(lanczos) → [reverse] → palettegen/paletteuse</code>.
  4. Loop count maps onto <code>-loop</code>: infinite = 0, play once = -1, 3 times = 2.循环次数映射到 <code>-loop</code>：无限=0，播放一次=-1，3 次=2。ループ回数は <code>-loop</code> に写像します：無限 = 0、1 回再生 = -1、3 回 = 2。반복 횟수는 <code>-loop</code>로 매핑합니다. 무한=0, 한 번 재생=-1, 3회=2입니다.Le nombre de boucles correspond à <code>-loop</code> : infini = 0, une seule lecture = -1, 3 fois = 2.
Further notes补充说明補足보충 설명Remarques complémentaires
  • GIF file size grows fast, so the UI suggests keeping clips under 10 seconds.GIF 体积增长很快，界面上提示建议不超过 10 秒。GIF はサイズが急増するため、画面には 10 秒以内を推奨する旨を表示します。GIF는 용량이 빠르게 늘어나므로, 화면에는 10초를 넘기지 않기를 권한다는 안내를 띄웁니다.Le poids d'un GIF grimpe vite ; l'interface conseille de ne pas dépasser 10 secondes.
  • Dithering is selectable: none / Bayer / Sierra 2-4A / Floyd-Steinberg.抖动算法可选：无 / Bayer / Sierra 2-4A / Floyd-Steinberg。ディザアルゴリズムは選択式です：なし / Bayer / Sierra 2-4A / Floyd-Steinberg。디더링 알고리즘은 선택할 수 있습니다. 없음 / Bayer / Sierra 2-4A / Floyd-Steinberg.Le tramage est au choix : aucun / Bayer / Sierra 2-4A / Floyd-Steinberg.

    static var tool: Tool { Tool(
        id: "video.gif",
        name: L("video.gif.name"),
        summary: L("video.gif.summary"),
        symbol: "photo.stack",
        category: .video,
        accepts: ["mp4", "mov", "mkv", "avi", "webm", "m4v", "ts"],
                requiresFFmpeg: true,
        actionTitle: L("image.gif.action"),
        parameters: [
            .number("start", L("video.frames.param.start.label"), default: 0, min: 0, max: 100_000, step: 0.1),
            .number("duration", L("video.gif.param.duration.label"), default: 5, min: 0.1, max: 600, step: 0.5,
                    hint: L("video.gif.param.duration.hint")),
            .slider("fps", L("ui.frame_rate"), default: 15, min: 5, max: 50, step: 1,
                    hint: L("video.gif.param.fps.hint")),
            .number("width", L("image.resize.param.width.label"), default: 480, min: 40, max: 2000, step: 20,
                    hint: L("video.gif.param.width.hint")),
            .picker("dither", L("video.gif.param.dither.label"), default: "sierra2_4a", options: [
                .init("none", L("enum.transition.none")), .init("bayer", "Bayer"), .init("sierra2_4a", "Sierra 2-4A"),
                .init("floyd_steinberg", "Floyd-Steinberg"),
            ]),
            .slider("colors", L("ui.palette_colours"), default: 256, min: 16, max: 256, step: 8,
                    hint: L("video.gif.param.colors.hint")),
            .picker("loop", L("ui.looping"), default: "forever", options: [
                .init("forever", L("video.gif.param.loop.label")), .init("once", L("video.gif.param.loop.label.2")), .init("3", L("video.gif.param.loop.label.3")),
            ]),
            .toggle("reverse", L("ui.reverse"), default: false),
            .toggle("highQuality", L("video.gif.param.highQuality.label"), default: true,
                    hint: L("video.gif.param.highQuality.hint")),
        ],
        run: { context in
            var outputs: [URL] = []
            for (index, input) in context.inputs.enumerated() {
                try context.checkCancelled()
                let output = context.output(index: index, ext: "gif", suffix: "")
                let start = context.double("start", 0)
                let clipDuration = context.double("duration", 5)
                let fps = context.double("fps", 15)
                let width = context.int("width", 480)
                let dither = context.choice("dither", "sierra2_4a")
                let colors = context.int("colors", 256)
                let reverse = context.bool("reverse", false)

                var chain = "fps=\(VideoSupport.fmt(fps)),scale=\(width):-2:flags=lanczos"
                if reverse { chain += ",reverse" }

                let scratch = try context.makeScratch()
                defer { FileIO.removeQuietly(scratch) }
                let paletteURL = scratch.appendingPathComponent("palette.png")
                let temp = scratch.appendingPathComponent("out.gif")

                let seek = ["-ss", VideoSupport.fmt(start), "-t", VideoSupport.fmt(clipDuration), "-i", input.path]

                if context.bool("highQuality", true) {
                    // Pass 1: derive an optimal palette from the actual clip.
                    let paletteArgs = FFmpeg.baseFlags + seek + [
                        "-vf", "\(chain),palettegen=max_colors=\(colors):stats_mode=diff",
                        "-y", paletteURL.path,
                    ]
                    let pass1 = try await ProcessRunner.run(
                        "ffmpeg", paletteArgs, handle: context.handle)
                    if pass1.cancelled { throw ProcessError.cancelled }
                    guard pass1.exitCode == 0 else {
                        throw ProcessError.failed(code: pass1.exitCode, message: pass1.stderr)
                    }

                    // Pass 2: apply the palette.
                    let useArgs = FFmpeg.baseFlags + [
                        "-progress", "pipe:1",
                        "-ss", VideoSupport.fmt(start), "-t", VideoSupport.fmt(clipDuration),
                        "-i", input.path, "-i", paletteURL.path,
                        "-lavfi", "\(chain)[x];[x][1:v]paletteuse=dither=\(dither)",
                        "-loop", loopValue(context),
                        "-y", temp.path,
                    ]
                    let pass2 = try await ProcessRunner.run(
                        "ffmpeg", useArgs, handle: context.handle,
                        onStdout: FFmpeg.progressHandler(duration: clipDuration, reporter: context.progress))
                    if pass2.cancelled { throw ProcessError.cancelled }
                    guard pass2.exitCode == 0 else {
                        throw ProcessError.failed(code: pass2.exitCode, message: pass2.stderr)
                    }
                } else {
                    let args = FFmpeg.baseFlags + [
                        "-progress", "pipe:1",
                    ] + seek + [
                        "-vf", "\(chain),split[s0][s1];[s0]palettegen=max_colors=\(colors)[p];[s1][p]paletteuse=dither=\(dither)",
                        "-loop", loopValue(context),
                        "-y", temp.path,
                    ]
                    let result = try await ProcessRunner.run(
                        "ffmpeg", args, handle: context.handle,
                        onStdout: FFmpeg.progressHandler(duration: clipDuration, reporter: context.progress))
                    if result.cancelled { throw ProcessError.cancelled }
                    guard result.exitCode == 0 else {
                        throw ProcessError.failed(code: result.exitCode, message: result.stderr)
                    }
                }

                if let committed = try FileIO.commit(
                    temp, to: output, policy: context.settings.conflictPolicy) {
                    outputs.append(committed)
                }
            }
            return outputs
        }
    ) }

How it works实现原理実装の仕組み구현 원리Comment ça marche

ffmpeg's image2 demuxer requires consecutively numbered filenames, so the user's files are first copied to canonical names before assembling.ffmpeg 的 image2 解复用器要求文件名是连续编号的，所以先把用户选的文件复制成规范命名再合成。ffmpeg の image2 デマルチプレクサはファイル名が連番であることを要求するため、まずユーザーが選んだファイルを規約に沿った名前へコピーしてから合成します。ffmpeg의 image2 디먹서는 파일 이름이 연속 번호여야 하므로, 사용자가 고른 파일을 먼저 규칙적인 이름으로 복사한 뒤 합성합니다.Le démultiplexeur image2 de ffmpeg exige des noms de fichiers numérotés consécutivement : on copie donc d'abord les fichiers choisis sous des noms normalisés avant l'assemblage.
  1. Copy the inputs into a temp directory in order, naming them <code>frame_%05d.ext</code>.把输入按顺序复制到临时目录，命名为 <code>frame_%05d.ext</code>。入力を順に一時ディレクトリへコピーし、<code>frame_%05d.ext</code> と命名します。입력을 순서대로 임시 디렉터리에 복사하고 <code>frame_%05d.ext</code>로 이름을 붙입니다.On copie les entrées dans un dossier temporaire, dans l'ordre, sous les noms <code>frame_%05d.ext</code>.
  2. Set the input frame rate with <code>-framerate</code> and read the numbered sequence.用 <code>-framerate</code> 指定输入帧率，读取编号序列。<code>-framerate</code> で入力フレームレートを指定し、連番を読み込みます。<code>-framerate</code>로 입력 프레임 레이트를 지정해 번호 시퀀스를 읽습니다.On fixe la cadence d'entrée avec <code>-framerate</code> et on lit la séquence numérotée.
  3. "Hold each image for N seconds" translates to a frame rate of <code>1/N</code>.「每张停留 N 秒」换算成帧率 <code>1/N</code>。「1 枚あたり N 秒表示」はフレームレート <code>1/N</code> に換算します。"한 장당 N초 정지"는 프레임 레이트 <code>1/N</code>으로 환산합니다.« Chaque image reste N secondes » se traduit par une cadence de <code>1/N</code>.
  4. For looping playback, <code>split</code> + <code>reverse</code> + <code>concat</code> build a seamless forward-plus-reverse loop.循环播放用 <code>split</code> + <code>reverse</code> + <code>concat</code> 生成正放加倒放的无缝循环。ループ再生は <code>split</code> + <code>reverse</code> + <code>concat</code> で、正再生と逆再生を繋いだシームレスループを生成します。반복 재생은 <code>split</code> + <code>reverse</code> + <code>concat</code>으로 정방향과 역방향을 이어 끊김 없는 루프를 만듭니다.Pour une lecture en boucle, <code>split</code> + <code>reverse</code> + <code>concat</code> composent une boucle sans couture, en avant puis en arrière.

    static var tool: Tool { Tool(
        id: "video.fromimages",
        name: L("video.fromimages.name"),
        summary: L("video.fromimages.summary"),
        symbol: "photo.on.rectangle.angled",
        category: .video,
        accepts: ["png", "jpg", "jpeg", "tiff", "bmp", "heic", "webp"],
                requiresFFmpeg: true,
        actionTitle: L("video.fromimages.action"),
        parameters: [
            .slider("fps", L("ui.frame_rate"), default: 30, min: 1, max: 120, step: 1),
            .picker("codec", L("video.fromimages.param.codec.label"), default: "h264", options: [
                .init("h264", "H.264"), .init("hevc", "H.265"), .init("prores", "ProRes"),
            ]),
            .slider("crf", L("video.fromimages.param.crf.label"), default: 18, min: 10, max: 34, step: 1),
            .number("width", L("video.fromimages.param.width.label"), default: 0, min: 0, max: 7680, step: 2,
                    hint: L("video.fromimages.param.width.hint")),
            .picker("fit", L("video.fromimages.param.fit.label"), default: "pad", options: [
                .init("pad", L("video.fromimages.param.fit.label.2")), .init("crop", L("enum.fitmode.contain.2")),
            ]),
            .toggle("loop", L("video.fromimages.param.loop.label"), default: false),
            .number("holdSeconds", L("video.fromimages.param.holdSeconds.label"), default: 0, min: 0, max: 60, step: 0.1,
                    hint: L("video.fromimages.param.holdSeconds.hint")),
        ],
        minimumInputs: 2,
        run: { context in
            let scratch = try context.makeScratch()
            defer { FileIO.removeQuietly(scratch) }

            // ffmpeg's image2 demuxer needs uniform names, so relink the inputs.
            let ext = context.inputs[0].pathExtension.lowercased()
            for (i, url) in context.inputs.enumerated() {
                let target = scratch.appendingPathComponent(
                    String(format: "frame_%05d.%@", i + 1, ext))
                try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: target)
                try FileManager.default.copyItem(at: url, to: target)
            }

            let codec = VideoCodec(rawValue: context.choice("codec", "h264")) ?? .h264
            let output = context.output(ext: codec.preferredExtension, suffix: L("video.fromimages.param.holdSeconds.label.2"))
            var fps = context.double("fps", 30)
            let hold = context.double("holdSeconds", 0)
            if hold > 0 { fps = 1 / hold }

            let width = context.int("width", 0)
            var filters: [String] = []
            if width > 0 {
                if context.choice("fit", "pad") == "crop" {
                    filters.append("scale=\(width):-2:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase")
                } else {
                    filters.append("scale=\(width):-2:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease")
                }
            }
            if context.bool("loop") {
                // Reverse then forward, played once, gives a seamless loop.
                filters.append("split[a][b];[b]reverse[r];[a][r]concat=n=2:v=1:a=0")
            }

            var args = [
                "-framerate", VideoSupport.fmt(fps),
                "-i", scratch.appendingPathComponent("frame_%05d.\(ext)").path,
            ]
            if !filters.isEmpty { args += ["-vf", filters.joined(separator: ",")] }
            args += FFmpeg.videoArgs(
                codec: codec,
                quality: context.double("crf", 18),
                hardware: context.settings.useHardwareAcceleration && codec != .prores,
                preset: "medium")
            args += ["-pix_fmt", "yuv420p"]

            let total = Double(context.inputs.count) / max(fps, 0.001)
            return [try await VideoSupport.encode(
                context, input: context.inputs[0], output: output,
                arguments: args, duration: total)]
        }
    ) }

How it works实现原理実装の仕組み구현 원리Comment ça marche

Transitions use the <code>xfade</code> filter, but it <b>requires every input to have identical geometry</b>, so each image has to be normalized first.转场用 <code>xfade</code> 滤镜，但它<b>要求所有输入几何完全一致</b>，所以必须先归一化每张图。トランジションは <code>xfade</code> フィルタを使いますが、これが<b>すべての入力のジオメトリが完全に一致していることを要求する</b>ため、まず各画像を正規化する必要があります。전환에는 <code>xfade</code> 필터를 쓰는데, 이 필터는 <b>모든 입력의 기하가 완전히 같아야 하므로</b> 각 이미지를 먼저 정규화해야 합니다.Les transitions passent par le filtre <code>xfade</code>, mais il <b>exige une géométrie identique pour toutes les entrées</b> : chaque image doit donc être normalisée au préalable.
  1. First scale each image to the target resolution, either padding with <code>contain</code> or cropping with <code>cover</code>.先把每张图按目标分辨率缩放，<code>contain</code> 补边或 <code>cover</code> 裁剪。まず各画像を目標解像度に縮小し、<code>contain</code> で余白を足すか <code>cover</code> で切り抜きます。먼저 각 이미지를 대상 해상도로 축소하고, <code>contain</code>으로 여백을 채우거나 <code>cover</code>로 자릅니다.On met d'abord chaque image à l'échelle de la résolution cible, en complétant les bords avec <code>contain</code> ou en recadrant avec <code>cover</code>.
  2. Optional Ken Burns effect: a slow push-in with <code>zoompan</code>.可选 Ken Burns 效果：用 <code>zoompan</code> 做缓慢推近。任意で Ken Burns 効果：<code>zoompan</code> でゆっくり寄ります。선택 사항인 Ken Burns 효과: <code>zoompan</code>으로 천천히 밀어 넣습니다.Effet Ken Burns facultatif : un lent zoom avant avec <code>zoompan</code>.
  3. Each image is its own input and needs <code>-loop 1 -t duration</code> - a still is a single frame, so without looping there is nothing to cross-fade.每张图作为独立输入，并且要 <code>-loop 1 -t 时长</code>——静态图只有一帧，不循环就没有素材可以交叉淡化。各画像は独立した入力にし、しかも <code>-loop 1 -t 長さ</code> を付けます——静止画は 1 フレームしかないので、ループさせないとクロスフェードする素材がありません。각 이미지를 독립 입력으로 넣고 <code>-loop 1 -t 길이</code>를 붙여야 합니다. 정지 이미지는 한 프레임뿐이라 루프하지 않으면 교차 페이드할 소재가 없습니다.Chaque image est une entrée à part, avec <code>-loop 1 -t durée</code> — une image fixe ne compte qu'une frame, et sans boucle il n'y a rien à fondre enchaîné.
  4. Chain them with <code>xfade</code>, accumulating <code>offset</code> by <code>per-image duration - transition duration</code> each time.用 <code>xfade</code> 串联，每次的 <code>offset</code> 累加<code>每张时长 − 转场时长</code>。<code>xfade</code> で繋ぎ、各回の <code>offset</code> は<code>1 枚あたりの長さ − トランジション長</code>ずつ加算します。<code>xfade</code>로 이어 붙이되, 매번 <code>offset</code>에 <code>각 장 길이 − 전환 길이</code>를 누적합니다.On les enchaîne avec <code>xfade</code>, en incrémentant <code>offset</code> de <code>durée par image − durée de transition</code>.
Further notes补充说明補足보충 설명Remarques complémentaires
  • Total duration = count * per-image duration - (count-1) * transition duration. Measured: 3 images at 1 second with a 0.6-second transition = 1.8 seconds.总时长 = 张数 × 每张时长 − (张数−1) × 转场时长。实测 3 张 1 秒 + 0.6 秒转场 = 1.8 秒。合計時間 = 枚数 × 1 枚あたりの長さ − (枚数−1) × トランジション長。実測では 3 枚 1 秒 + 0.6 秒トランジション = 1.8 秒です。총 길이 = 장수 × 각 장 길이 − (장수−1) × 전환 길이. 실측으로 1초짜리 3장 + 0.6초 전환 = 1.8초였습니다.Durée totale = nombre d'images × durée par image − (nombre − 1) × durée de transition. Mesuré : 3 images de 1 seconde avec une transition de 0,6 seconde = 1,8 seconde.
  • Background music goes in as the last input, with <code>-shortest</code> to match the length.背景音乐作为最后一个输入，用 <code>-shortest</code> 对齐长度。BGM は最後の入力にし、<code>-shortest</code> で長さを揃えます。배경 음악은 마지막 입력으로 넣고 <code>-shortest</code>로 길이를 맞춥니다.La musique de fond entre en dernier, avec <code>-shortest</code> pour aligner les durées.

            .toggle("kenBurns", L("video.slideshow.param.kenBurns.label"), default: false,
                    hint: L("video.slideshow.param.kenBurns.hint")),
            .slider("crf", L("video.fromimages.param.crf.label"), default: 20, min: 12, max: 34, step: 1),
        ],
        hasCustomEditor: true,
        minimumInputs: 2,
        run: { context in
            let perImage = context.double("perImage", 3)
            let transition = context.choice("transition", "fade")
            let transitionDuration = transition == "none" ? 0 : context.double("transitionDuration", 0.6)
            let fps = Double(context.choice("fps", "30")) ?? 30
            let (width, height) = slideshowDimensions(context.choice("resolution", "1080p"))
            let background = context.string("background", "black")
            let fit = context.choice("fit", "contain")
            let images = context.inputs.filter { !$0.pathExtension.isAudioExtension }
            guard images.count >= 2 else {
                throw ProcessError.failed(code: 0, message: L("video.slideshow.param.crf.label"))
            }

            let output = context.output(ext: "mp4", suffix: L("video.slideshow.param.crf.label.2"))
            let scratch = try context.makeScratch()
            defer { FileIO.removeQuietly(scratch) }

            // Normalise every image to the same size and pixel format first;
            // xfade requires identical geometry across inputs.
            var normalised: [URL] = []
            for (i, image) in images.enumerated() {
                try context.checkCancelled()
                let target = scratch.appendingPathComponent(String(format: "n_%04d.png", i))
                var filters = "scale=\(width):\(height):force_original_aspect_ratio=\(fit == "cover" ? "increase" : "decrease")"
                if fit == "cover" {
                    filters += ",crop=\(width):\(height)"
                } else {
                    filters += ",pad=\(width):\(height):(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2:color=\(background)"
                }
                filters += ",setsar=1,format=yuv420p"
                if context.bool("kenBurns", false) {
                    // zoompan needs a generous source so the zoom stays sharp.
                    filters += ",scale=\(width * 2):\(height * 2),zoompan=z='min(zoom+0.0008,1.15)':d=\(Int(perImage * fps)):s=\(width)x\(height):fps=\(VideoSupport.fmt(fps))"
                }
                let args = FFmpeg.baseFlags + [
                    "-i", image.path, "-vf", filters, "-frames:v", "1", "-y", target.path,
                ]
                let result = try await ProcessRunner.run("ffmpeg", args, handle: context.handle)
                guard result.exitCode == 0 else {
                    throw ProcessError.failed(code: result.exitCode,
                                              message: L("video.slideshow.param.crf.label.3", image.lastPathComponent, result.stderr))
                }
                normalised.append(target)
                context.progress.report(Double(i + 1) / Double(images.count) * 0.3)
            }

            // Build the xfade chain. Every still is its own ffmpeg input, so
            // the preamble is assembled here rather than by the helper.
            var inputArguments: [String] = []
            for url in normalised {
                // A still decodes to a single frame; loop it so the xfade
                // offsets below actually have footage to blend.
                inputArguments += ["-loop", "1", "-t", VideoSupport.fmt(perImage), "-i", url.path]
            }
            let audioInput = context.inputs.first(where: { $0.pathExtension.isAudioExtension })
            if let audioInput { inputArguments += ["-i", audioInput.path] }
            var args: [String] = []

            var filters: [String] = []
            var lastLabel = "0:v"
            var offset = perImage - transitionDuration

            for i in 1..<normalised.count {
                let outLabel = i == normalised.count - 1 ? "vout" : "v\(i)"
                if transition == "none" {
                    filters.append("[\(lastLabel)][\(i):v]concat=n=2:v=1:a=0[\(outLabel)]")
                } else {
                    filters.append(
                        "[\(lastLabel)][\(i):v]xfade=transition=\(transition):duration=\(VideoSupport.fmt(transitionDuration)):offset=\(VideoSupport.fmt(offset))[\(outLabel)]")
                    offset += perImage - transitionDuration
                }
                lastLabel = outLabel
            }
            if normalised.count == 1 { filters.append("[0:v]null[vout]") }

            args += ["-filter_complex", filters.joined(separator: ";")]
            args += ["-map", "[vout]"]
            if context.inputs.contains(where: { $0.pathExtension.isAudioExtension }) {
                args += ["-map", "\(normalised.count):a", "-shortest"]
                args += ["-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "192k"]
            }
            args += FFmpeg.videoArgs(codec: .h264, quality: context.double("crf", 20),
                                     hardware: context.settings.useHardwareAcceleration,
                                     preset: "medium")
            args += ["-r", VideoSupport.fmt(fps), "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p", "-movflags", "+faststart"]

            let total = Double(normalised.count) * perImage
            let produced = try await VideoSupport.encode(
                context, input: normalised[0], output: output,
                arguments: args, duration: total, inputArguments: inputArguments)
            context.progress.report(1)
            return [produced]
        }
    ) }

How it works实现原理実装の仕組み구현 원리Comment ça marche

Extracting an audio track and removing one are opposite operations that share a single tool entry point.分离音轨与移除音轨是相反操作，共用同一个工具入口。音声トラックの分離と削除は逆の操作で、同じツールの入口を共有しています。오디오 분리와 오디오 제거는 반대 작업이지만 같은 도구 진입점을 공유합니다.Extraire une piste audio et la supprimer sont deux opérations opposées, réunies derrière une même entrée d'outil.
  1. Extract: add <code>-vn</code> (no video) and pick the encoder for the target format.提取：加 <code>-vn</code>（不要视频），按目标格式选编码器。抽出：<code>-vn</code>（映像なし）を付け、目的の形式に応じてエンコーダを選びます。추출: <code>-vn</code>(비디오 제외)을 붙이고 대상 형식에 맞는 인코더를 고릅니다.Extraction : on ajoute <code>-vn</code> (pas de vidéo) et on choisit l'encodeur selon le format cible.
  2. Remove: use <code>-c copy -an</code>; the video stream is copied without re-encoding, so it finishes instantly.移除：用 <code>-c copy -an</code>，视频流直接复制不重新编码，秒完成。削除：<code>-c copy -an</code> を使い、映像ストリームは再エンコードせずコピーするので一瞬で終わります。제거: <code>-c copy -an</code>을 씁니다. 비디오 스트림은 재인코딩 없이 그대로 복사되어 즉시 끝납니다.Suppression : <code>-c copy -an</code>, le flux vidéo est copié sans réencodage, donc l'opération est instantanée.
  3. The optional "also keep a silent video" writes a second video with the audio track stripped after extracting the audio.可选「同时保留无声视频」会在提取音频后再输出一个去掉音轨的视频。任意の「無音映像も同時に保持」は、音声を抽出したうえで音声トラックを外した動画も出力します。선택 사항인 "무음 비디오도 함께 보관"은 오디오를 추출한 뒤 오디오 트랙을 뺀 비디오를 하나 더 출력합니다.L'option « conserver aussi une vidéo muette » produit, après extraction de l'audio, une seconde vidéo dépourvue de piste son.

How it works实现原理実装の仕組み구현 원리Comment ça marche

Replacing and mixing are two different needs: replacing means "overwrite with the new track", mixing means "play both tracks at once".替换与混合是两种不同需求：替换是「用新音轨覆盖」，混合是「两条音轨同时播放」。置き換えとミックスは別の要求です：置き換えは「新しい音声トラックで上書き」、ミックスは「2 つの音声トラックを同時に再生」です。교체와 믹스는 서로 다른 요구입니다. 교체는 "새 오디오 트랙으로 덮기", 믹스는 "두 오디오 트랙을 동시에 재생"입니다.Remplacer et mixer répondent à deux besoins différents : remplacer, c'est « écraser avec la nouvelle piste » ; mixer, c'est « faire jouer les deux pistes ensemble ».
  1. First split the inputs into a video group and an audio group by extension, and take one from each.先按扩展名把输入分成视频组与音频组，取各一个。まず拡張子で入力を映像グループと音声グループに分け、それぞれ 1 つずつ取ります。먼저 확장자로 입력을 비디오 그룹과 오디오 그룹으로 나누고 각각 하나씩 고릅니다.On répartit d'abord les entrées en un groupe vidéo et un groupe audio selon l'extension, et on en prend une de chaque.
  2. Replace: use <code>-map 0:v -map [a1]</code> and copy the video stream.替换：用 <code>-map 0:v -map [a1]</code>，视频流复制。置き換え：<code>-map 0:v -map [a1]</code> を使い、映像ストリームはコピーします。교체: <code>-map 0:v -map [a1]</code>을 쓰고 비디오 스트림은 복사합니다.Remplacement : <code>-map 0:v -map [a1]</code>, avec copie du flux vidéo.
  3. Mix: blend the original track and the new one with <code>amix=inputs=2:duration=first</code>.混合：用 <code>amix=inputs=2:duration=first</code> 把原音轨与新音轨混合。ミックス：<code>amix=inputs=2:duration=first</code> で元の音声トラックと新しい音声トラックを混ぜます。믹스: <code>amix=inputs=2:duration=first</code>로 원래 오디오와 새 오디오를 섞습니다.Mixage : on combine la piste d'origine et la nouvelle avec <code>amix=inputs=2:duration=first</code>.
  4. Volume, delay and fades are strung together into a single audio filter chain.音量、延迟、淡入淡出串成一条音频滤镜链。音量・遅延・フェードイン/アウトを 1 本の音声フィルタチェーンに繋ぎます。볼륨, 지연, 페이드 인/아웃을 하나의 오디오 필터 체인으로 엮습니다.Volume, délai et fondus s'enchaînent en une seule chaîne de filtres audio.
Further notes补充说明補足보충 설명Remarques complémentaires
  • When the filter chain is empty, <code>anull</code> has to be added, otherwise an empty filter graph is produced and it errors out. This bug fires with the default parameters.滤镜链为空时必须补 <code>anull</code>，否则会生成空滤镜图导致报错。这个 bug 在默认参数下就会触发。フィルタチェーンが空のときは <code>anull</code> を補う必要があります。そうしないと空のフィルタグラフが生成されてエラーになります。このバグは既定のパラメータでも発生します。필터 체인이 비어 있으면 반드시 <code>anull</code>을 채워야 합니다. 그러지 않으면 빈 필터 그래프가 생겨 오류가 납니다. 이 버그는 기본 파라미터에서도 발생했습니다.Quand la chaîne de filtres est vide, il faut ajouter <code>anull</code>, sinon un graphe de filtres vide provoque une erreur. Ce bug se déclenche avec les paramètres par défaut.

How it works实现原理実装の仕組み구현 원리Comment ça marche

Cover art can be an image embedded in the video, or an image exported from one of its frames.封面既可以是嵌入视频的图片，也可以是从某一帧导出的图片。カバーは動画に埋め込まれた画像にも、あるフレームから書き出した画像にもなれます。커버는 동영상에 삽입하는 이미지일 수도 있고, 특정 프레임에서 내보낸 이미지일 수도 있습니다.La pochette peut être une image intégrée à la vidéo, ou une image exportée depuis l'une de ses frames.
  1. Set cover: add the image as the second input, flag it as an attached picture with <code>-disposition:v:1 attached_pic</code>, and copy the video stream.设置封面：把图片作为第二个输入，用 <code>-disposition:v:1 attached_pic</code> 标记为附加图片，视频流复制。カバーを設定：画像を 2 番目の入力にし、<code>-disposition:v:1 attached_pic</code> で添付画像として印を付け、映像ストリームはコピーします。커버 설정: 이미지를 두 번째 입력으로 넣고 <code>-disposition:v:1 attached_pic</code>으로 첨부 이미지로 표시하며, 비디오 스트림은 복사합니다.Définir la pochette : l'image entre comme second flux, on la marque comme image jointe avec <code>-disposition:v:1 attached_pic</code>, et le flux vidéo est copié.
  2. Extract cover: first ask ffprobe whether an <code>attached_pic</code> stream exists; if it does, take <code>0:v:1</code>, otherwise take the first frame.提取封面：先用 ffprobe 查询是否存在 <code>attached_pic</code> 流，有就取 <code>0:v:1</code>，没有就取第一帧。カバーを抽出：まず ffprobe で <code>attached_pic</code> ストリームの有無を調べ、あれば <code>0:v:1</code> を取り、なければ最初のフレームを取ります。커버 추출: 먼저 ffprobe로 <code>attached_pic</code> 스트림이 있는지 조회해 있으면 <code>0:v:1</code>을, 없으면 첫 프레임을 가져옵니다.Extraire la pochette : on demande d'abord à ffprobe si un flux <code>attached_pic</code> existe ; si oui on prend <code>0:v:1</code>, sinon la première frame.
  3. Generate from a frame: seek with <code>-ss</code> and grab one frame.从帧生成：<code>-ss</code> 跳转后取一帧。フレームから生成：<code>-ss</code> でシークして 1 フレーム取ります。프레임에서 생성: <code>-ss</code>로 이동한 뒤 한 프레임을 가져옵니다.Générer depuis une frame : on se positionne avec <code>-ss</code> et on prélève une frame.

    static var tool: Tool { Tool(
        id: "video.cover",
        name: L("video.cover.name"),
        summary: L("video.cover.summary"),
        symbol: "photo.badge.arrow.down",
        category: .video,
        accepts: ["mp4", "mov", "mkv", "m4v", "png", "jpg", "jpeg", "heic", "tiff", "bmp", "webp"],
                requiresFFmpeg: true,
        actionTitle: L("video.cover.action"),
        actionVariants: ["action=extract": L("ui.extract_cover"), "action=frame": L("ui.generate_cover")],
        parameters: [
            .picker("action", L("doc.pdfsecurity.param.action.label"), default: "set", options: [
                .init("set", L("video.cover.action"), detail: L("video.cover.param.action.label")),
                .init("extract", L("ui.extract_cover"), detail: L("video.cover.param.action.label.2")),
                .init("frame", L("video.cover.param.action.label.3"), detail: L("video.cover.param.action.label.4")),
            ]),
            .number("timestamp", L("video.screenshot.param.timestamp.label"), default: 1, min: 0, max: 100_000, step: 0.1,
                    visibleWhen: .oneOf("action", ["frame"])),
            .picker("format", L("video.cover.param.format.label"), default: "jpg", options: [
                .init("jpg", "JPG"), .init("png", "PNG"),
            ], visibleWhen: .oneOf("action", ["extract", "frame"])),
        ],
        minimumInputs: 1,
        run: { context in
            let action = context.choice("action", "set")

            if action == "set" {
                let videos = context.inputs.filter { !$0.pathExtension.isImageExtension }
                let images = context.inputs.filter { $0.pathExtension.isImageExtension }
                guard let video = videos.first, let image = images.first else {
                    throw ProcessError.failed(code: 0, message: L("video.cover.param.format.label.2"))
                }
                let output = context.output(ext: video.pathExtension, suffix: L("video.cover.param.format.label.3"))
                let args = [
                    "-map", "0", "-map", "1",
                    "-c", "copy",
                    "-disposition:v:1", "attached_pic",
                    "-metadata:s:v:1", "title=Cover",
                ]
                return [try await VideoSupport.encode(
                    context, input: video, output: output, arguments: args,
                    duration: await MediaProbe.duration(video),
                    inputArguments: ["-i", video.path, "-i", image.path])]
            }

            guard let video = context.inputs.first else {
                throw ProcessError.failed(code: 0, message: L("video.cover.param.format.label.4"))
            }
            let format = context.choice("format", "jpg")
            let output = context.output(ext: format, suffix: L("video.cover.param.format.label.3"))

            if action == "extract" {
                // Prefer an embedded attached picture; fall back to the first frame.
                let info = (try? await ProcessRunner.capture("ffprobe", [
                    "-v", "error", "-select_streams", "v",
                    "-show_entries", "stream=index,disposition=attached_pic",
                    "-of", "csv=p=0", video.path,
                ])) ?? ""
                let hasAttached = info.split(separator: "\n").contains { $0.contains("1") }
                var args: [String] = []
                if hasAttached {
                    args += ["-map", "0:v:1", "-frames:v", "1"]
                } else {
                    args += ["-map", "0:v:0", "-frames:v", "1"]
                }
                args += ["-q:v", "2"]
                return [try await VideoSupport.encode(
                    context, input: video, output: output, arguments: args, duration: 0)]
            }

            let timestamp = context.double("timestamp", 1)
            let args = [
                "-ss", VideoSupport.fmt(timestamp),
                "-frames:v", "1", "-q:v", "2",
            ]
            return [try await VideoSupport.encode(
                context, input: video, output: output, arguments: args, duration: 0)]
        }
    ) }

How it works实现原理実装の仕組み구현 원리Comment ça marche

Change the file hash while <b>not re-encoding and not touching the picture</b>, purely by editing metadata and remuxing the file structure.改变文件哈希但<b>不重新编码、不改变画面</b>，靠改元数据和重新封装文件结构实现。ファイルのハッシュを変えつつ<b>再エンコードもせず、映像も変えない</b>——メタデータの変更とファイル構造の再パッケージで実現します。파일 해시를 바꾸되 <b>재인코딩하지 않고 화면도 바꾸지 않습니다</b>. 메타데이터를 고치고 파일 구조를 다시 패키징하는 방식으로 구현합니다.Modifier le hachage d'un fichier <b>sans réencoder ni toucher à l'image</b>, uniquement en changeant les métadonnées et en remultiplexant la structure du fichier.
  1. Copy every stream with <code>-c copy</code>, so not a single bit is re-encoded.用 <code>-c copy</code> 复制所有流，一个比特都不重新编码。<code>-c copy</code> ですべてのストリームをコピーし、1 ビットも再エンコードしません。<code>-c copy</code>로 모든 스트림을 복사해 비트 하나도 재인코딩하지 않습니다.On copie tous les flux avec <code>-c copy</code> : pas un seul bit n'est réencodé.
  2. Write a random tag into the <code>comment</code> metadata, with optional title randomization.写入随机标记到 <code>comment</code> 元数据，可选随机化标题。<code>comment</code> メタデータにランダムなマークを書き込み、任意でタイトルもランダム化します。<code>comment</code> 메타데이터에 무작위 표시를 쓰고, 선택적으로 제목도 무작위화합니다.On écrit une balise aléatoire dans la métadonnée <code>comment</code>, avec randomisation facultative du titre.
  3. Add <code>-movflags +faststart</code> to rearrange the container structure, which by itself changes the byte stream.加 <code>-movflags +faststart</code> 重排容器结构，这本身就会改变字节流。<code>-movflags +faststart</code> を付けてコンテナ構造を並べ替えます。これ自体がバイト列を変えます。<code>-movflags +faststart</code>로 컨테이너 구조를 재배열하는데, 이것만으로도 바이트 스트림이 바뀝니다.On ajoute <code>-movflags +faststart</code> pour réorganiser le conteneur, ce qui modifie à soi seul le flux d'octets.
Further notes补充说明補足보충 설명Remarques complémentaires
  • Verification matters here: before and after the edit, the measured <b>frame count is identical (180 frames)</b>, proving the picture really was never re-encoded.验证方式很关键：实测修改前后<b>帧数完全一致（180 帧）</b>，证明画面确实没被重新编码。検証方法が肝心です：実測で変更の前後で<b>フレーム数が完全に一致（180 フレーム）</b>し、映像が確かに再エンコードされていないことを示せました。검증 방식이 중요합니다. 실측에서 수정 전후의 <b>프레임 수가 완전히 같았고(180 프레임)</b>, 화면이 실제로 재인코딩되지 않았음이 증명되었습니다.La vérification compte ici : avant et après modification, le <b>nombre de frames mesuré est identique (180 frames)</b>, preuve que l'image n'a vraiment pas été réencodée.

    static var tool: Tool { Tool(
        id: "video.fingerprint",
        name: L("video.fingerprint.name"),
        summary: L("video.fingerprint.summary"),
        symbol: "number.circle",
        category: .video,
        accepts: ["mp4", "mov", "mkv", "m4v", "avi"],
                requiresFFmpeg: true,
        actionTitle: L("video.fingerprint.action"),
        parameters: [
            .picker("mode", L("utility.rehash.param.method.label"), default: "both", options: [
                .init("metadata", L("video.fingerprint.param.mode.label"), detail: L("video.fingerprint.param.mode.label.2")),
                .init("remux", L("video.fingerprint.param.mode.label.3"), detail: L("video.fingerprint.param.mode.label.4")),
                .init("both", L("video.fingerprint.param.mode.label.5"), detail: L("video.fingerprint.param.mode.label.6")),
            ]),
            .text("tag", L("video.fingerprint.param.tag.label"), default: "",
                  hint: L("video.fingerprint.param.tag.hint")),
            .toggle("randomTitle", L("video.fingerprint.param.randomTitle.label"), default: true),
        ],
        run: { context in
            var outputs: [URL] = []
            for (index, input) in context.inputs.enumerated() {
                try context.checkCancelled()
                let duration = await MediaProbe.duration(input)
                let output = context.output(index: index, ext: input.pathExtension, suffix: L("video.fingerprint.param.randomTitle.label.2"))
                let mode = context.choice("mode", "both")
                let marker = context.string("tag", "").isEmpty
                    ? UUID().uuidString.replacingOccurrences(of: "-", with: "")
                    : context.string("tag")

                var args: [String] = ["-c", "copy", "-map", "0"]

                if mode == "metadata" || mode == "both" {
                    args += ["-metadata", "comment=FormatForge-\(marker)"]
                    if context.bool("randomTitle", true) {
                        args += ["-metadata", "title=\(marker.prefix(12))"]
                    }
                }
                if mode == "remux" || mode == "both" {
                    // Re-laying out the container alone changes the byte stream.
                    args += ["-movflags", "+faststart"]
                    args += ["-fflags", "+bitexact", "-flags:v", "+bitexact", "-flags:a", "+bitexact"]
                }

                outputs.append(try await VideoSupport.encode(
                    context, input: input, output: output,
                    arguments: args, duration: duration))
            }
            return outputs
        }
    ) }

How it works实现原理実装の仕組み구현 원리Comment ça marche

Strip private metadata (capture device, GPS, creation time) - again without re-encoding.删除隐私元数据（拍摄设备、GPS、创建时间），同样不重新编码。プライバシーに関わるメタデータ（撮影機器・GPS・作成日時）を削除します。これも再エンコードしません。촬영 기기, GPS, 생성 시간 같은 사생활 관련 메타데이터를 삭제하며, 마찬가지로 재인코딩하지 않습니다.Supprimer les métadonnées privées (appareil de prise de vue, GPS, date de création), là encore sans réencodage.

    static var tool: Tool { Tool(
        id: "video.strip",
        name: L("video.strip.name"),
        summary: L("video.strip.summary"),
        symbol: "eye.slash",
        category: .video,
        accepts: ["mp4", "mov", "mkv", "m4v", "avi"],
                requiresFFmpeg: true,
        actionTitle: L("video.strip.action"),
        parameters: [
            .toggle("keepRotation", L("video.strip.param.keepRotation.label"), default: true,
                    hint: L("video.strip.param.keepRotation.hint")),
        ],
        run: { context in
            var outputs: [URL] = []
            for (index, input) in context.inputs.enumerated() {
                try context.checkCancelled()
                let duration = await MediaProbe.duration(input)
                let output = context.output(index: index, ext: input.pathExtension, suffix: L("video.strip.param.keepRotation.label.2"))
                var args = ["-c", "copy", "-map", "0", "-map_metadata", "-1"]
                if context.bool("keepRotation", true) {
                    let rotation = await MediaProbe.info(for: input)?.rotation ?? 0
                    if rotation != 0 {
                        args += ["-metadata:s:v:0", "rotate=\(rotation)"]
                    }
                }
                outputs.append(try await VideoSupport.encode(
                    context, input: input, output: output,
                    arguments: args, duration: duration))
            }
            return outputs
        }
    ) }

How it works实现原理実装の仕組み구현 원리Comment ça marche

The key to format conversion is <b>matching transparency against lossy parameters</b>: JPEG has no alpha, so converting to it gives you a black background.格式转换的关键是<b>透明度与有损参数的匹配</b>：JPEG 不支持透明，转过去会变黑底。形式変換の要点は<b>透明度と非可逆パラメータの噛み合わせ</b>です：JPEG は透明を扱えないため、そのまま変換すると黒背景になります。형식 변환의 핵심은 <b>투명도와 손실 파라미터의 조합</b>입니다. JPEG는 투명을 지원하지 않아 변환하면 검은 배경이 됩니다.La clé d'une conversion de format est <b>l'accord entre transparence et paramètres avec perte</b> : le JPEG ne gère pas la transparence, et une conversion vers lui donne un fond noir.
  1. Read the image and correct the EXIF orientation first.先读取并纠正 EXIF 方向。まず EXIF の向きを読んで補正します。먼저 EXIF 방향을 읽어 보정합니다.On lit d'abord l'image et on corrige l'orientation EXIF.
  2. Optionally resize according to the "size handling" parameter.按「尺寸处理」参数可选地缩放。「サイズ処理」パラメータに応じて任意で縮小します。"크기 처리" 파라미터에 따라 선택적으로 크기를 조정합니다.On redimensionne éventuellement selon le paramètre « traitement des dimensions ».
  3. When the target format has no alpha (JPEG/BMP), lay down a white background before compositing.目标格式不支持透明时（JPEG/BMP），先铺一层白底再合成。変換先の形式が透明を扱えない場合（JPEG/BMP）は、先に白で塗りつぶしてから合成します。대상 형식이 투명을 지원하지 않으면(JPEG/BMP) 흰 배경을 먼저 깔고 합성합니다.Quand le format cible ignore la transparence (JPEG/BMP), on pose d'abord un fond blanc avant de composer.
  4. Formats ImageIO can write are written directly; WebP goes through the bundled cwebp.ImageIO 能写的格式直接写；WebP 交给内嵌的 cwebp。ImageIO が書ける形式はそのまま書き、WebP は内蔵の cwebp に任せます。ImageIO가 쓸 수 있는 형식은 바로 쓰고, WebP는 내장된 cwebp에 맡깁니다.Les formats qu'ImageIO sait écrire sont écrits directement ; le WebP passe par le cwebp embarqué.
Further notes补充说明補足보충 설명Remarques complémentaires
  • Measured: JPG to WebP drops from 28 KB to 12 KB.实测 JPG→WebP 体积从 28 KB 降到 12 KB。実測で JPG→WebP のサイズが 28 KB から 12 KB に減りました。실측으로 JPG→WebP 변환 시 용량이 28 KB에서 12 KB로 줄었습니다.Mesuré : le passage de JPG à WebP fait tomber le poids de 28 Ko à 12 Ko.
  • HEIC/AVIF are supported too, but encoding is slower.HEIC/AVIF 也支持，但编码较慢。HEIC/AVIF にも対応しますが、エンコードは遅めです。HEIC/AVIF도 지원하지만 인코딩이 느립니다.HEIC/AVIF sont également pris en charge, mais l'encodage est plus lent.

    static var tool: Tool { Tool(
        id: "image.convert",
        name: L("image.convert.name"),
        summary: L("image.convert.summary"),
        symbol: "arrow.left.arrow.right",
        category: .image,
        accepts: ["png", "jpg", "jpeg", "gif", "webp", "tiff", "tif", "bmp", "heic", "heif",
                  "avif", "ico", "icns", "psd", "tga", "jp2", "exr", "dng", "cr2", "nef", "arw", "raf"],
        actionTitle: L("ui.start"),
        parameters: [
            .picker("codec", L("image.convert.param.codec.label"), default: "jpeg", options: ImageCodec.allCases.map {
                PickerOption($0.rawValue, $0.label, detail: $0.detail)
            }),
            .slider("quality", L("pdf.toimage.param.quality.label"), default: 90, min: 10, max: 100, step: 1,
                    hint: L("image.convert.param.quality.hint"),
                    visibleWhen: .oneOf("codec", ["jpeg", "heic", "avif", "webp", "jp2"])),
            .slider("compression", L("image.convert.param.compression.label"), default: 60, min: 0, max: 100, step: 5,
                    hint: L("image.convert.param.compression.hint"),
                    visibleWhen: .oneOf("codec", ["png", "tiff"])),
            .picker("resize", L("image.convert.param.resize.label"), default: "keep", options: [
                .init("keep", L("enum.kind.lossless")), .init("maxWidth", L("image.convert.param.resize.label.2")),
                .init("maxHeight", L("image.convert.param.resize.label.3")), .init("percent", L("image.convert.param.resize.label.4")),
            ]),
            .number("maxWidth", L("image.convert.param.maxWidth.label"), default: 1920, min: 16, max: 20_000, step: 10,
                    visibleWhen: .equals("resize", "maxWidth")),
            .number("maxHeight", L("image.convert.param.maxHeight.label"), default: 1080, min: 16, max: 20_000, step: 10,
                    visibleWhen: .equals("resize", "maxHeight")),
            .slider("percent", L("image.convert.param.percent.label"), default: 50, min: 1, max: 400, step: 1,
                    visibleWhen: .equals("resize", "percent")),
            .number("dpi", L("image.convert.param.dpi.label"), default: 0, min: 0, max: 1200, step: 1),
            .toggle("flatten", L("image.convert.param.flatten.label"), default: true,
                    hint: L("image.convert.param.flatten.hint")),
            .toggle("stripMetadata", L("image.convert.param.stripMetadata.label"), default: false),
        ],
        run: { context in
            let codec = ImageCodec(rawValue: context.choice("codec", "jpeg")) ?? .jpeg
            let quality = context.double("quality", 90) / 100
            let compression = context.double("compression", 60) / 100
            let dpi = context.double("dpi", 0)
            let strip = context.bool("stripMetadata")
            let flatten = context.bool("flatten", true)
            let useNativeEncoder = ImageSupport.needsFFmpeg(codec)

            return try await ConcurrentProcessor.run(context.inputs, reporter: context.progress) { url, index in
                try context.checkCancelled()
                guard var image = ImageSupport.loadOriented(url) else {
                    throw ProcessError.failed(code: 0, message: L("image.convert.param.stripMetadata.label.2", url.lastPathComponent))
                }
                image = try ImageConvertTool.applyResize(image, context: context)
                if flatten && !codec.supportsAlpha {
                    image = ImageConvertTool.flatten(image) ?? image
                }

                let output = context.output(index: index, ext: codec.fileExtension, suffix: "")
                if useNativeEncoder {
                    try await ImageSupport.writeNonNative(
                        image, to: output, codec: codec, quality: quality, context: context)
                } else {
                    try ImageSupport.write(
                        image, to: output, codec: codec,
                        quality: quality, compression: compression,
                        dpi: dpi > 0 ? dpi : nil,
                        metadata: strip ? [:] : nil)
                }
                return output
            }
        }
    ) }

How it works实现原理実装の仕組み구현 원리Comment ça marche

Target-size compression closes in with a <b>binary search</b>: encoders don't offer a "give me 500 KB" switch, so you have to try.按目标体积压缩用<b>二分搜索</b>逼近：编码器不提供「给我 500 KB」这种接口，只能试。目標サイズ圧縮は<b>二分探索</b>で近づけます：エンコーダには「500 KB で」と頼むインターフェースがないので、試すしかありません。목표 용량 압축은 <b>이진 탐색</b>으로 접근합니다. 인코더에 "500 KB로 주세요" 같은 인터페이스는 없으니 시도해 볼 수밖에 없습니다.La compression à taille cible s'approche par <b>recherche dichotomique</b> : aucun encodeur n'offre d'option « donne-moi 500 Ko », il faut essayer.
  1. By quality: use the given value as-is.按画质：直接用指定值。画質優先：指定値をそのまま使います。화질 기준: 지정한 값을 그대로 씁니다.Par qualité : on prend la valeur indiquée telle quelle.
  2. By target size/percentage: binary search between 0.05 and 1.0, encoding to a temp file and measuring the size each round, up to 7 rounds, stopping early once the error is within 8%.按目标体积/百分比：在 0.05–1.0 之间二分，每次编码到临时文件量体积，最多 7 轮，误差进入 8% 就提前结束。目標サイズ/割合優先：0.05〜1.0 の間で二分し、毎回一時ファイルへエンコードしてサイズを測ります。最大 7 ラウンドで、誤差が 8% に入れば途中で終了します。목표 용량/백분율 기준: 0.05–1.0 사이에서 이진 탐색하고, 매번 임시 파일로 인코딩해 용량을 재며, 최대 7회까지 돌고 오차가 8% 안에 들면 일찍 끝냅니다.Par taille cible / pourcentage : recherche dichotomique entre 0,05 et 1,0, avec un encodage vers un fichier temporaire et une mesure de taille à chaque tour, 7 tours au maximum, et arrêt anticipé dès que l'écart passe sous 8 %.
  3. PNG is lossless, so re-encoding usually makes the file bigger, so it switches to JPEG automatically.PNG 是无损格式，重新编码通常会让文件变大，所以自动改用 JPEG。PNG は可逆形式で、再エンコードするとたいていファイルが大きくなるため、自動的に JPEG へ切り替えます。PNG는 무손실 형식이라 재인코딩하면 보통 파일이 커지므로 자동으로 JPEG로 바꿉니다.Le PNG est un format sans perte : le réencoder fait généralement grossir le fichier, d'où le basculement automatique vers JPEG.
Further notes补充说明補足보충 설명Remarques complémentaires
  • The binary search adds up to 7 extra encodes per image, so batch processing gets noticeably slower - that is the trade-off of precision for time.二分搜索对每张图要多编码 7 次，所以批量处理会明显变慢——这是精度换时间的取舍。二分探索は 1 枚につき最大 7 回多くエンコードするので、一括処理は目に見えて遅くなります——精度と引き換えの時間です。이진 탐색은 이미지마다 인코딩을 7번 더 하므로 일괄 처리에서 눈에 띄게 느려집니다. 정확도를 위해 시간을 내주는 맞바꿈입니다.La recherche dichotomique ajoute jusqu'à 7 encodages par image, ce qui ralentit nettement le traitement par lots — c'est le compromis de la précision contre le temps.

    static var tool: Tool { Tool(
        id: "image.compress",
        name: L("image.compress.name"),
        summary: L("image.compress.summary"),
        symbol: "arrow.down.circle",
        category: .image,
        accepts: ["png", "jpg", "jpeg", "heic", "avif", "webp", "tiff", "tif", "bmp", "gif"],
        actionTitle: L("archive.create.action"),
        parameters: [
            .picker("mode", L("image.compress.param.mode.label"), default: "quality", options: [
                .init("quality", L("image.compress.param.mode.label.2")), .init("targetSize", L("image.compress.param.mode.label.3")),
                .init("percent", L("image.compress.param.mode.label.4")),
            ]),
            .slider("quality", L("pdf.toimage.param.quality.label"), default: 75, min: 10, max: 100, step: 1,
                    hint: L("image.compress.param.quality.hint"),
                    visibleWhen: .equals("mode", "quality")),
            .number("targetKB", L("image.compress.param.targetKB.label"), default: 500, min: 5, max: 200_000, step: 10,
                    visibleWhen: .equals("mode", "targetSize")),
            .slider("percent", L("image.compress.param.percent.label"), default: 50, min: 5, max: 95, step: 5,
                    visibleWhen: .equals("mode", "percent")),
            .picker("format", L("doc.ocr.param.output.label"), default: "keep", options: [
                .init("keep", L("image.compress.param.format.label")), .init("jpeg", "JPEG"), .init("webp", "WebP"),
                .init("heic", "HEIC"), .init("png", "PNG"),
            ]),
            .picker("resize", L("image.convert.param.resize.label"), default: "keep", options: [
                .init("keep", L("enum.kind.lossless")), .init("maxWidth", L("image.convert.param.resize.label.2")),
                .init("maxHeight", L("image.convert.param.resize.label.3")), .init("percent", L("image.convert.param.resize.label.4")),
            ]),
            .number("maxWidth", L("image.convert.param.maxWidth.label"), default: 1920, min: 16, max: 20_000, step: 10,
                    visibleWhen: .equals("resize", "maxWidth")),
            .number("maxHeight", L("image.convert.param.maxHeight.label"), default: 1080, min: 16, max: 20_000, step: 10,
                    visibleWhen: .equals("resize", "maxHeight")),
            .slider("scalePercent", L("image.convert.param.percent.label"), default: 70, min: 5, max: 100, step: 5,
                    visibleWhen: .equals("resize", "percent")),
        ],
        run: { context in
            let mode = context.choice("mode", "quality")
            let requestedFormat = context.choice("format", "keep")
            let originalBytes = context.inputs.reduce(Int64(0)) { $0 + FileIO.size(of: $1) }

            let outputs = try await ConcurrentProcessor.run(context.inputs, reporter: context.progress) { url, index in
                try context.checkCancelled()
                guard var image = ImageSupport.loadOriented(url) else {
                    throw ProcessError.failed(code: 0, message: L("image.convert.param.stripMetadata.label.2", url.lastPathComponent))
                }
                image = try ImageConvertTool.applyResize(image, context: context)

                var codec: ImageCodec
                if requestedFormat == "keep" {
                    codec = ImageCodec.from(extension: url.pathExtension) ?? .jpeg
                    if codec == .tiff { codec = .jpeg }
                } else {
                    codec = ImageCodec(rawValue: requestedFormat) ?? .jpeg
                }
                // PNG is lossless; re-encoding it usually grows the file.
                if codec == .png && mode != "percent" { codec = .jpeg }
                if !codec.supportsAlpha {
                    image = ImageConvertTool.flatten(image) ?? image
                }

                let output = context.output(index: index, ext: codec.fileExtension, suffix: L("doc.pdfcompress.param.grayscale.label.2"))
                let quality = try ImageCompressTool.resolveQuality(
                    mode: mode, context: context, image: image,
                    codec: codec, output: output, sourceBytes: FileIO.size(of: url))

                if ImageSupport.needsFFmpeg(codec) {
                    try await ImageSupport.writeNonNative(
                        image, to: output, codec: codec, quality: quality, context: context)
                } else {
                    try ImageSupport.write(image, to: output, codec: codec, quality: quality)
                }
                return output
            }

            let outputBytes = outputs.reduce(Int64(0)) { $0 + FileIO.size(of: $1) }
            if originalBytes > 0, outputBytes > 0 {
                let saved = 1 - Double(outputBytes) / Double(originalBytes)
                context.progress.note(String(format: L("image.compress.param.scalePercent.label"), saved * 100))
            }
            return outputs
        }
    ) }

How it works实现原理実装の仕組み구현 원리Comment ça marche

"Shrink only, never enlarge" is on by default, because upscaling only makes the image blurrier and the file bigger.「仅缩小不放大」是默认开启的，因为放大只会让图片变模糊、体积变大。「縮小のみ、拡大しない」が既定でオンです。拡大は画像をぼかしてサイズを大きくするだけだからです。"축소만 하고 확대는 하지 않음"이 기본으로 켜져 있습니다. 확대는 이미지를 흐리게 만들고 용량만 키우기 때문입니다.« Réduire seulement, jamais agrandir » est actif par défaut, car l'agrandissement ne fait que flouter l'image et alourdir le fichier.
  1. Compute the target size from the mode: specified width/height, exact size, percentage, or capped long edge.按模式算出目标尺寸：指定宽/高、精确尺寸、百分比、限制长边。モードに応じて目標サイズを算出します：幅/高さ指定、正確なサイズ、割合、長辺の制限。모드에 따라 대상 크기를 계산합니다. 너비/높이 지정, 정확한 크기, 백분율, 긴 변 제한.On calcule la taille cible selon le mode : largeur/hauteur imposée, dimensions exactes, pourcentage ou grand côté borné.
  2. If shrink-only is on, clamp the target to within the source dimensions.若开启仅缩小，把目标钳制到源尺寸以内。縮小のみがオンなら、ターゲットを元サイズ以内にクランプします。축소만 하기가 켜져 있으면 대상을 원본 크기 안으로 제한합니다.Si la réduction seule est active, la cible est bornée aux dimensions de la source.
  3. Redraw with CoreGraphics at <code>.high</code> interpolation quality.用 CoreGraphics 以 <code>.high</code> 插值质量重绘。CoreGraphics で <code>.high</code> の補間品質で描き直します。CoreGraphics로 <code>.high</code> 보간 품질로 다시 그립니다.On redessine avec CoreGraphics à la qualité d'interpolation <code>.high</code>.

    static var tool: Tool { Tool(
        id: "image.resize",
        name: L("image.resize.name"),
        summary: L("image.resize.summary"),
        symbol: "arrow.up.left.and.arrow.down.right",
        category: .image,
        accepts: ["png", "jpg", "jpeg", "gif", "webp", "tiff", "tif", "bmp", "heic", "heif", "avif", "ico"],
        actionTitle: L("image.resize.action"),
        parameters: [
            .picker("mode", L("image.resize.param.mode.label"), default: "width", options: [
                .init("width", L("image.resize.param.mode.label.2")), .init("height", L("image.resize.param.mode.label.3")),
                .init("exact", L("image.resize.param.mode.label.4")), .init("percent", L("image.resize.param.mode.label.5")),
                .init("longEdge", L("image.resize.param.mode.label.6")),
            ]),
            .number("width", L("image.resize.param.width.label"), default: 1920, min: 1, max: 20_000, step: 1,
                    visibleWhen: .oneOf("mode", ["width", "exact"])),
            .number("height", L("image.resize.param.height.label"), default: 1080, min: 1, max: 20_000, step: 1,
                    visibleWhen: .oneOf("mode", ["height", "exact"])),
            .slider("percent", L("image.convert.param.percent.label"), default: 50, min: 1, max: 400, step: 1,
                    visibleWhen: .equals("mode", "percent")),
            .number("longEdge", L("image.resize.param.longEdge.label"), default: 1600, min: 1, max: 20_000, step: 1,
                    visibleWhen: .equals("mode", "longEdge")),
            .picker("fit", L("image.resize.param.fit.label"), default: "stretch", options: ImageFit.allCases.map {
                PickerOption($0.rawValue, $0.label)
            }, visibleWhen: .equals("mode", "exact")),
            .toggle("onlyShrink", L("image.resize.param.onlyShrink.label"), default: true),
            .number("dpi", L("image.convert.param.dpi.label"), default: 0, min: 0, max: 1200, step: 1),
            .picker("format", L("doc.ocr.param.output.label"), default: "keep", options: [
                .init("keep", L("image.compress.param.format.label")), .init("png", "PNG"), .init("jpeg", "JPEG"), .init("webp", "WebP"),
            ]),
        ],
        run: { context in
            let requested = context.choice("format", "keep")
            let dpi = context.double("dpi", 0)
            let onlyShrink = context.bool("onlyShrink", true)

            return try await ConcurrentProcessor.run(context.inputs, reporter: context.progress) { url, index in
                try context.checkCancelled()
                guard let image = ImageSupport.loadOriented(url) else {
                    throw ProcessError.failed(code: 0, message: L("image.convert.param.stripMetadata.label.2", url.lastPathComponent))
                }

                let source = CGSize(width: image.width, height: image.height)
                var target = ImageResizeTool.targetSize(source: source, context: context)
                if onlyShrink {
                    target.width = min(target.width, source.width)
                    target.height = min(target.height, source.height)
                }
                target.width = max(target.width.rounded(), 1)
                target.height = max(target.height.rounded(), 1)

                let fit: ImageFit = context.choice("mode", "width") == "exact"
                    ? (ImageFit(rawValue: context.choice("fit", "stretch")) ?? .stretch)
                    : .stretch

                guard let resized = ImageSupport.resize(image, to: target, fit: fit) else {
                    throw ProcessError.failed(code: 0, message: L("image.resize.param.format.label", url.lastPathComponent))
                }

                let codec = requested == "keep"
                    ? (ImageCodec.from(extension: url.pathExtension) ?? .png)
                    : (ImageCodec(rawValue: requested) ?? .png)
                let output = context.output(index: index, ext: codec.fileExtension, suffix: "_\(Int(target.width))")

                if ImageSupport.needsFFmpeg(codec) {
                    try await ImageSupport.writeNonNative(
                        resized, to: output, codec: codec, quality: 0.92, context: context)
                } else {
                    try ImageSupport.write(resized, to: output, codec: codec,
                                           quality: 0.92, dpi: dpi > 0 ? dpi : nil)
                }
                return output
            }
        }
    ) }

How it works实现原理実装の仕組み구현 원리Comment ça marche

Crop first, then rotate - the order can't be flipped, because rotating first changes the coordinate system the proportional crop works in.先裁剪再旋转，顺序不能反——先旋转的话，按比例裁剪的坐标系就变了。切り抜きを先、回転を後に行います。順序は逆にできません——先に回転すると、割合で切り抜く際の座標系が変わってしまうからです。자르기를 먼저 하고 회전을 나중에 합니다. 순서를 바꾸면 안 됩니다. 먼저 회전하면 비율 기준으로 자르는 좌표계가 달라집니다.On recadre avant de tourner, et l'ordre ne s'inverse pas : tourner d'abord changerait le repère dans lequel le recadrage proportionnel s'effectue.
  1. Proportional center crop: work out the difference between the source and target ratios and take the largest inscribed rectangle.按比例居中裁剪：算出源比例与目标比例的差异，取最大内接矩形。割合で中央切り抜き：元の比率と目標比率の差を求め、最大の内接矩形を取ります。비율 기준 가운데 자르기: 원본 비율과 대상 비율의 차이를 계산해 가장 큰 내접 사각형을 취합니다.Recadrage centré proportionnel : on calcule l'écart entre le rapport source et le rapport cible, puis on prend le plus grand rectangle inscrit.
  2. Percentage inset: pull each of the four sides in by the given proportion.按百分比内缩：四周各缩进指定比例。割合で内側に縮める：四辺をそれぞれ指定割合だけ狭めます。백분율 안쪽 축소: 사방에서 지정한 비율만큼 들여냅니다.Retrait en pourcentage : on rentre les quatre côtés de la proportion indiquée.
  3. Rotation uses CGContext's <code>rotate</code> and swaps width and height at the same time.旋转用 CGContext 的 <code>rotate</code>，同时交换宽高。回転は CGContext の <code>rotate</code> を使い、同時に幅と高さを入れ替えます。회전은 CGContext의 <code>rotate</code>를 쓰고 너비와 높이를 함께 바꿉니다.La rotation passe par <code>rotate</code> de CGContext, en échangeant largeur et hauteur.
  4. Mirroring is done with <code>scaleBy(x: -1)</code>.镜像用 <code>scaleBy(x: -1)</code> 实现。鏡像は <code>scaleBy(x: -1)</code> で実装します。좌우 반전은 <code>scaleBy(x: -1)</code>로 구현합니다.Le miroir s'obtient avec <code>scaleBy(x: -1)</code>.
